  • Expertise with asynchronous processing, event streaming, and messaging platforms, including Apache Kafka.
  • Experience implementing modern DevOps and CI/CD practices using.Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Ansible, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Strong understanding of software engineering best practices including. Secure coding, Test automation, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery, Observability and monitoring, Performance optimization, Reliability engineering
  • Proven experience leading architecture reviews, defining technical roadmaps, and driving engineering excellence across multiple teams
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to executive, business, product, and engineering audiences

  • Experience with object storage technologies, including MinIO

  • Experience implementing enterprise security frameworks, including OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT, and Zero Trust principles

raw.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Job Type: Full-time

Location: This role is fully remote but must be based in Mozambique or DRC only.

Priority Application Deadline: October 5, 2026 or until we receive a critical mass of applications

About this role

GiveDirectly is planning to grow delivery roughly tenfold by 2028. Getting there means changing our programs faster and more often than we ever have: consolidating country programs onto a small number of common Salesforce builds through 2027, then layering on new enrollment models — large-group barazas, remote and self-enrollment — from 2028.

Every one of those changes has to land with roughly 650 people in country operations. A new survey design is only as good as the Field Officer's understanding of it at seven in the morning, standing in a village with a tablet and no supervisor nearby. A Country Director needs to know why we changed something and what risk it carries. A Field Manager needs to know what changes about supervision and quality checks. A Field Officer needs to know exactly what to do differently tomorrow, and nothing else.

That translation work is this role. You will turn new survey designs, program changes, and system releases into training materials, live training sessions, demo videos, release notes, and internal communications pitched at the right level for each audience — from Country Director down to Field Officer.

We are looking specifically for someone who has been a Field Officer, or held a directly equivalent frontline role. Not as a nice-to-have: this role exists because materials written by people who have never run a registration are consistently too abstract, too long, and wrong about which details actually matter. You should know from experience what makes a training useful and what makes it a waste of a morning.

Your work will be anchored on the 2027 rollout — supporting the consolidation of country programs onto common Salesforce builds, which is high-volume and has real deadlines — and will absorb 2028 pilot material as those designs become real. Beyond that, you will be a genuinely useful pair of hands to a small, fast-moving product team: expect a meaningful share of your time to go to ad-hoc support that doesn't fit neatly in a job description.

We work across English, Portuguese and French. Materials that only exist in English do not reach Mozambique or DRC, and translating them after the fact is slow and lossy. We need someone who can write well in English and work in at least one of Portuguese or French.

Explicitly not in scope:

  • Designing the programs or surveys themselves — owned by the 2028 Design Lead, the STPM, Large Transfers, and the Senior Director, Product; this role makes those designs usable, and will often be the first person to notice when a design isn't explainable

  • Salesforce configuration and technical build work — owned by the Technical Program Managers

  • Deciding which change requests get built and when — owned by the STPM, Large Transfers

  • Staff development, onboarding, and performance training — owned by the People team; this role covers product and program training only

Reports to: Sarah Kenkuyu,Senior Manager Product, LLS

Level: Open band — Associate to Manager, depending on the candidate. We would rather find the right person than fill a predetermined level. A candidate with deeper field experience, stronger writing, and the judgment to run their own queue and push back on a poorly explained design will be brought in at the higher end, with correspondingly more independence.

Day-to-day work assignment: Requests come primarily from the STPM, Large Transfers (2027 build rollout) and the 2028 Design Lead, with the Senior Director, Product arbitrating priorities when they conflict. You are not expected to absorb every request that arrives — part of the job is flagging when the queue is over capacity.

Travel Requirement: Regular — roughly once per quarter at minimum, and more during rollout waves, to deliver training in person and to see how materials actually perform in the field.

What you'll do

  • Build the training materials that make new designs usable in the field

    • e.g., turning new survey designs, program changes, and Salesforce releases into practical training decks, job aids, quick-reference sheets, and step-by-step guides — written for someone who will use them on a tablet in the field, not read them at a desk

  • Write internal communications pitched to the level of the reader

    • e.g., taking a single change and producing the version each audience actually needs: the why and the risk for a Country Director; the timeline, staffing and cost implications for a Program Director; what changes about supervision and quality checks for a Field Manager or Assistant Field Manager; and exactly what to do differently tomorrow for a Field Officer — deciding what each group does not need to know is as much of the job as deciding what they do

  • Deliver training live, and record it when live doesn't scale

    • e.g., running training sessions with country teams before a rollout, in person or remotely; recording screen-capture demo videos of new builds and flows so teams can refresh without waiting for a session; and building a library that new staff can be pointed to rather than re-trained from scratch

  • Own release notes and change documentation

    • e.g., writing clear release notes as changes ship to the common Salesforce build, so country teams understand what changed, why, and what they need to do — and keeping documentation current rather than letting it drift from what the system actually does

  • Work across English, Portuguese and French

    • e.g., producing or adapting materials so Mozambique and DRC teams receive them in a usable language on the same timeline as everyone else, and managing translation support where your own languages don't reach

  • Be a useful pair of hands to a small, fast-moving product team

    • e.g., ad-hoc support across the Program Design team — pulling together a briefing, cleaning up a deck before a leadership check-in, taking notes and turning them into actions, chasing an open item across countries. Some of this will be unglamorous. It is also how you will learn the whole system faster than anyone else on the team

  • Close the loop from the field back to design

    • e.g., noticing when the same question keeps coming up in training, when a design cannot be explained simply because it isn't simple, or when field teams have quietly worked around a change — and bringing that back to the people who own the design

First 90 days

So the scope is unambiguous, here is what we expect the first three months to look like:

  • Days 0–30: Get oriented on the 2027 common Salesforce build and the countries moving onto it first. Review the training and documentation that exists today and give us an honest read on what's working and what isn't — you will have a sharper view of this than we do.

  • Days 30–60: Produce the full enablement package for one country's rollout: training materials, a live session delivered, at least one demo video, release notes, and the layered internal comms from Country Director to Field Officer. This becomes the template for everything after it.

  • Days 60–90: Adapt that package for a second and third country, including at least one Portuguese- or French-speaking market. Establish a simple intake and prioritization method for training requests, so the queue is visible rather than negotiated ad hoc.

What success looks like:

At 6 months:

  • Every rollout onto the common Salesforce build ships with training and release notes as standard, rather than as an afterthought

  • A demo video and materials library that country teams actually use, evidenced by repeat access rather than one-off downloads

  • Materials reaching Portuguese- or French-speaking teams on the same timeline as English-speaking ones

  • Fewer repeated questions from field teams post-launch — measured however crudely, but measured

At 12 months:

  • A reusable enablement template that any new country rollout or 2028 pilot can be plugged into in days

  • Documentation that stays current with the system, with a maintenance rhythm rather than periodic rewrites

  • A track record of catching unexplainable designs before they reach the field, and of the design being changed as a result

  • Trusted enough by country leadership that they come to you directly when a change needs explaining

What you'll bring

  • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.

  • Language Requirement: English (professional written fluency — this role's core craft is writing), plus professional working proficiency in Portuguese or French.

  • Language Preferences: English, Portuguese and French all three — this is the ideal profile. Additional languages spoken in our countries of operation are a plus.

Required:

  • Prior experience as a Field Officer, or in a directly equivalent frontline data-collection or enrollment role, at GiveDirectly or a comparable cash transfer, humanitarian, or survey organization

  • Excellent written English: clear, short, and organized, with a real instinct for what a reader needs and what they can be spared

  • Professional working proficiency in Portuguese or French, including written

  • Experience producing training or instructional material, and delivering training live to groups

  • Ability to translate technical or system changes into plain, practical instruction without losing the parts that matter

  • Organized and self-directed enough to run a queue of requests from several stakeholders, and to say clearly when it is over capacity

  • Willingness to travel to field sites, including rural and low-infrastructure locations

Preferred:

  • Comfort recording and lightly editing screen-capture demo videos (e.g., Loom or similar)

  • Familiarity with GiveDirectly's core systems — Salesforce, CommCare, Call Center Studio

  • Experience writing release notes, product documentation, or change communications

  • Formal training in instructional design or adult learning

  • Experience delivering training across languages, or working with interpreters and translators

  • Progression from Field Officer into a supervisory role (AFM/FM), giving you sight of what supervisors need as well as what field staff need

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

Kenya

  • Base Salary: $46,930
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% of base salary

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

Referrals

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them. We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

raw.description:
About Us:

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care’s mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Nadia Care does not replace the primary obstetrician or doctor’s relationships. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors’ offices.

Our Values:

  • Empathy is at the heart of everything we do. We must always center the experiences of the mothers and families we serve, as well as support and uplift one another.
  • Collaboration is what makes us stronger. We achieve the greatest impact when we work together, share knowledge, and elevate each other’s strengths.
  • Resilience reflects our ability to push through challenges, adapt in a fast-changing environment, and remain committed to our mission no matter the obstacles.

The Role:

Nadia Care is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD) to join our team. In this role, you will deliver essential, specialized nutrition education and support to expectant and new mothers, especially those navigating high-risk pregnancies or managing chronic health conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and anemia.

As a trusted partner, you will support the health and well-being of Nadia members and their babies through individualized dietary plans, virtual consultations, and education tailored to their nutritional needs. This position will primarily serve our members in Tennessee and potentially other areas in the future beyond what is listed, and report to the Director of Care Delivery.

Work Schedule:

This is a remote, contract position working 5-10 hours a week. The schedule is based on your availability to accept scheduled visits and group classes. You are responsible for being present on our platforms at those provided times.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver individualized perinatal and postpartum nutrition education via scheduled, virtual visits.
  • Facilitate scheduled, virtual group classes for perinatal and postpartum nutrition, equipping mothers with essential knowledge for managing pregnancy and optimizing health outcomes.
  • Ensure clear and precise documentation for all care interactions.
  • Adhere to our policies and procedures to maintain the highest standard of care for our members.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Registered Dietitian (RD) and credentialed by the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).
  • Current licensure to practice in Tennessee (licensure in other states e.g., Maryland, and DC is a plus!)
  • Demonstrated experience in providing medical nutrition therapy to perinatal and postpartum individuals managing conditions such as diabetes, hypertension or preeclampsia, inadequate weight gain, and anemia.
  • Experience serving families eligible for Medicaid, SNAP, or WIC programs.
  • Exceptional listening and communication skills, including proficiency in motivational interviewing techniques and the ability to provide practical, culturally sensitive guidance with empathy.
  • Excellent organizational skills and proven ability to manage multiple priorities, such as member visits and messages, in a fast-paced environment.
  • Access to reliable home internet.
  • Tech-savvy; proficient in using EHR and messaging platforms for documentation and communication.

Nice to haves, but not required:

  • IBCLC certification with relevant hospital or outpatient experience.
  • Proficiency in navigating and documenting within AthenaOne EHR.
  • Fluent in Spanish.
  • Experience in a start-up environment or strong adaptability to a fast-evolving organization.

Benefits of Contracting with us:

  • Skip payment headaches: we manage the billing process for you and contracts directly with insurers.
  • Help even more families: we find the members and seamlessly connects you with them.
  • Feel the power of a team behind you: Our Maternity Navigators develop deep relationships with our members in their first and second trimester, monitoring their health and connecting them with community resources for a healthy pregnancy.

The compensation for this contractor role is between $35-$43 per hour. The exact range will depend on years of relevant and direct experience.

For full-time employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally:

Time Off That Works for You

  • Recharge with annual paid holidays off.
  • Full-Time Salaried Employees (Exempt): Enjoy unlimited time off after the 90-day introductory period.
  • Full-Time Hourly Employees (Non-Exempt): Receive three weeks of paid time off after the 90-day introductory period.

Comprehensive Health & Wellness Coverage

  • Medical Insurance: Access top-tier healthcare, covering hospital, surgical, and prescription drug benefits. Coverage begins the first of the following month.
  • Dental Insurance: Coverage for preventive care, as well as basic and major procedures.
  • Vision Insurance: Coverage for routine eye exams and eyeglasses.

Security & Future Planning Options

  • Stock Option Grant: We believe in shared success.
  • Life Insurance: Financial protection for your beneficiaries.
  • Disability Insurance: Short-term and long-term coverage in case of illness or injury.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Opportunity to save for the future.

We’re building something great and want you to be part of it. If you're looking for a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your contributions make an impact, apply today!

Remote positions are open to candidates in the contiguous US only. Due to operational and compliance requirements, we are unable to hire candidates residing in ND, AL, HI, PR or outside the contiguous US.

Please note that our recruitment team will only contact candidates via an official company email address ending in @nadiacare.com. Be cautious of scams; Nadia Care will never ask for financial information or payments at any stage of the hiring process.

Position: Writer

Hours: minimum 4 hours per week

Location: Remote

Volunteering commitment: 3 - 6 months

Job description

We are looking for motivated, creative, and autonomous writers to join us on the Marketing, Fundraising and Operations team at ConnectionHub. You will need to be independent minded and work well in a team. This is an exciting opportunity to join our charity and help build ConnectionHub’s online presence and increase engagement. You should be ambitious and excited by the prospect of telling our story, and eager to share ideas about the best ways in which to do this. The 4 roles available are: Feature Writer, Blogger, Social Media Content Creator and Campaign Copywriter.

Responsibilities:

  • Planning, writing and publishing engaging and considerate regular content for our blog, social media, campaigns and features.

  • Perform research for blog posts, articles, guides and other content.

  • Work with the team to analyze content performance metrics, to improve existing content and develop better content ideas for the future.

  • Conduct simple keyword research and use SEO guidelines to increase web traffic.

  • Pitch articles to third-party websites for publication and guest post on partner websites.

  • Work to outline expectations and requirements established in the project brief.

  • Ensure all-around consistency (style, fonts, images and tone).

  • Bachelor's degree in English, Creative Writing, Journalism or related field.

  • Proven work experience as a writer in writing for charity, non profit or related experience.

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills.

  • Ability to research and learn about a wide range of topics.

  • Excellent written skills and ability to communicate effectively with others.

  • Ability to work to tight deadlines, while maintaining attention to detail.

  • Able to commit to a weekly Zoom meeting.

  • Excellent IT skills (proficient in Microsoft packages) and design packages (desirable).

Introduction to ConnectionHub

ConnectionHub is a UK-registered charity offering blended learning programmes to refugees and asylum seekers in Lesbos, Greece. Currently, the lack of educational opportunities leaves refugees and asylum seekers in Lesbos, Greece exposed to a future of social exclusion, precarious employment, exploitation, and poverty.

ConnectionHub’s mission is to provide education and integration opportunities via blended learning pathways to people in crisis and conflict contexts, in order to reduce this human suffering and exploitation. Blended learning, which utilises both online and offline educational material and support, is proven to better facilitate student’s learning journey; with this approach we hope to give refugees and asylum seekers the chance to develop new skills that will build their capacities as individuals, help them bridge the literacy gap, and support them to change the trajectory of their lives by creating job opportunities and economic empowerment. ConnectionHub’s programmes are accessible to displaced people regardless of legal status, gender, age, or ethnic identity.

We grew 600% YoY in 2025 and serve industry leaders, consistently winning against legacy solutions. We move fast, build intentionally, and focus on delivering real value.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Product Designer at EULER, you will design the core product experience for two very different users. Partnership managers use EULER to run their programs. Channel partners use it to register deals, access content, complete training, and get paid.

A growing part of that experience is AI. That includes our in-platform agent (PAM), our Slack-accessible agent (POPS), and workflows where AI drafts, recommends, or acts on the user's behalf. You will help define what good AI UX looks like in B2B software: when the agent should act, when it should ask, and how users stay in control.

You will work day to day with Product Managers and Engineers. This is a hands-on IC role. You own features from problem framing through shipped UI.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own end-to-end design for product areas across the partner portal and the admin experience. That covers discovery, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and engineering-ready specs.
  • Design AI-driven experiences, including agent interactions, suggested actions, generated content, and the states around them (loading, uncertainty, errors, human review).
  • Simplify complex B2B workflows such as deal registration, referrals, incentives and payouts, onboarding flows, and partner analytics.
  • Contribute to and use EULER's Figma design system, including components, tokens, and variables that keep the product consistent as we ship.
  • Run lightweight research and usability tests with customers and partners, and turn findings into concrete design changes.
  • Prototype quickly in Figma and Claude Design to test ideas with users before they reach engineering.
  • Work closely with engineers during build and review implemented UI against spec.
  • Track how your work performs after launch, including adoption, task completion, and drop-off, and iterate based on what you learn.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years of product design experience in B2B SaaS.
  • A portfolio showing end-to-end product work on complex workflows, not only visual polish. A portfolio is required to be considered.
  • Experience designing for more than one user type, with different goals and mental models.
  • Strong Figma skills: auto layout, components, variants, variables, and prototyping.
  • Comfortable using AI design tools such as Claude Design to explore and prototype faster without lowering quality.
  • Hands-on experience designing AI features, or a clear, well-argued point of view on how AI should show up in product UX.
  • Comfortable running research and usability tests yourself.
  • Clear written communication. You can explain a design decision in a short async message.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and decisions made with incomplete information.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with PRM, CRM, marketplaces, or other multi-sided platforms.
  • Familiarity with low-code builders such as Bubble.io, or an understanding of how design constraints change in them.
  • Experience with conversational interfaces or Slack app design.
  • Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS, React) or experience prototyping with AI coding tools.

WHAT WILL NOT WORK HERE

  • Waiting for a perfect brief or complete requirements before starting.
  • Handing off designs and disappearing before they ship.
  • Prioritizing visual polish over clarity and usability.
  • Treating AI as a chat box added to the corner of the screen.
  • Making design decisions without talking to users.

WHY JOIN US

  • Design a product with real complexity: two user types, deep workflows, and AI at the core.
  • Help shape how AI agents work inside B2B software, in a category that is still being defined.
  • Join the design team early and help shape how it works as it grows.
  • See your work in customers' hands quickly. We ship constantly.
  • Real traction: 600% YoY growth and enterprise customers.
  • Competitive salary and benefits.

We'd love to meet you.

The Opportunity

Praxis Precision Medicines is entering a pivotal moment as we prepare for commercialization, and how we build and scale capability across the organization will directly impact our success.

We are seeking driven and customer-focused Account Specialists to execute in the field and drive commercial performance across a defined territory. These individuals will be responsible for engaging healthcare providers, building strong customer relationships, and delivering on commercial objectives.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you will play a critical role in supporting product launches, driving adoption, and ensuring patients gain access to innovative therapies.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute territory business plans to achieve and exceed sales goals.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with healthcare providers and key stakeholders.
  • Drive product adoption through effective customer engagement and education.
  • Navigate complex patient pathways and support access to therapy.

  • Leverage insights from the field to inform strategy and improve execution.

How You Work

  • You hold a high bar for performance, quality, and accountability.
  • You collaborate deeply but act with ownership and urgency.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of direct sales experience in CNS or specialty pharmaceuticals.
  • Deep understanding of complex patient pathways and specialist prescriber dynamics.
  • Participation in a recent product launch highly preferred, including familiarity with pre-launch planning and early market execution.
  • Experience with formulary access strategies and early market penetration tactics.

Actionstep is a pioneer in the development and sale of software-as-a-service (SaaS) products, specializing in the delivery of Legal Practice Management software. We are a fast growing, dynamic business with a global customer base of more than 50,000 and a team of over 300 in the USA, Australia, UK, Canada and New Zealand.

THE PURPOSE OF YOUR ROLE

As a Product Manager, you will maintain assigned products, manage ongoing product planning, requirements, development of new features, functionality and integrations. The role is ultimately tasked with the delivery of unique value-based products based on customer insights. You will also take responsibility for the creation of a product vision and strategy, product governance and senior stakeholder communication.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

In this role, you will be accountable for…

- Build and launch successful products in a SaaS B2B software company, working directly with and influencing/inspiring enterprise customers, and serving multiple user and business personas.

- Build and bring to market AI-powered features and products, applying hands-on experience taking AI/ML-driven capabilities from concept through go-to-market.

- Own the delivery of the strategic product direction based on clear commercial rationale and robust insights.

- Coordinate feature launches, including orchestrating testing, documentation, training rollout sequencing, customer communication, and adoption measurement.

- Generate, gather, and organize ideas for features and improvements for the product, prioritize feature requests, and maintain part of the roadmap.

- Design product enhancements and communicate designs orally, through diagrams, and through appropriate product artifacts.

- Demonstrate success producing product management artifacts such as opportunity briefs, prioritized roadmaps, product specs, user stories, wireframes, and customer-facing docs.

-Achieve stretch goals in innovative and fast-paced cross functional teams.

- Understand technical elements and communicate them to those who don’t.

- Lead, motivate and develop engineering & design team members.

- Demonstrate strong leadership and proven ability to operate successfully in a collaborative, matrixed global organizational structure.

- Follow industry trends through exploring complementary products, meeting with partners, and investigating innovative technologies.

- Contribute to company-level product planning by developing concepts into specs, evaluating them, and participating as we expand on our strategic product roadmap.

- Work with product research to conduct data gathering, competitive reviews, customer analysis, market-sizing as required.

- Perform any other duties within the scope of the key responsibilities as directed.

Relationship Management:

- Build and maintain strong working relationships with all internal and external parties ensuring transparent, proactive and effective communication always.

- Attending and proactively contributing to customer, partner and internal meetings with the view to add value in a constructive manner.

- Lead and actively participate in customer discovery sessions, beta programs, and user research with legal professionals to deeply understand their workflows and pain points.

- Represent Actionstep at customer-facing events such as webinars and industry conferences, building relationships with legal professionals and translating their feedback into product improvements.

Professional Development:

Actively looking to build own career through delivery of self and assisted professional development initiatives.

Being a thought leader both within Actionstep but also in the wider industry.

Staying abreast of industry best practice patterns, products and technologies and assisting in process improvement activities as required.

Continuous Improvement:

Proactive in identifying and participating in the continuous improvement of processes and procedures within the Relevant Team department.

Actively contribute to the development and maintenance of a strong department culture ensuring knowledge and experience is shared.

Health & Safety:

- Assume responsibility for your own and others safety and wellbeing, following all safety and wellbeing procedures and instructions, including reporting hazards, incidents and accidents and participating in safety and wellbeing initiatives and programmes as required.

Other Responsibilities:

- Undertaking any other reasonable duties as required

Requirements

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

Essential:

- 5+ years of SaaS product management experience building enterprise products.

- Proven track record of successfully bringing products to market & delivering product features that are aligned with company goals and strategy.

- Proven ability to bring AI-powered products to market that go beyond generic AI features, with a real understanding of what makes an AI capability defensible and hard to copy.

- Expertise in driving product development processes using agile methodologies.

- Experience in product management tools such as Azure DevOps, Notion, Pendo, Miro.

- Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, experience working closely with design and UX teams, and proven ability to create exceptional user experiences.

- Strong track record of driving successful product launches within strict timelines.

- Ability to dig into business or technical problems and find pragmatic solutions.

- Strong project management skills; able to identify needs, break down objectives into key results & initiatives, deliver value continuously with short and long-term initiatives, and move multiple related & unrelated workstreams forward in parallel.

- A profound understanding of product lifecycle management, user experience design, and market analysis.

- Hands-on experience with product roadmap creation, stakeholder collaboration, leading cross-functional teams, and data-driven decision-making processes.

- Working experience in creating, prioritizing and recommending epics and features.

- Ability to work in a remote environment – travel will be part of the role to successfully engage with the team and participate in cross functional meetings/working sessions.

- Working knowledge of application performance and analytics.

- Experience researching, defining and documenting market, product and platform requirements.

- Strong understanding of customer needs, pain points, and experience with similar technologies.

- Track project progress and initiatives in alignment with the roadmap.

Desirable:

Personal Skills, Attributes & Behavioural Competencies:

- Great communication and interpersonalskills.

- Passionate about teamwork and collaboration.

Other:

Senior CDP Solutions Architect

Intelligent Marketing | Remote | Full-Time | EMEA

Who We Are: Front Office Transformation Experts

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.

What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office

We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.

The Role

BPX is hiring a Senior CDP Solutions Architect into our Intelligent Marketing practice. You will own the technical design of customer data platform programmes for enterprise clients — from data model and identity strategy through to segmentation, activation and journey orchestration. This is a hands-on architecture role, not a slide-deck one: you run discovery with client marketing, data and IT teams, define the target-state architecture, and stay close enough to the build to unblock engineers and prove the design works in production. Twilio Segment and Adobe Real-Time CDP are our primary platforms, with Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360) and adjacent tooling on a growing number of engagements. On every programme you lead, you are the client-facing technical authority.

What you'll do

  • Lead discovery and requirements workshops with client marketing, data and IT stakeholders, translating commercial goals into CDP use cases.
  • Design target-state CDP architecture: data models and schemas, ingestion patterns, identity resolution and profile strategy, consent and governance.
  • Architect and oversee integrations between the CDP and CRM, cloud data platforms, analytics, paid media and messaging systems.
  • Define segmentation and activation approaches across batch, streaming and edge, chosen on use case and data readiness rather than habit.
  • Design cross-channel journey orchestration and hand activation-ready audiences to campaign teams.
  • Stay hands-on — build proofs of concept, review engineering work, and clear technical blockers during delivery.
  • Own data quality, privacy and compliance standards, including GDPR and consent management, across every implementation.
  • Mentor CDP engineers and consultants, and contribute to BPX delivery accelerators, patterns and reusable assets.
  • Support pre-sales with scoping, estimation, solution shaping and technical credibility in client pitches.

What you'll bring

  • Certification in Twilio Segment CDP and Adobe Real-Time CDP — both are required for this role.
  • Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360) certification is a distinct advantage, as are certifications in other customer data or engagement platforms.
  • Seven or more years in martech or customer data, including at least three years architecting CDP implementations end to end.
  • Deep hands-on command of schema and data modelling, identity resolution, audience segmentation and activation at enterprise scale.
  • Strong SQL, plus working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure or AWS) and API-based integration.
  • Experience integrating CDPs with CRM and journey orchestration tooling such as Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze.
  • Practical grasp of GDPR, ePrivacy and consent management, including tools such as OneTrust.
  • Consulting or agency background — credible in front of clients, and able to hold an architecture conversation with marketers and engineers in the same room.
  • Evidence of leading or mentoring technical teams on enterprise delivery.
  • Fluent English and the right to work in an EMEA country where BPX operates.

Why this role, why now

Customer data is the constraint on nearly every front-office programme our clients run, and BPX's Intelligent Marketing practice is scaling to meet it. Segment and Adobe Real-Time CDP are the two fastest-moving lines in that book, with Salesforce Data 360 close behind. This role puts you at the design end of those programmes rather than in a ticket queue — you set the architecture, then watch it run at enterprise scale across 300 customers in 10 countries. If you want breadth across multiple CDPs instead of a single in-house stack, and room to shape how a growing practice delivers, this is that seat.

Right to Work. Applicants must have the right to work in the EMEA country in which they are based. {Bluprintx is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role} and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of nationality or immigration status.

Salary: £80,000-£105,000

The Learning Technology Administrator supports Marathon Health University by serving as the technical owner of the technology that enables our learning ecosystem. This role administers and optimizes the platforms, integrations, data, AI-enabled tools, and technical experiences that make learning accessible, connected, and easy to use for teammates.

The individual in this role brings demonstrated success implementing and administering enterprise learning platforms, with strong learning technology, project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills. This person understands both the technical requirements and the teammate experience needed to create a connected and effective learning ecosystem.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Learning Technology System Administration & Optimization

  • Serve as the primary administrator and technical owner of the enterprise learning technology ecosystem, including platforms, configuration, integrations, data, testing, technical learner experience, troubleshooting, and ongoing optimization.
  • Manage core platform functionality, including courses, learning pathways, academies, cohorts, assignments, certifications, assessments, user groups, permissions, and the learning catalog.
  • Maintain system and data integrity through administrative standards, documentation, SOPs, quality assurance, and effective management of user data and metadata.
  • Provide learner and administrator support, troubleshoot issues, and evaluate, test, and implement platform enhancements, releases, and third-party integrations in partnership with vendors and internal teams.

Learning Technology Implementation & Project Management

  • Lead learning technology implementation and enhancement initiatives from planning and requirements through configuration, integration, migration, testing, launch, adoption, stabilization, and ongoing optimization.
  • Develop and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, communications, and stakeholder readiness.
  • Coordinate cross-functional work across Organizational Development, vendors, content providers, and business stakeholders to deliver against project goals.
  • Identify risks and barriers, drive solutions and decisions, and support change management and end-user adoption through successful implementation.

Learning Content & Experience Support

  • Partner across the Organizational Development team and with key stakeholders to ensure learning technologies work together to create a connected, accessible Marathon Health University experience from onboarding through ongoing development.
  • Apply adult-learning and user-experience principles to improve how teammates discover, access, navigate, and engage with learning.
  • Provide technical consultation and guidance on effective use of the learning technology, content providers, authoring tools, and related learning technologies.
  • Identify and implement AI agents and AI-enabled workflows that improve learning operations, access to knowledge, and scalable learning solutions.

Learning Data, Reporting & Insights

  • Develop and maintain learning reports, dashboards, and analytics related to participation, completion, utilization, engagement, compliance, and learning effectiveness.
  • Analyze learning trends, system utilization, learner feedback, and KPIs to identify opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Establish reporting standards and ensure learning data is accurate, accessible, meaningful, and consistently maintained.
  • Strengthen manager and administrator self-service through dashboards, learner records, reporting tools, and training while supporting required-learning and compliance reporting.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Instructional Technology, Learning & Development, Education, Business, Information Systems, or related field and 5+ years of experience administering enterprise learning management systems or learning technology platforms or equivalent combination of education and experience.

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

  • Demonstrated success implementing, migrating, or significantly transforming an enterprise Learning Technology required.
  • Hands-on 360Learning implementation and administration experience highly preferred, including platform configuration, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
  • Demonstrated experience with Learning Technology configuration, user management, learning pathways, reporting, integrations, content administration, testing, and troubleshooting required.
  • Experience building or configuring AI agents, workflows, or AI-enabled solutions preferred.
  • Demonstrated project management experience leading complex, cross-functional learning technology initiatives from planning through implementation.
  • Experience with learning analytics, dashboards, reporting, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience with eLearning authoring tools and digital content platforms, such as Articulate 360, preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and experience using Microsoft Copilot or similar generative AI tools required.
  • Exceptional project management and execution skills, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans, milestones, owners, and deliverables.
  • Strong learning-technology mindset with an understanding of both the learner experience and technical requirements.
  • Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills with the ability to simplify complex processes and identify scalable solutions.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to independently manage competing priorities, solve problems, and drive work to completion in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and broader business and learning objectives.
  • Curiosity and continuous-learning mindset with an interest in AI and emerging learning technologies.
  • Strong commitment to internal customer service and creating intuitive, high-quality teammate experiences.

Pay Range: $70,000 - $85,000/yr

The actual offer may vary dependent upon geographic location and the candidate’s years of experience and/or skill level.

We are accepting applications for this position until a candidate has been selected. To apply to this position and learn more about open jobs at Marathon Health, visit our careers page.

Success looks like accurate, engaging content that serves readers, maintains Money’s editorial standards, supports business objectives, and performs well across traditional search and AI-powered discovery platforms.

  • Edit articles, guides, and other personal finance content for clarity, accuracy, tone, and adherence to Money’s editorial standards and sponsor objectives.

DTC Canada is a specialized digital transformation strategy and software implementation company that helps small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) achieve digital maturity. Our client-centric approach, supported by a team of experts, ensures we consistently deliver results that spur growth and innovation.

Technical Business Analyst - Software Implementation and Development

The Technical Business Analyst - Software Implementation and Development is responsible for successfully implementing and customizing software solutions based on client needs. This role involves collaborating closely with clients, developers, and project managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions while ensuring smooth deployments. Key responsibilities include configuring and developing functionalities for software platforms like Odoo, Zoho, and Microsoft Dynamics. The ideal candidate has strong analytical, technical, and communication skills, with a solid grasp of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and business process re-engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Stakeholder Liaison: Serve as the main contact between clients, developers, and project managers to ensure alignment.
  • Business Process Re-engineering: Recommend workflow improvements that align with the software's capabilities.
  • Data Migration & Integration: Lead data migration and system integration efforts, ensuring seamless transitions.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Develop test cases, oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and ensure alignment with client goals.
  • Training & Support: Create training materials and conduct sessions to ensure user proficiency.
  • Project Monitoring: Help manage project scope, timelines, and risks, reporting progress regularly.

À propos de DTC Canada
DTC Canada est une firme spécialisée dans les stratégies de transformation numérique pour les PME. Nos services incluent des évaluations de maturité numérique, des feuilles de route stratégiques, et l’implémentation de solutions ERP, CRM, SIRH, et eCommerce. Nous offrons également des solutions de sécurité des données et des formations pour assurer une transition fluide. En travaillant étroitement avec nos clients, nous proposons des solutions personnalisées pour accélérer leur transformation numérique.

Preferred Skills

Position: Full Stack Senior Marketer

Salary: Up to $2,700 AUD per month

Working Hours & Conditions: Australian Hours

Holidays: Public holidays in AU

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly capable Senior Full Stack Marketing Manager to own the company's marketing function across both the commercial and charitable brands.

This is not a specialist role focused solely on social media, paid advertising, or content creation. Instead, we are looking for a commercially minded marketing generalist who understands how every component of a marketing system connects—from brand positioning and messaging through to lead generation, CRM automation, reporting, and revenue growth.

The successful candidate will become the internal marketing leader, responsible for designing, executing, measuring, and continually improving the company's end-to-end marketing ecosystem. They will also be expected to champion the practical use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across the marketing function—using AI to improve efficiency, automate workflows, generate reporting and presentations, connect business systems, and enhance decision-making. AI should be viewed as a productivity multiplier rather than simply a content creation tool.

This role requires someone who thinks strategically, enjoys solving commercial problems, and is confident challenging ideas and contributing to business discussions. We value curiosity, critical thinking, and the ability to connect marketing activity directly to business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Commercial Growth (Primary Focus)

  • Own the end-to-end marketing strategy across both the company and its charitable division
  • Develop integrated marketing campaigns aligned with commercial objectives
  • Build full-funnel marketing strategies that generate awareness, enquiries, and conversions
  • Analyse the customer journey, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements
  • Work closely with leadership to ensure marketing supports broader business strategy
  • Regularly review campaign performance and adapt strategy based on data and insights

CRM & Marketing Automation

  • Become the company's subject matter expert in GoHighLevel
  • Design and manage the complete customer journey within the CRM
  • Build lead nurturing sequences and automated marketing workflows
  • Improve lead management and conversion processes
  • Ensure accurate reporting across the marketing and sales pipeline
  • Continuously optimise automation and customer communication
  • Utilise AI tools to automate repetitive marketing and administrative workflows
  • Develop AI-assisted reporting, presentations, campaign analysis, and marketing documentation
  • Build connections between AI platforms (such as Claude) and business systems where appropriate to improve operational efficiency
  • Continually identify opportunities to streamline processes and reduce manual work through AI and automation

Digital Marketing

  • Manage and optimise Google Ads and Meta advertising campaigns
  • Recommend marketing investment based on commercial performance
  • Oversee SEO strategy and ongoing website optimisation
  • Coordinate email marketing campaigns and customer communications
  • Monitor campaign performance and maximise return on investment

Website & Content Management

  • Oversee website development and ongoing optimisation
  • Create landing pages and lead generation assets
  • Develop compelling website copy and customer messaging
  • Ensure content clearly communicates the company's value proposition
  • Improve website conversion rates through continuous testing

Content & Brand Development

  • Coordinate content creation across multiple channels
  • Work with leadership to develop educational content, customer stories, and brand messaging
  • Support podcast launches, campaign rollouts, partnership opportunities, and events
  • Maintain consistent brand positioning across all customer touchpoints

Reporting & Business Intelligence

  • Develop meaningful marketing dashboards and reporting
  • Track lead generation, campaign performance, conversion rates, and ROI
  • Present marketing insights and recommendations to leadership
  • Use data to recommend continuous improvements across all marketing activities
  • Translate marketing data into commercial actions

What You'll Deliver in Your First 90 Days

  • Become proficient in the company's marketing systems, including GoHighLevel
  • Develop a clear understanding of the entire customer acquisition funnel
  • Identify major bottlenecks and recommend improvements across marketing and lead generation
  • Launch or optimise Google and Meta advertising campaigns
  • Support the launch of the new charitable website
  • Build marketing reporting dashboards that provide meaningful commercial insights
  • Develop a pipeline of partnership and promotional opportunities
  • Establish a structured marketing roadmap for future growth

Tools & Systems

  • GoHighLevel CRM (primary platform)
  • Google Ads
  • Meta Business Suite
  • Google Analytics & Search Console
  • AI platforms including Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other productivity tools
  • Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace
  • Marketing reporting and analytics platforms

Requirements

  • Proven experience owning the marketing function within a growing business
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end marketing strategy and customer acquisition
  • Experience building and optimising complete marketing funnels
  • Commercial mindset with an ability to connect marketing activity to business growth
  • Strong analytical and reporting capability
  • Excellent written English and copywriting skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Reporting Analyst to focus on the development of our Power BI reporting environment. The Reporting Analyst will be responsible for creating impactful dashboards and reports which deliver meaningful data to our business leaders to achieve organizational goals. This role will do more than compile tabular data; this role will have an opportunity to use data to tell a story, and help our team, as well as business leaders, derive meaningful insights. This role will support various facets of the company including sales, HR, and Finance.

The right candidate will have a strong background with Power BI. They will be detail oriented, with the ability to infer business needs and develop reporting solutions using data visualization best practices including leveraging Gestalt principles, Storytelling with Data, and visualization selection principals. They will proactively run data quality checks to ensure the integrity of the information being delivered. Self-motivated with an eagerness to learn, becoming a subject matter expert to coincide with technical fluency. Stays abreast of the latest Power BI features and identifies the right opportunities for implementation.

Report Development (50%)

  • Migrate existing reporting inventory to a centralized semantic model
  • Automate/streamline manual processes

Data Monitoring and Diagnostics (20%)

  • Monitor reports for data discrepancies and issues through use of Power BI and SQL
  • Address, diagnose, and resolve reporting issues identified by business partners

Semantic Model Support (10%)

  • Propose changes and enhancements to established semantic models to support new reporting, or improve existing reporting
  • Implement minor changes to semantic models as needed

Report Maintenance (10%)

  • Make minor changes and updates to existing reports as needed

Documentation (5%)

  • Document report development processes for business contingency purposes
  • Maintain semantic model documentation, including data sources and table relationships
  • Maintain an index of all active reports, including data lineage, purpose, and audience
  • Maintain reporting changelog

Team Support & Other Duties (5%)

  • Provide backfill support for ongoing team work as needed

Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in a data or business intelligence focused role
  • 3+ years creating BI dashboards and reports with a focus on data visualization and storytelling with a high proficiency using Power BI
  • 3+ years writing SQL queries for data mining
  • 3+ years’ experience collecting and documenting business requirements

This opportunity is fully remote with the option to work from our offices in San Diego, CA, Irvine, CA, or Omaha, NE for those who prefer an office environment. You will be joining a dynamic, fully remote team which is distributed across time zones.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without the need for sponsorship.

About the role, as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer you’ll work on AI-based features (GenAI, Agentic AI, RAG, etc.) search/ranking quality, and knowledge graph aware retrieval while enforcing content rights and editorial confidentiality.

ML & LLM Engineering, Search and Recommendation Engines

  • Design and implement ML pipelines that utilize Elasticsearch/OpenSearch/Solr, vector DBs, and graph DBs .
  • Build evaluation pipelines: offline IR metrics (NDCG, MAP, MRR), LLM quality metrics (faithfulness, grounding), and A/B testing.
  • Optimize infrastructure costs through monitoring, scaling strategies, and efficient resource utilization.
  • Stay current with the latest GAI research, NLP and RAG and apply the state-of-the-art in our experiments and systems.

Collaboration

  • Partner with Subject-Matter Experts, Product Managers, Data Scientists and Responsible AI experts to translate business problems into cutting edge data science solutions
  • Collaborate and interface with Operations Engineers who deploy and run production infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Current experience in ML Engineering, MLOps platforms, shipping ML or search/GenAI systems to production.
  • Strong Python, Java, and/or Scala experience will be considered a plus.
  • Hands-on‑ experience with major cloud vendor solutions (AWS, Azure and/or Google)
  • Experience with Search/vector/graph technologies (e.g., Elasticsearch / OpenSearch / Solr / Neo4j).
  • Experience in evaluating LLM models.
  • A strong understanding of the Data Science Life Cycle including feature engineering, model training, and evaluation metrics.
  • Background in health technology and/or medical content workflows is preferred.
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks, e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, PySpark.

Introductie

Ben jij een gediplomeerd verpleegkundige met oog voor kwaliteit, processen en samenwerking? Zoek je een veelzijdige functie waarin je farmaceutische zorg combineert met coördinatie, innovatie en digitale zorg? Dan is deze rol bij Wellis Pharmacy iets voor jou!

In deze functie werk je volledig remote (of hybride indien mogelijk), in een digitaal team dat farmaceutische zorg verleent aan cliënten door heel Nederland.

Over Wellis

Wellis is een snelgroeiende healthtech scale-up die één van de meest traditionele sectoren opnieuw uitvindt: de apotheek. Wat nog maar kort geleden begon, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een winstgevend Europees bedrijf met tienduizenden klanten — en we staan pas aan het begin.

Door medische expertise te combineren met technologie en data maken we de zorg slimmer, efficiënter en persoonlijker. We richten ons op thema’s zoals gewichtsbeheersing, leefstijlbegeleiding en medicatie op maat.

Bij Wellis sluit je je aan bij een gedreven, ambitieus team dat snel schakelt, conventies doorbreekt en bouwt met impact. We creëren een omgeving waar professionals zich thuis voelen: met korte communicatielijnen, veel eigenaarschap en de energie van een organisatie die hard groeit.

Over de rol

Als verpleegkundige ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen cliënten, apothekers en het logistieke team. Je zorgt dat alles soepel verloopt: van intake tot medicatieverstrekking. Je combineert klantgericht contact met procesmatig inzicht en kwaliteitsbewust werken — volledig digitaal.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Cliëntcontact & farmaceutische zorg: uitvoeren van telefonische intakes, beantwoorden van vragen via telefoon, e-mail en chat.

  • Dossierbeheer: controleren en aanvullen van cliëntendossiers, bewaken van medicatieveiligheid en signaleren van bijzonderheden.

  • Samenwerking met apothekers: afstemmen over recepten en afwijkingen, zorgen voor correcte documentatie volgens wet- en regelgeving.

  • Procescoördinatie: ondersteunen van de logistieke processen op afstand en meedenken over verbeteringen in workflow en kwaliteit.

  • Kwaliteitsbewaking: bijdragen aan het borgen van procedures en meewerken aan optimalisatie van digitale zorgprocessen.

Requirements

Wie ben jij

  • Diploma MBO-4 verpleegkunde met BIG-registratie.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als verpleegkundige.

  • Affiniteit met digitale zorg en ervaring met werken in online systemen.

  • Communicatief sterk, klantgericht en nauwkeurig.

  • Vloeiend Nederlands en goed Engels - Duits is een grote pré

  • Zelfstandig, verantwoordelijk en organisatorisch sterk.

  • Proactief en in staat om verbeteringen aan te dragen.

  • Beschikbaar voor minimaal 24 uur/week. (op dit moment hebben we mensen nodig die ‘s avonds en in het weekend beschikbaar zijn)

Wat bieden wij

  • Een volledig remote functie met veel autonomie en flexibiliteit.

  • Marktconform salaris volgens CAO Apotheken, inclusief pensioen.

  • Flexibele werktijden tussen 07:00 en 23:00 uur (maandag t/m zaterdag). Mogelijkheid om op zondag te werken (indien je ook op zaterdag werkt)

  • Werken binnen een enthousiast en deskundig team dat digitale zorg vormgeeft.

  • Ruimte voor professionele ontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei.

  • De mogelijkheid tot volledig flexibel remote werken, zodat werk en privé in balans blijven; (Het is trouwens een pré als je 1 of 2 dagen op kantoor in Hapert kan werken!)

  • De mogelijkheid om meer te werken en vrije tijd op te bouwen of uit te laten keren;

  • Meerdere leuke teamuitjes;

  • Hele leuke collega's :)

Hiring Proces

  • Sollicitatie – Stuur je CV en motivatie via onze website.

  • Kennismaking – Kort online gesprek met HR om jouw ervaring en motivatie te bespreken.

  • Inhoudelijk gesprek – Met onze apotheker en coördinator over de inhoud van de functie.

  • Finale kennismaking – Met het management, om te kijken of er een goede match is.

Als je vragen hebt, neem contact op met

Highlights

Een veelzijdige, volledig remote rol waarin je jouw kennis combineert met digitale zorg en procescoördinatie — met ruimte om door te groeien in een snelgroeiende organisatie.

Regional Sales Director - Americas

Full time, US remote, with travel

Role Purpose

Luna Innovations is the global leader in distributed fibre-optic sensing: no one else matches the breadth and depth of our portfolio. Our market position, combined with the timing and direction of the market, means we are currently facing a significant growth opportunity.

The Regional Sales Director reports directly to the VP Sales & Marketing, Sensing Business Unit, and holds full commercial responsibility for Luna's sensing business across their region. This is a role for a builder. Beyond running the regional sales effort, the Director will bring the teams closer together into one, define the regional go-to-market plan, and put in place the team, territory and channel structure needed to win and grow efficiently. The core responsibility of the role is to grow revenue across the region, and build the regional organisation able to consistently deliver results.

Key Responsibilities

1. Grow revenue

  • Lead the team to win new business and grow existing accounts, personally leading from the front on key accounts and opportunities.
  • Build key-account capability across high-priority accounts, cross-selling the full portfolio to maximise revenue potential.
  • Partner with the Regional Operations Director to ensure proposals and customer commitments are deliverable.

2. Build, integrate and develop the team

  • Rapidly build a regional sales organisation, integrating previously siloed teams into one team with shared objectives.
  • Assess capability and potential objectively, and make sure the right people are in the right roles.
  • Coach and develop a high-performing team, leading by example and setting a standard of customer obsession and accountability.

3. Lead the region commercially

  • Carry full responsibility for sales performance across the region: revenue, margin, pipeline and forecast accuracy.
  • Own a clear, prioritised view of the region and translate Business Unit strategy into a regional plan with measurable targets.
  • Run a disciplined operating rhythm covering pipeline, forecasting, deal qualification and review, so that what we commit, we deliver.

4. Own the regional go-to-market plan

  • Own the regional go-to-market plan against which sales coverage is designed and deployed, and against which regional investment and divestment decisions are made.
  • Design territories by geography and end-user market to deploy sales-manager resource aligned to where the opportunity sits.
  • Build a regional partner ecosystem to scale an indirect channel and extend reach efficiently where direct coverage is not justified.

5. Contribute as a member of the Sales Leadership team

  • Help shape Business Unit commercial strategy as a member of the Sales Leadership team.
  • Feed regional customer, competitor and market intelligence back into product, marketing and Business Unit leadership, where it directly informs investment and roadmap priorities.
  • Resolve issues at the level they arise, and help build a culture of direct, accountable problem-solving.
  • Represent Luna credibly at customer, partner and industry level, including at conferences, exhibitions and customer events.

Candidate Profile

Qualifications

  • A technical degree in a relevant field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Business-fluent English is essential. Additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.
  • Digitally fluent with strong CRM and sales-tooling skills; quick to adopt new technologies and to apply AI in innovative ways to improve productivity.

Key Competencies

  • Technical aptitude.Able to learn fast and engage credibly with deep-tech solutions and technical customers.
  • High IQ and EQ.Strong analytical and strategic horsepower, matched by genuine emotional intelligence and the ability to read and lead people.
  • Strategic thinker and exceptional operator.Can set direction and then make it happen in the detail.
  • Outstanding leader of people.A track record of building, integrating and developing high-performing commercial teams.
  • High integrity.Does the right thing, especially when it is hard or unseen.
  • Self-starter.High agency and high ownership; does not wait to be told.
  • Willing to “get their hands dirty”.Leads by example and gets into the trenches alongside their people. This is a build role, not a purely strategic one.

Experience and background

  • Commercial leadership.Demonstrable success leading sales in a technical or industrial B2B environment, including building and integrating teams.
  • Selling complex solutions.Experience selling complex technical solutions to enterprise and infrastructure customers, including framework and strategic account agreements.
  • Channel and partner development.Experience building and managing indirect channels (agents, resellers, service partners) to extend coverage.
  • Go-to-market and territory design.Has owned go-to-market planning, territory design and sales-coverage decisions, ideally tied to investment cases.
  • Regional knowledge.Knowledge of the assigned region and its key end-user markets, with an existing network a strong advantage.

Domain knowledge (preferred, not essential)

  • Fibre-optic / distributed sensing experience is preferable but not essential.
  • Experience in any of our served markets is an advantage but not essential: oil and gas, energy, power and utilities, telecoms and data centres, transport and infrastructure, mining, security, or defence.
  • Familiarity with one or more of our application areas (subsurface imaging, production monitoring, pipeline integrity and security, power-cable monitoring) is helpful but not essential.

Travel

Approximately 50% travel within the assigned region.

•DoD or Army authorization experience.

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Care Manager – Innovations Waiver (IW) to join our Care Management Team! The Care Manager - IW is responsible for providing complex care coordination and monitoring to members having a primary Intellectual or Developmental Disability, which may include secondary mental health or substance abuse, and/or complex medical/physical health needs. This position requires a dynamic, proactive approach to assessment, monitoring, and complex coordination of care, to ensure quality support and consistent adherence to waiver requirements. Care Manager - IW assists with integrated care management through multi-disciplinary collaboration and referrals. This position has a primary focus on members who have Intellectual Developmental Disability, serving both children, adolescents, and adults.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Utilize person centered planning methods/strategies to gather information, to get to know the members supported and to adequately address specific needs of the individual.
  • Provide education and support to members in learning about and exercising rights and responsibilities.
  • Consistently complete Discovery activities (information gathering and assessment) as a component of the planning process.
  • Ensure that members/legally responsible people are informed of services available (all types of Medicaid and state-funded services), service options available (e.g. Individual/Family Direction for Innovations participants), processes (e.g. requirements for specific service), Natural and community services, and so forth.
  • Assist members/legally responsible people in choosing service providers, ensuring objectivity in the process.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must meet QP status.
  1. Fully licensed by the NC governing board regulating Human Services professions; OR Fully licensed RN who is licensed to practice in the state of NC by the NC Board of Nursing who also has four (4) years of full-time experience with the MH/DD/SA population served. OR
  2. A graduate of a college or university with a Master’s degree in a human service field and has one year of full-time, pre or post-graduate degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has one year of full-time, pre or postgraduate degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  3. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a human service field and has two years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has two years of full-time, pre or post bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  4. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a field other than human services and has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling.
  • Additionally, If serving members with LTSS needs, the care manager, must meet the minimum QP requirements defined above (A-D) and shall additionally have at a minimum two (2) years of prior LTSS and/or HCBS coordination, care delivery monitoring and care management experience. This experience may be concurrent with the years of experience required to become a Qualified Professional.
  • License and/or certification may be accepted as noted above.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside in North Carolina and within 75 miles Trillium’s South Central Region, specifically Pender County.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree in human services.
  • Experience with the Innovation Waiver or IDD population and writing person-centered plans.

Deadline for Application:October 12, 2026 at 11:59 PM

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.
