Brooks & Berne is a minority-owned insurance defense firm where diversity is key. We pride ourselves on providing each of our clients with aggressive, proactive representation. Our trial attorneys are fearless, and we allow our clients to reach the best possible results in a cost-effective way. We do not wait for things to happen – we make them happen. Our team has years of experience handling premises liability, motor vehicle accidents, professional liability, construction/workplace accidents and suits brought under New York’s Labor Law. No matter how complex the case, we are ready to ensure every client the best possible representation.

WHAT SETS US APART
• Mentorship-Focused: We’re a teaching firm at heart. Our partners are deeply committed to developing junior attorneys through active mentorship, collaboration, and ongoing feedback. Attorneys are challenged and supported to grow.
• Supportive Team-First Culture: We believe great work comes from a strong team. Our firm hosts annual partner retreats, employee appreciation events, and regularly attends industry conferences and networking events with our attorneys. You’ll be a part of a community that values people as much as performance.
• Growth & Stability: Our firm has deep client relationships that provide consistent, interesting work. Attorneys are given space to develop lasting careers here with real paths to advancement and partnership for those that desire it.

THE POSITION:
Our firm is seeking to hire talented Litigation Associates across all experience levels to our established and growing Insurance Defense Practice in New York. Associates will work closely with experienced partners while maintaining appropriate autonomy based on their level of experience. This is an excellent opportunity for attorneys looking to further develop their litigation skills within a collaborative and supportive environment

We represent major insurance carriers and their insureds in a broad range of liability and personal injury matters. The role involves handling general liability and personal injury claims, including premises liability, motor vehicle accidents, and New York Labor Law matters (Construction §§ 240 and 241(6)). Responsibilities and case complexity will align with the candidate’s experience level.

Experience:
  • Litigation experience in personal injury, general liability, and/or insurance defense matters
  • Prior experience representing insurance carriers or working within an insurance defense firm
PREFERRED SKILLS:
  • Strong legal research, writing, and analytical skills
  • Ability to manage a caseload with increasing independence based on experience level
  • Experience with court appearances, depositions, and motion practice
  • Familiarity with billing practices and adherence to client guidelines
  • Trial exposure (second-chair or first-chair experience welcomed)
  • Professional judgment, strong work ethic, and attention to detail
  • Commitment to delivering high-quality legal representation

raw.description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

The Opportunity

We're hiring Licensed Mental Health Therapists (LCSW, LPC, LMHC) to provide therapy for autistic and neurodivergent adults via telehealth. You'll join a team dedicated to creating affirming, accessible mental health services for the neurodivergent community.

Our clinicians come from diverse backgrounds and career stages - whether you're passionate about neurodiversity advocacy, seeking flexibility and better work-life balance, or looking to add specialized experience to your existing practice, we offer roles to match your professional goals.

Why Therapists Choose Prosper:

  • Focus on what matters most: Provide exceptional client care while we manage administrative tasks, insurance billing, and client acquisition
  • Enjoy scheduling flexibility: Design your work schedule to accommodate personal needs and maintain optimal work-life balance
  • Scale your practice quickly: Build your caseload with steady client referrals during your first few weeks, with most clinicians reaching their ideal caseload within 4-6 weeks
  • No-show and late cancellation reimbursement: Receive 50% reimbursement for late cancellations and no-shows
  • Grow professionally: Access regular peer consultation, specialized training, and monthly case conferences
  • Neurodiversity-affirming environment: Work alongside clinicians who share your commitment to neurodiversity-affirming approaches
  • Connect with a supportive clinical community: Join weekly drop-ins and engage in a tight-knit clinical community that prevent isolation

We offer two distinct position types to accommodate different career needs and scheduling preferences

Scheduling Availability

  • Set your own schedule, 7 days a week, between 7am and 10pm
  • No required evening, weekend or on-call hours
  • Build your schedule around your life, not the other way around

Full time (Benefits-Eligible)

  • Hours: Provide 25+ hours of weekly availability to build a caseload of 25+ clients
  • Ideal for: Those who seek steady, predictable income that grows with your client base
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly rate paid per session
  • Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package including Medical/Dental/Vision coverage, 401(k) retirement plan and PTO.

Part-Time Position

  • Hours: Provide 15+ hours of weekly availability to build a caseload of 15+ clients
  • Ideal For: Practitioners with existing commitments who want to diversify their practice or add specialized neurodiversity experience to your clinical portfolio
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly rate paid per session

Who We're Looking For:

Qualifications:

  • Licensed independent mental health professional (LCSW, LPC, LMHC)
  • Strong clinical skills in evidence-based modalities such as CBT, DBT or ACT
  • Interest in working with autistic or neurodivergent adults
  • Comfort with technology and virtual care platforms (Zoom, EHR, Slack)
  • Excellent communication skills and commitment to client-centered care
  • Telehealth experience preferred but not required

You'll Thrive Here If:

  • You identify with our mission to support the neurodivergent community
  • You're seeking better work-life balance without sacrificing meaningful clinical work
  • You're transitioning from a demanding in-person setting and want more flexibility
  • You want to maintain multiple practice settings and add specialized experience
  • You're passionate about providing affirming care to traditionally underserved populations

Compensation:

Our transparent model means your income grows with your client relationships. Unlike traditional salary models, our fee-for-service approach rewards you directly for the sessions you provide. The more sessions you complete, the more your practice thrives – with the security of guaranteed income during no-shows and cancellations. We pay between $X - $X per session.

Join Our Team

Ready to transform lives while advancing your career? Apply today to join Prosper Health's team of dedicated professionals making a real difference for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Prosper Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those who identify as neurodivergent, LGBTQ+, or BIPOC.

Competitive W2 rate paid per session. 50% reimbursement for late cancellations/no shows. Paid every 2 weeks for the sessions you provide, no waiting for payment or reimbursement. Benefit Eligible roles available that include Medical/Dental/Vision/401k/PTO

W2 Per Session Rate
$55—$60 USD

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

  • Takes Initiative - Takes prompt action to accomplish goals and achieve results beyond what is required; is proactive and pursues relentlessly.

Revenue Cycle Management experience within a healthcare environment

- Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.

- This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

Desired Education

Bachelors Degree or Equivalent Experience

Other Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

raw.description:
Position: OFF-THE-PLAN CONVEYANCING SPECIALIST

Salary range: Php 87,000/month (The final amount will be at the the client discretion basing on the candidate’s skills and experience.)

Working Hours: Following AU business hours

Work set-up: 100% Remote work under Independent Contractor Agreement

Holidays: TBD

Recruitment process: possible multiple client interviews and an assessment

About the Company & Role

Our client is an established Australian property services firm that supports clients through important residential and commercial property transactions, with a strong focus on providing accurate, practical, and client-focused conveyancing support. The team works closely with property purchasers and a range of professionals involved in property transactions, including developers, solicitors, brokers, and selling agents. We are looking for an experienced Off-the-Plan Conveyancing Specialist to join the team and provide specialist contract review and risk assessment support for Queensland property purchasers. The role is responsible for reviewing off-the-plan contracts and related developer documentation before signing, identifying potential legal, financial, and property-related risks, and presenting findings in clear and practical language. The successful candidate will combine strong Australian conveyancing knowledge with excellent attention to detail, contract interpretation, written communication, and stakeholder management skills to help clients make informed decisions before committing to a property purchase.

What You'll Do

  • Review residential and commercial off-the-plan property contracts before they are signed.
  • Review contracts alongside relevant supporting documentation, including:
    • Disclosure statements
    • Disclosure plans
    • Proposed survey plans
    • Specifications and finishes schedules
    • Proposed by-laws
    • Developer documentation
    • Other relevant property and contractual documents
  • Identify and assess key contractual, legal, financial, and property-related risks from the purchaser's perspective.
  • Review provisions relating to:
    • Sunset dates and termination rights
    • Developer termination provisions
    • Settlement and registration timeframes
    • Changes to lot size, area, boundaries, or layout
    • Material changes and potential material prejudice
    • Deposit requirements and trust arrangements
    • Finance and valuation risks
    • Body corporate and community-title arrangements
    • By-laws and management rights
    • Easements, encumbrances, covenants, and restrictions
    • Adjustment provisions
    • Default, rescission, and termination provisions
    • Developer-favourable special conditions
    • Assignment and resale restrictions
    • Construction delays and extension provisions
    • Defects and practical completion provisions
  • Assess whether contractual terms are consistent with the purchaser's intended use, financing arrangements, and investment objectives.
  • Prepare clear and structured contract review reports highlighting key risks, important considerations, and matters requiring client instructions.
  • Explain complex contractual and property matters in plain English to clients and stakeholders.
  • Provide recommendations on amendments, protections, clarifications, or other matters that should be addressed before signing.
  • Assist with negotiating special conditions and contractual amendments with the developer's solicitor where appropriate.
  • Review subsequent contract amendments, variations, and updated disclosure documentation throughout the development.
  • Liaise with purchasers, developers, developer solicitors, selling agents, brokers, financial advisers, and other relevant professionals.
  • Maintain accurate records of contract reviews, client instructions, negotiations, and amendments.
  • Provide a clear handover to the conveyancing team once the contract has been signed.
  • Support the broader conveyancing team with specialist contract and property-related matters as required.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in Australian conveyancing, property law, or property contract review.
  • Strong experience reviewing off-the-plan property contracts and associated documentation.
  • Solid understanding of Queensland property and conveyancing practices.
  • Strong ability to identify contractual risks and explain their potential impact on purchasers.
  • Experience interpreting complex contracts and identifying developer-favourable terms or special conditions.
  • Strong written English and the ability to prepare clear, professional, client-facing reports.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing multiple documents and identifying inconsistencies.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a wider conveyancing or legal team.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple contract reviews and deadlines.
  • High level of confidentiality and professionalism when handling client and transaction information.

Nice to Have

  • Legal, paralegal, conveyancing, property, or related qualification.
  • Previous experience working with an Australian conveyancing or law firm.
  • Direct experience with Queensland property transactions.
  • Experience handling off-the-plan residential or commercial purchases.
  • Experience reviewing developer contracts and disclosure documentation.
  • Experience negotiating special conditions or amendments with solicitors.
  • Familiarity with body corporate, community-title arrangements, easements, covenants, and other property encumbrances.
  • Experience communicating directly with Australian property purchasers.

Key Skills & Expertise

  • Australian Conveyancing
  • Queensland Property
  • Off-the-Plan Contracts
  • Property Contract Review
  • Contract Interpretation
  • Legal Risk Assessment
  • Property Law
  • Contract Negotiation
  • Client Advisory
  • Legal Research
  • Report Writing
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Attention to Detail

raw.description:
At gFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we’re growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong.

The application window will be open until at least May 18, 2026. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Role Description

In the Network Acquisition Manager role you will use strategic negotiation to secure leased network infrastructure for gFiber’s production network. You will work closely with local market and network engineering teams to source and implement leased data center, bandwidth, and dark fiber solutions across North America. Collaborate and partner with legal to deliver innovative contracts that support long term business partnerships.

Using your leadership and technical expertise, you will manage projects of various size and complexity, identify future opportunities, improve processes and drive the technical direction of your programs. You will work with internal stakeholders to ensure that projects are scoped properly and handed off seamlessly for overall vendor delivery and network deployment. You will also utilize technical judgment to overcome design challenges and manage escalations when infrastructure delivery is at risk.

In this role, you'll:

  • Negotiate and acquire Transport, Transit, Caching, and Private LAN services serving as the strategic vendor lead to drive commercial agreements and ensure effective, resilient network capacity delivery.
  • Develop and grow relationships with commercial partners including telecommunications companies, network carriers and colocation operators for the purpose of managing leased asset acquisition.
  • Negotiate and implement new commercial agreements that allow for predictable, efficient delivery of 3rd party assets to meet gFiber’s business needs. You will also draft and execute new orders with incumbent providers under existing agreements.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to identify capacity requirements & craft resilient leased infrastructure solutions, including the preparation of infrastructure drawings, SOW’s and other materials which clearly define the technical scope.
  • Identify, evaluate and acquire metro dark fiber assets and bandwidth services. In some cases, you may need to design and build a new infrastructure solution through joint projects.

At a minimum we'd like you to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Law or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of program management experience managing networking projects with cross-functional teams.
  • 5 years of experience developing and managing network infrastructure programs, including experience in vendor management, contract negotiation and acquisition of network infrastructure assets including dark fiber, bandwidth, and colocation space and power.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time domestically.

It's preferred if you have:

  • 8 years of experience with fiber network deployments and constructing new outside plant and inside plant fiber infrastructure.
  • 5 years experience with strategic negotiations or business development in obtaining services from high-technology providers in collocation, data centers, internet transit, network transport, telecom or IT services.
  • 3 years of experience with space and power build-outs in data centers or third-party colocation facilities, outside plant infrastructure, designing power distribution (AC and/or DC), or working in a data center design or operations role.
  • Ability to think "outside the box" and come up with commercially and technically creative solutions and comfort working independently and thinking dynamically, while still leading cross-functional efforts.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is between $121,800 - $196,400 + bonus + benefits. As pay varies by location, your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring process.

raw.description:
Director, Sales

Location: Remote (Midwest Region)

(Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, Missouri)

ABOUT ANET

Achievement Network (ANet) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping all students achieve strong educational outcomes. We partner with school and system leaders to strengthen teaching and learning through the strategic use of assessments, coaching, and tools that drive meaningful results. Individuals who join ANet become part of a dynamic, mission-driven, and collaborative organization focused on making a lasting impact in schools. We are committed to supporting one another and growing together as a team.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Reporting to the Managing Director, Sales, the Director, Sales will expand ANet’s impact across the Midwest Region by cultivating a strong, diverse community of school partners and education champions. In close collaboration with the Senior Vice President, Sales, you’ll drive ambitious growth goals by identifying and pursuing high-leverage opportunities through thoughtful research, strategic outreach, and a deep understanding of local instructional priorities and leadership dynamics.

You will exercise strong judgment and influence across the region by tailoring communication to diverse audiences, framing decisions, and guiding districts toward high-impact, equity-centered assessment practices.

Precision and discipline will be key: tracking outreach efforts, prioritizing prospects, and maintaining clean, actionable data to ensure no opportunity is missed. Ultimately, you’ll play a critical role in securing new partnerships that deepen ANet’s impact across the region.

TRAVEL

Travel is expected to be 50-75% depending on business needs, and will be primarily in the Midwest region. Some weekend travel and overnight stays expected for conferences.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Opportunity Identification & Lead Generation

  • Meet pre-set revenue targets through strategic planning, pipeline development, and partnership engagement within the designated region.
  • Research district and system priorities, leadership structures, and instructional needs to identify high-potential partnership opportunities, with a focus on mid-sized districts.
  • Build and manage a steady pipeline of qualified leads via outbound outreach, referrals, networking, and event follow-up.
  • Ensure timely response to all sales-qualified leads (SQLs), coordinating with relevant team members (e.g., Specialists, MDs).
  • Track regional market trends, competitor activity, and policy shifts to inform targeting and positioning strategies.
  • Use regional policy, instructional, and market data to identify implications for ANet’s strategy, elevating trends and risks that require organizational attention.

Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Building

  • Initiate and nurture relationships with senior district and charter network leaders, school-based decision-makers, and mid-level instructional leaders.
  • Secure and lead discovery conversations that uncover surface-level needs and deeper instructional challenges.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to prospective partners by tailoring solutions to their unique goals, constraints, and priorities.
  • Engage internal team members as needed to support cultivation and deepen trust.
  • Create inclusive engagement spaces that draw out district leaders’ diverse perspectives, enabling collaborative problem-solving and trust building.

Sales Execution & Deal Management

  • Design and deliver customized, persuasive sales presentations and materials that communicate ANet’s offerings and differentiated value.
  • Recommend scope, pricing, and partnership structures using sound judgment, balancing impact, district context, and financial sustainability.
  • Create proposals that reflect partner needs and priorities, collaborating with delivery and finance teams to ensure aligned scope and pricing.
  • Navigate procurement processes and lead negotiations with professionalism and clarity around value, constraints, and timing.
  • Close well-scoped, high-quality deals that set the stage for long-term success and renewals.

Operational Discipline & Internal Collaboration

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM to track outreach, engagement, and pipeline progression.
  • Leverage CRM insights and tools to forecast progress, identify bottlenecks, and refine outreach strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with the Growth & Partnerships team and delivery teams to ensure alignment on targeting, messaging, and handoffs.
  • Identify systemic bottlenecks in outreach, pipeline progression, and handoffs, proposing solutions that strengthen cross-functional alignment.
  • Contribute to team learning by sharing insights, participating in professional development, and continuously improving sales practice.

COMPETENCIES

In order to be successful in this role, candidates must demonstrate the following:

  • Expertise in Area of Focus: 5+ years’ professional experience, including 3+ years owning a full sales cycle in a mission-driven or K–12 education-facing organization (preferably in California). Proven consultative selling success with public school systems or charter networks.
  • Critical Thinking & Data Orientation: Ability to prioritize high-value information, surface important trends, and make strategic, equity-centered recommendations; uses both qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions.
  • Planning & Prioritization: Plans and prioritizes complex regional work in a way that aligns with organizational strategy, anticipating barriers and coordinating with internal partners to ensure smooth execution.
  • Communication: Crafts persuasive, tailored presentations and proposals; communicates with clarity and empathy; actively listens to build trust.

Ideal candidates may also demonstrate the following preferred qualifications:

  • Expertise in area of focus:
  • Technical proficiency with Salesforce and HubSpot
  • Prior experience serving in a K-12 edtech or educational publishing sales role
  • Prior experience as a teacher, instructional coach, and/or administrator
  • Critical Thinking & Data Orientation:
    • Ability to evaluate qualitative and/or quantitative data to surface conclusions

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this position is between $99,144 - $148,716. New hires will start between the range minimum and midpoint ($99,144 - $123,930) based on qualifications assessed during the hiring process, past experience, and internal equity. In order to uphold our commitment to transparent, equitable, competitive, and sustainable compensation, ANet does not negotiate pay.

INCENTIVE COMPENSATION

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a performance-based sales commission plan tied to individual revenue generation and attainment of an annual sales quota.

BENEFITS

We offer comprehensive benefits to best support our people. Benefits include: medical, dental and vision insurance where ANet pays a portion of the cost of these benefits for employees and their families/domestic partner; generous paid time-off including 10 paid holidays and paid days off between the Christmas and New Year’s holidays; paid parental leave; educational expenses reimbursements; flexible spending accounts; professional development; a 401(k) plan with a 4% match; short and long-term disability coverage; and basic life and personal accident insurance.

APPLY

We are now accepting applications for this position, which will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Please submit your application online. Learn more about the application process here.

ANet is committed to maximizing the diversity of our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage individuals of all ethnic and racial backgrounds and gender identities to apply to our positions.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

  • Develop and execute functional test scenarios, support SIT/E2E and UAT, resolve defects and drive Procurement business acceptance.
  • Support cutover, supplier/open-transaction readiness, production validation and hypercare; provide role-based knowledge transfer to Procurement users and support teams.

Requirements

  • 8-10+ years in Oracle SCM/Procurement consulting preferred, with substantial Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation experience.
  • At least 3 end-to-end Oracle Fusion Procurement implementations preferred, including Sourcing and supplier lifecycle/portal exposure.
  • Strong experience in P2P integration with Financials/AP and in approval/DoA design.
  • Experience in supplier data migration, procurement reporting, SIT/UAT and cutover is required.
  • Bachelor degree in Supply Chain, Business, Information Systems or related discipline. Oracle Fusion Procurement certification is advantageous.

Key Delivery Outputs / Accountabilities

  • Procurement TO-BE design, fit/gap decisions and RTM content.
  • Approved BF.016/application configuration baseline for Procurement.
  • Supplier/procurement migration rules and validation requirements under CV.010.
  • Procurement integration and reporting requirements with applicable MD.050/MD.070 inputs.
  • TE.040 test scenarios/evidence and TE.130 UAT acceptance support.
  • Cutover readiness, production validation and procurement hypercare support.

The ideal lead can design and configure Oracle Procurement hands-on, but is equally strong at process control. Role Boundaries / Interfaces

  • Finance/AP accounting design is owned by the Financials Lead; Procurement owns the business event and functional hand-off.
  • OIC and technical resources build integrations; this role owns functional requirements, mappings and acceptance.

Our client is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager (B2B) to lead and scale the company’s marketing strategy across paid, organic, outbound, and brand channels.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution and is ideal for a growth-minded marketer who thrives in fast-paced environments, understands modern B2B marketing trends, and can drive measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

The Digital Marketing Manager will own the full marketing funnel — from demand generation and lead nurturing to brand positioning and performance optimization — ensuring consistent growth, high-quality lead flow, and strong brand visibility.

The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, execution-focused, and comfortable balancing strategy with day-to-day campaign management.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Marketing Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive B2B marketing strategy aligned with company growth goals
    • Own the marketing funnel end-to-end, from awareness and demand generation through lead nurturing and conversion
    • Partner closely with leadership and sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue objectives
    • Build, manage, and mentor high-performing marketing resources, agencies, or contractors as needed
    • Identify scalable growth opportunities across acquisition, retention, and brand channels

Campaign Management & Growth Execution

  • Lead and optimize multi-channel marketing campaigns across paid media, SEO, outbound, email marketing, social media, partnerships, and content
    • Manage budgets and allocate spend strategically to maximize ROI and efficiency
    • Oversee campaign messaging, positioning, and creative direction to maintain brand consistency
    • Launch and manage performance-driven campaigns focused on pipeline growth and customer acquisition
    • Test new acquisition channels, campaign structures, audiences, and messaging to improve results

Analytics, Optimization & Reporting

  • Track and analyze campaign performance metrics including CAC, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, traffic, MQLs, SQLs, and revenue attribution
    • Build dashboards and reports using platforms such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, or other analytics tools
    • Use data-driven insights to refine targeting, messaging, budget allocation, and campaign strategy
    • Present actionable recommendations and performance updates to leadership regularly
    • Continuously optimize campaigns through A/B testing and experimentation

Content, Branding & Messaging

  • Collaborate with content, design, and technical teams to ensure cohesive execution across channels
    • Guide messaging strategy and brand positioning to strengthen market visibility and engagement
    • Support content initiatives including blogs, landing pages, outbound messaging, and campaign assets
    • Ensure all marketing efforts align with brand voice, customer pain points, and business objectives

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales teams to improve lead quality, funnel conversion, and campaign alignment
    • Coordinate with operations and product stakeholders to ensure marketing supports business priorities
    • Contribute to broader growth strategy discussions and go-to-market initiatives

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strategic thinker who connects marketing execution to business outcomes
    • Hands-on operator comfortable managing campaigns and optimizing performance directly
    • Data-driven marketer who thrives on experimentation, testing, and continuous improvement
    • Creative storyteller capable of building compelling brand and campaign messaging
    • Strong communicator and collaborative leader who works effectively across teams

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in B2B marketing leadership roles such as Head of Marketing, Growth Lead, or Senior Marketing Manager
    • Demonstrated success driving measurable growth through paid ads, outbound marketing, SEO, and organic channels
    • Strong understanding of modern B2B marketing tools and platforms including LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, HubSpot, analytics tools, and outbound systems
    • Experience balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution
    • Strong analytical mindset with experience interpreting performance data and optimizing campaigns accordingly
    • Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience leading marketing functions in B2B service-based, SaaS, or professional industries
    • Background in account-based marketing (ABM) or performance-driven demand generation
    • Familiarity with CRM and automation platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo
    • Experience managing cross-functional marketing teams or external agencies
    • Strong branding, storytelling, and positioning capabilities
    • Experience scaling marketing systems in high-growth environments

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Digital Marketing Manager’s day is a mix of strategic planning, campaign execution, and performance analysis. You will:

  • Review campaign dashboards and optimize active marketing initiatives
    • Collaborate with leadership, sales, and content teams to align priorities and messaging
    • Launch and refine campaigns across paid and organic channels
    • Monitor lead flow, pipeline quality, and funnel conversion performance
    • Test new acquisition ideas, audience segments, creatives, and messaging strategies
    • Analyze campaign data and prepare actionable reports and recommendations

In essence: you are responsible for driving pipeline growth, strengthening brand visibility, and ensuring marketing efforts generate measurable business impact.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs)
    • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Marketing ROI
    • Website traffic and conversion rate growth
    • Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-customer conversion rates

• Paid campaign performance and ROAS

  • Brand visibility, engagement, and audience growth across channels

Interview Process

  • Application Review – Assessment of experience and role alignment
    • Initial Interview – Discussion of background, marketing expertise, and growth mindset
    • Technical Interview – Deep dive into strategy, campaign management, analytics, and execution capabilities
    • Final Interview – Leadership and culture fit discussion with the client team

• Offer & Background Verification

This role covers a complex, multi-country region spanning the Middle East, including Israel and Africa, and requires someone who can operate confidently across time zones (UTC+2 to +4) and cultural contexts. Deliver & Measure

  • Report progress and insights to leadership, flagging risks early and proactively improving programming
  • Navigate the practical realities of a multi-country region — time zones, local context, and logistics — so programming lands well everywhere it needs to

Qualifications & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in program coordination or management, employee wellbeing, HR, Customer Success, or a related field
  • Strong project and event management skills, with the ability to run multiple initiatives end-to-end simultaneously
  • Experience operating in a co-delivery or partnership model
  • International experience working across regions or in a complex, virtual environment

Who You Are

  • An excellent communicator and relationship-builder who builds trust easily across diverse stakeholder groups, from wellbeing champions to regional business leaders
  • Analytical by instinct — comfortable tracking metrics, pulling reports, and turning data into insights that shape program decisions
  • A proactive problem-solver who adapts quickly when priorities shift
  • Culturally aware, with a genuine focus on inclusivity and accessibility in program design
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and navigating grey areas with confidence
  • Skilled at balancing local relevance with global scalability — able to tailor programming to a region while staying aligned to a broader strategy

🚀 Career Growth: Develop within the company and help shape our growth strategy.

💙 Human-Centric Culture: Thrive in a supportive environment with a range of wellness perks and benefits.

💰 Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a comprehensive and rewarding total compensation package.

🩺 Health & Financial Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage plus a retirement program.

🌴 Time to Recharge: Paid time-off programs designed to help you rest, reset, and recharge — including Thrive Time, a benefit unique to Thrive that gives employees additional paid time off after major projects or intense periods of work to truly recharge and recover.

Base compensation for this role will likely fall in the $40,000-$60,000 range.

Youth Enrichment Brands is the nation’s leading youth activities platform, offering camps, classes, leagues, and lessons for over 1 million kids each year. The YEB mission is to help as many kids as possible discover and develop their passion while building critical skills for life.

YEB encompasses i9 Sports (the nation’s largest youth league franchisor), School of Rock (the most revolutionary music education school in the world), Streamline Brands (the leading franchisor of swim school concepts), US Sports Camps (the official provider of Nike Camps), and more premier youth activity brands. Please visitwww.yeb.comto learn more.

With over 4 million registrations annually, i9 Sports is the nation’s largest multi-sport provider focused exclusively on high-quality, community-based youth sports. We are committed to our mission of Helping Kids Succeed in Life Through Sports.

Role Overview

The Director of Marketing is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping how i9 Sports shows up to franchisees, parents, and partners—ensuring clarity, consistency, and execution across all brand touchpoints.

This role owns brand positioning, messaging, system-wide communications, and content strategy, while serving as a key connector across Marketing, IT, Operations, and YEB shared services. The focus is on building strong foundations, aligning national strategy with local execution, and ensuring marketing initiatives are scalable, adoptable, and operationally sound in a franchise environment.

This leader balances brand stewardship with growth enablement—ensuring messaging and communications don’t just look good, but drive adoption, trust, and measurable business results across a distributed system.

Core Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Positioning

  • Own and evolve the i9 Sports brand voice, positioning, and messaging framework across all channels
  • Ensure brand consistency across web, email, paid media, social, and franchise communications
  • Lead brand updates and rollout plans that are realistic, scalable, and adoptable system-wide
  • Serve as final approver for brand messaging and system-wide communications
  • Proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities in brand perception and system adoption

Communications & Content Leadership

  • Oversee all franchise-facing communications, including the weekly Between the Goal Post newsletter
  • Ensure communications are concise, action-oriented, and tied to clear business outcomes
  • Guide content strategy across blogs, newsletters, social media, and campaigns
  • Partner with CRM and Digital teams to execute lifecycle communications in HubSpot
  • Develop and manage an annual strategic communications and marketing calendar
  • Leverage AI and emerging tools to improve content efficiency and performance

Digital Presence & Brand Governance

  • Provide strategic oversight of i9 Sports digital properties, including ongoing website content, brand updates and SEO/AEO content strategy
  • Partner with Digital/IT and agency partners on UX, consumer journey and website optimization
  • Lead sport- and program-specific brand storytelling across digital properties
  • Direct photo, video and creative strategy, including vendor management and creative direction
  • Oversee on-field branding, merchandise/apparel and physical brand touchpoints to ensure brand consistency
  • Oversee Canva platform strategy to drive simplicity, adoption and brand consistency

Campaigns, PR & Thought Leadership

  • Lead PR and earned media strategy in partnership with external agencies
  • Build i9 Sports thought leadership through media, executive visibility, speaking opportunities and strategic storytelling
  • Identify, develop and activate strategic brand partnerships aligned with business and brand priorities
  • Lead national campaigns and brand platforms, including Gains for the Girls, from positioning through activation
  • Align partnerships, influencers, PR and campaigns into an integrated annual strategy

Franchise Alignment & Enablement

  • Ensure national marketing strategies translate effectively at the local level
  • Support adoption of the Local Marketing Playbook, PPC Match Back Program, and CRM initiatives
  • Maintain franchise trust through clear expectations, consistent communication, and practical tools
  • Partner with Franchise Development to support franchise sales through brand positioning, messaging, content, creative assets and storytelling that clearly communicate the strength and differentiation of the i9 Sports brand.

Technology Alignment & Program Management

  • Act as a bridge between Marketing, IT, Operations, and YEB shared services
  • Ensure alignment across core platforms:
    • Franchise Manager (programs, registrations, POS)
    • HubSpot (CRM, automation, email deliverability)
    • Websites, paid media, analytics tools
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with clear ownership, timelines, and accountability
  • Identify risks early, escalate issues, and ensure execution discipline
  • Be technically fluent (not hands-on technical)—able to manage dependencies and integrations

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Provide clear direction, expectations, and accountability within the marketing team
  • Balance collaboration with decisive ownership
  • Lead with transparency, discipline, and a strong understanding of franchise dynamics

Skills & Experience

  • 7–10+ years of experience in brand, marketing communications, or integrated marketing roles
  • Experience within franchise, multi-unit, or distributed systems strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to operate strategically while staying close to execution
  • Strong leadership in brand positioning, messaging, and content strategy
  • Deep experience with CRM and marketing automation (HubSpot preferred)
  • Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills
  • Analytical, results-oriented mindset tied to business outcomes
  • Proficiency with modern marketing tools (HubSpot, WordPress, Canva, social platforms, Google Business)
  • Highly collaborative, organized, and adaptable
  • Passion for youth development, sports, and mission-driven brands

Why this Role Matters

This role is critical to ensuring i9 Sports shows up consistently, credibly, and confidently as a youth sports leader built on fun, inclusion, and life skills—not pressure or early specialization. The Director of Brand, Communications & Enablement will help shape how millions of families, franchisees, and partners experience the brand each year.

raw.description:
Leidos is seeking an experienced Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Functional Analyst to support the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), Administration for Strategic Preparedness and Response (ASPR), Strategic National Stockpile (SNS).


Contingent upon contract award


Candidate MUST:

Be a US Citizen or Green Card holder with the ability to obtain a Public Trust Clearance.

Role is remote but MUST be located in the UNITED STATES

preference for candidates who are local to the Atlanta, GA  area


Position Summary

The successful candidate will provide functional support for an Oracle E-Business Suite solution supporting mission-critical inventory, supply chain, asset management, financial, and warehouse operations. The position works closely with SNS business users, technical teams, developers, database administrators, integration specialists, and other stakeholders to translate operational requirements into effective Oracle EBS solutions.

The Oracle EBS Functional Analyst will support day-to-day operations as well as ongoing modernization and enhancement activities, including requirements analysis, business-process improvement, functional configuration, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, user support, and implementation of new or enhanced ERP capabilities.

The SNS mission depends on 24x7 availability of systems that support the nation’s emergency medical supply readiness and public health response. This position will participate in on-call services and must be able to acknowledge critical incidents within 15 minutes while on call.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support, configuration, analysis, and troubleshooting for Oracle EBS modules supporting SAMS.
  • Work with business stakeholders to understand operational requirements, business processes, issues, and enhancement needs.
  • Analyze existing business processes and recommend Oracle EBS configuration or functional solutions that improve efficiency, usability, data quality, and mission support.
  • Develop and document functional requirements, business-process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, configuration requirements, and functional specifications.
  • Support Oracle EBS modules and associated business processes, which may include:
  • Order Management
  • Inventory Management
  • Warehouse Management
  • Financials, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and General Ledger
  • Enterprise Asset Management
  • Advanced Supply Chain Planning
  • Planning Command Center
  • Transportation Management
  • Medical Equipment Maintenance
  • Support key end-to-end ERP business processes including Order-to-Delivery, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, Warehouse Operations, Asset Management, and Supply Chain Planning.
  • Perform functional fit-gap analysis and recommend configuration, process, or system enhancements.
  • Configure and maintain Oracle EBS functionality in accordance with approved requirements and configuration baselines.
  • Support the design and implementation of enhancements, new functionality, interfaces, reports, and business-process improvements.
  • Develop functional test scenarios and test cases and support system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Validate application changes and coordinate with users to confirm that delivered functionality meets business requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Troubleshoot functional issues, analyze root causes, and work with developers, DBAs, infrastructure engineers, Oracle Support, and other technical personnel to resolve problems.
  • Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 functional support for user questions, incidents, and service requests.
  • Support data validation, reconciliation, master-data quality, and integration activities involving SAMS and third-party logistics systems.
  • Participate in Agile development activities including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners and SNS stakeholders to develop and prioritize user stories based on business value, operational need, risk, and dependencies.
  • Support change management and configuration management processes and document functional and configuration changes.
  • Maintain functional documentation, business-process documentation, SOPs, user guides, job aids, and training materials.
  • Support user training, knowledge transfer, demonstrations, and implementation activities.
  • Support regulated-system activities, including change documentation, testing, and validation associated with cGMP and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, as applicable.
  • Participate in production implementation and post-release/HyperCare support.
  • Support emergency-response activities and critical system issues as required by the SNS mission.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 7+ years of experience performing Oracle E-Business Suite functional analysis, ERP business analysis, implementation, configuration, or production support.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting one or more Oracle EBS functional areas such as Order Management, Inventory, Warehouse Management, Financials, Enterprise Asset Management, Supply Chain Planning, Purchasing, or related modules.
  • Strong understanding of ERP business processes and the ability to translate business requirements into functional system solutions.
  • Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements.
  • Experience developing functional specifications, process flows, use cases or user stories, acceptance criteria, and test scenarios.
  • Experience with Oracle EBS configuration and functional troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Experience analyzing production issues and coordinating resolution across functional and technical teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with business users, technical staff, project leadership, and government/customer stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary Agile delivery environment.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Tier 2 background investigation/security eligibility and comply with HHS/ASPR/SNS security and training requirements.
  • Because SNS systems support the nation’s emergency medical supply readiness and public health response, this position is required to be on-call 24 hours/7 days a week. The employee must be able to respond to mission alerts within 15 minutes. The employee must carry a cell phone at all times while on call.
  • Ability to support occasional on-site activities at HHS facilities in the Atlanta, Georgia area and other authorized locations when required (for Atlanta based candidate).

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience with Oracle Fusion ERP or Oracle Cloud ERP.
  • Experience supporting Oracle EBS in a federal government, public health, pharmaceutical, medical supply, logistics, or regulated environment.
  • Experience with Oracle EBS supply chain, inventory, warehouse, asset-management, or financial modules.
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or cloud-hosted Oracle EBS environments.
  • Experience with warehouse-management systems, third-party logistics (3PL) operations, EDI, inventory management, or supply-chain integration.
  • Experience supporting data quality, master-data management, reconciliation, or ERP integration activities.
  • Experience working in Agile or SAFe delivery environments and developing user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience with cGMP-regulated systems, 21 CFR Part 11, validation, or formal change-control processes.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Analytics Cloud, Oracle reporting tools, or ERP reporting and analytics.
  • Experience supporting federal system-development and governance frameworks such as HHS EPLC.
  • Experience developing user documentation, training materials, and conducting end-user training.

Work Environment

The position is primarily remote, requiring occasional meetings at Atlanta HHS facilities for local candidates. Normal work hours align with Eastern Time business hours. The SNS mission also requires availability to support critical incidents or emergency-response activities when necessary.

Security Requirements

The selected candidate must obtain the required Tier 2 security clearance/background investigation prior to beginning work, maintain the required eligibility throughout performance, complete applicable HHS/ASPR/SNS nondisclosure agreements and training, and comply with HSPD-12 and other applicable federal security requirements.

raw.description:
About OHO

OHO is a digital agency full of smart, curious learners who love solving complex problems for higher education organizations. We partner with colleges and universities to navigate digital complexity so their marketing drives measurable impact for their brand and enrollment goals.

We bring deep expertise and a consultative mindset to everything we do—asking the right questions, challenging assumptions when needed, and always centering around our clients’ goals. In this role, you’ll be the subject-matter expert who frames the solution as part of the win-strategy for higher-ed web solutions engagements, helping prospective clients understand where they’re stuck and advising them on the right path forward, not just pitching a product.

We’re building toward a future where OHO is higher education’s most trusted advisory and implementation partner, and this role sits on the front lines of that journey—translating institutional challenges into smart, actionable web strategies.

About the Position

At its core, this role exists to win business: owning win-strategy, shaping the story OHO tells, engaging directly with clients, and leading pitches and proposals for Web Solutions deals.

The Principal Web Solutions Strategist sits on OHO’s Web Solutions Strategy team and plays a critical role at the intersection of business development, strategy, and delivery, in close partnership with the Director of Strategy. This role leads the strategic definition of Web Solutions deals, from early conversations with prospective clients through high-level involvement during delivery—ensuring that what OHO sells is thoughtful, viable, and aligned with how we deliver value.

In the sales process, the Principal Web Solutions Strategist crafts and communicates the vision and then defines the solution. You will own the majority of strategic airtime in client conversations:

  • Properly diagnosing client pain points and goals
  • Leading pitches and proposal strategy
  • Creating proposals and pitch materials, bringing in subject-matter experts and delivery leads when specialized input is needed or the opportunity requires a custom deliverable
  • Presenting audits and strategic recommendations
  • Clearly explaining OHO’s approach and the “how” behind our work

Proposal and pitch work is core to this role. It’s strategic work, not just production work. You’ll set the direction and narrative, developing customized proposals and pitch materials that communicate a persuasive, tailored solution that meets the client’s needs while effectively communicating the value OHO would bring to the engagement.

You’ll work closely with OHO’s Sales and Web Solutions teams, collecting collaborative input and feedback as you build the final proposal or pitch for delivery.

Through deep expertise in higher education websites and digital ecosystems, you’ll build trust quickly and confidently answer complex technical and strategic questions, partnering with OHO subject matter experts as needed.

After a project is won, you’ll stay engaged at key moments to ensure the project direction stays aligned with the vision established during the sales process. You’ll support a strong transition into delivery, participate in select milestones where your context is most valuable, and be available to help flag major strategic misalignments or risks so the team can address them early. This role provides continuity and confidence for the client at pivotal points while empowering the delivery team to lead day-to-day strategy and execution.

Beyond individual projects, you’ll help shape the evolution of OHO’s Web Solutions practice. You’ll gather market insights, identify buyer patterns, and partner with our Web Solutions leadership team to shape, inform and refine our offerings and how we talk about the value we bring to potential partners. i You’ll also contribute to OHO’s thought leadership so that OHO continues to be seen as a trusted strategic partner for higher education institutions.

Requirements

  • 7-10+ years of experience in digital strategy, web strategy, consulting, or agency environments.
  • Experience leading or owning delivery of digital projects in an agency and/or higher-education environment, with a solid understanding of how digital disciplines—UX, content strategy, design, and development—fit together and depend on one another. Higher-education experience is strongly preferred; candidates from other complex, highly regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, government, financial services) with comparable client and compliance dynamics are also encouraged to apply.
  • Deep expertise in content-intensive website strategy, including UX, content strategy, CMS platforms, accessibility, governance, SEO, and project delivery approaches.
  • Executive-level presence and strategic storytelling ability, with demonstrated comfort leading high-stakes pitches, setting vision, building trust with senior stakeholders, confidently owning the room, and influencing business development outcomes. This does not require a formal sales title or a traditional sales background.
  • Experience shaping, evolving, or stewarding service offerings or productized solutions.
  • Ability to balance pre-sale strategy leadership with high-level delivery involvement without becoming execution-focused.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and collaborating across sales, strategy, and delivery teams.
  • Strong judgment and decision-making skills, particularly around scope, approach, and strategic tradeoffs.
  • An intuitive problem-solver who can rapidly synthesize complex information, identify core problems, and pivot to strategic solutions with speed and precision.
  • Natural ability to rally teams, build momentum around a vision, and push deals or initiatives across the finish line.
  • Depth of technological understanding across diverse digital ecosystems, ensuring the ability to confidently advise on complex technical solutions and integrations.
  • Established or emerging thought leadership and external credibility—for example, conference speaking, published articles or perspective pieces, or a strong professional presence (e.g., LinkedIn) within the higher-ed or digital strategy community.

What Success Looks Like in 6–12 Months

Within 6–12 months, a successful Principal Web Solutions Strategist will:

  • Shape web opportunities so that by the time they’re late-stage, everyone is clear on the problem we’re solving, how success will be measured, and the recommended approach.
  • Develop and lead proposals and pitches that win, with measurable improvement in OHO's win rate on Web Solutions opportunities and wins increasingly driven by the strength of the strategy and story—not just price or scope.
  • Sell work that delivery teams describe as “right-sized and well framed,” with minimal need for major re-scoping once projects kick off.
  • Lead sales conversations that prospective clients and senior stakeholders regularly describe as advisory, clarifying, and confidence-building (for example, through direct feedback, NPS, or post-pitch debriefs).
  • Help evolve our Web Solutions offering by spotting patterns across deals and delivery and turning them into sharper packages, positioning, and case studies.
  • Become the person BDRs, BDMs, and Web Solutions Directors naturally pull into complex or ambiguous opportunities when they need help framing the problem and path forward.
  • Contribute to visible thought leadership in higher-ed web strategy (talks, webinars, articles, etc.) that we can point to as influencing new or stronger client relationships.

OHO Benefits

OHO offers a comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance package, along with company-paid life insurance as well as short/long-term disability coverage. Benefits also include a 401(k) match up to 4% of pay, paid vacation and sick time, ten holidays including a Flex Day, Summer Fridays, and more!

Each year, the team aims to come together in person for our Annual Summit at a beautiful destination, and throughout the year, leadership shares regular company updates and fosters an open-door culture. We also sprinkle in a healthy dose of fun with team events, friendly competitions, and other surprises that keep things fresh and connected.

Additional Information

Candidates should be comfortable traveling nationally 2-4 times a year for company and/or client meetings.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States in order to be considered. OHO is an e-Verify employer, ensuring compliance with federal employment eligibility requirements.

OHO is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse workforce, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Salary: Base pay $150K, plus commission

raw.description:
Location, Reporting & Travel

Reports to the Chief Revenue Officer. This is a full-time, 100% remote role within the United States, with approximately 20-25% travel for team meetings, member and partner engagement, conferences, and E3n events.

About Us

E3n is a not-for-profit, member-based organization serving independent schools, educators, students, and families across the full student lifecycle.

Formed through the merger of the former Educational Records Bureau (ERB) and the Enrollment Management Association (EMA), E3n builds on nearly a century of collective expertise in assessment, enrollment, and student development. E3n exists to deepen school impact and advance whole-student growth by uniting academic and enrollment leadership around shared, data-driven insights.

E3n provides comprehensive assessments, tools, professional learning, data and insights that help independent schools demonstrate their value and support student success from pre-enrollment through graduation - extending beyond academic performance to include student well-being, sense of belonging, and social-emotional development.

About the Opportunity

E3n is seeking a strategic, hands-on marketing leader to help translate the organization's post-merger strategy into disciplined, integrated, and measurable execution. The Vice President, Marketing will bring process, pace, and performance to a wide range of marketing work across brand, communications, member lifecycle, product marketing, events, sales enablement, and marketing operations.

This role is ideal for a senior marketing professional who can move fluidly between strategy and execution - building campaign plans, improving systems, coaching a team, analyzing performance, and partnering across Sales, Product, and the Member Experience functions . The right leader will thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building structure, and care deeply about helping schools understand E3n's value across the full student lifecycle.

As an executive-level functional leader, the VP will be expected to make sound decisions, manage resources, influence across teams, and ensure marketing execution strengthens E3n's market presence, member engagement, and growth outcomes.

What You'll Do

Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, the Vice President, Marketing will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following:

Set Enterprise Market Strategy and Executive Alignment

  • Establish and execute a unified market strategy that clarifies E3n's value proposition, and positioning following the merger.
  • Define enterprise marketing priorities, success metrics, investment choices, and operating rhythms that align with E3n's strategic plan, growth goals, member outcomes, and organizational performance.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Sales, Product, Member Experience, and other teams so E3n presents one coherent market narrative and delivers against shared outcomes.
  • Represent E3n with external stakeholders, including independent school leaders, members, partners, sector influencers, and, as appropriate, Board-level audiences.

Execute Brand Integration, Messaging, and Marketing Communications

  • Implement E3n's post-merger brand integration across legacy organizations, ensuring consistent brand voice, messaging, visual identity, and tone across channels and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the rebranding of core assets, including web and digital content, member communications, sales materials, product collateral, conference/event materials, and internal templates.
  • Translate E3n's mission, capabilities, and portfolio into clear, audience-specific messaging for school leaders, members, prospects, educators, students, and families.
  • Elevate E3n's thought leadership and market visibility through coordinated content, campaigns, events, and communications that position E3n as a trusted resource for independent schools.

Drive Member Lifecycle Marketing: Engage, Retain, Grow

  • Use member segmentation to define target cohorts and develop a multi-channel strategy that increases engagement, retention, product and service usage/adoption, and expansion opportunities.
  • Develop and execute multi-channel marketing plans that showcase Professional Learning and increase engagement among priority audiences.
  • Create communication plans that educate members about upcoming product releases in enrollment, achievement, assessment, and related portfolio areas with compelling benefit statements for key cohorts.
  • Partner with Member Experience to identify moments in the member journey where marketing can improve onboarding, adoption, renewal readiness, and long-term value.

Partner with Sales and Revenue Teams to Support Growth

  • Partner with Sales to provide core messaging, competitive differentiation, competitor profiles, campaign assets, and sales enablement materials needed to achieve growth goals.
  • Translate revenue priorities into campaign briefs, audience strategies, content plans, calls to action, and channel recommendations.
  • Support member acquisition goals by ensuring marketing programs are aligned to pipeline needs, buyer personas, , competitive positioning , and membership value drivers.
  • Collaborate with the CRO and revenue-facing teams to establish practical reporting on campaign performance, lead quality, engagement, and marketing contribution to shared outcomes.

Lead Product Marketing, Portfolio Messaging, and Partnerships

  • Implement and integrate a voice-of-the-customer process that informs messaging, product positioning, launch planning, and customer-facing content.
  • Partner with Product and Member Experience teams to evaluate and refine the market positioning of core products and services.
  • Develop competitor messaging frameworks and product-level differentiation for E3n's portfolio.
  • Support adoption and scale for new products and releases, including Wild Zebra and new blended admissions assessment offerings.
  • Promote key partnerships, including Committee for Children, Wild Zebra, and Test Innovators, in ways that drive growth and member value around SEL curriculum, AI tools, and test practice.

Strengthen Marketing Operations, Team Management, and Budget Discipline

  • Develop, implement, and maintain marketing tools, processes, dashboards, and reporting routines that enable data-informed decisions and stronger campaign execution.
  • Define core KPIs and action plans for engagement, campaign performance, product usage, retention support, and marketing operational effectiveness.
  • Provide performance management, coaching, and development for the marketing team, including the current five FTEs and a newly onboarded marketing communications resource.
  • Model best practices for cross-functional engagement and ensure the marketing team operates with clarity, accountability, and strong service orientation to internal partners.
  • Develop and manage the marketing budget with appropriate financial controls, vendor oversight, and expense management.

Measures of Success

  • Marketing plans, calendars, campaigns, and event support are delivered on time, aligned to organizational priorities, and clearly connected to member and revenue outcomes.
  • Campaign performance improves through disciplined testing, segmentation, analytics, and optimization.
  • Sales, Member Experience, and Product teams receivepractical, timely marketing partnership and enablement.
  • Members and prospects experience a clearer, more consistent E3n brand and portfolio story across channels.
  • The marketing team operates with stronger systems, clearer priorities, better reporting, and consistent coaching.

Why Work with Us

At E3n, you will join a mission-driven organization formed through the unification of two respected leaders in independent education. We are building something new - bringing together enrollment and academic perspectives to create deeper insight, stronger institutions, and better outcomes for students from pre-enrollment through graduation.

At E3n, you will experience:

  • Purpose with impact. Our work directly supports educators, school leaders, and families nationwide. The decisions we make - and the tools we build - matter.
  • Smart, thoughtful colleagues. You will work alongside people who care deeply about education, ask good questions, and value collaboration, clarity, and integrity.
  • Whole-person thinking. Just as we help schools understand the full student journey, we strive to support employees as whole people - recognizing that strong work is sustained by balance, trust, and belonging.
  • Growth during a moment of transformation. E3n is actively evolving. That means opportunities to shape systems, influence direction, and grow alongside an organization defining its future.
  • Values-driven, data-informed. We balance heart and rigor - grounding our work in evidence while staying anchored in empathy, equity, and real-world impact.

If you are energized by meaningful work, thoughtful problem-solving, and helping schools better serve students, you will find a home at E3n.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including significant leadership responsibility for functions, teams, or major organizational initiatives.
  • Progressive marketing leadership experience across marketing communications, product marketing, lifecycle/customer or member marketing, growth marketing, campaign strategy, and marketing operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and execute integrated, multi-channel marketing plans across email, social, web, events, webinars, member portals, print assets, direct mail, and partner channels.
  • Record of supporting a sales function with a suite of enablement tools resulting in member acquisition, member retention, and product expansion resulting in top-line growth.
  • Fluency in B2B and B2C marketing strategies, including segmentation, buyer personas, market research, customer journeys, and audience-specific messaging.
  • Experience using CRM, marketing automation, campaign analytics, and performance reporting tools to guide decisions and improve outcomes.
  • Experience managing people, budgets, vendors, timelines, and cross-functional work in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

Preferred Skills & Experiences

  • Experience in EdTech, education services, assessment, and enrollment.
  • Knowledge of the private and independent school landscape and the needs of school leaders, educators, students, and families.
  • Experience in membership-based organizations, including retention, engagement, renewal, product usage, and expansion strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pardot, Marketing Cloud, or comparable marketing technology tools.
  • Experience marketing conferences, annual meetings, webinars, sponsored events, partner campaigns, or professional learning offerings.

E3n is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We believe our work is stronger when people of different backgrounds, identities, and experiences come together.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are looking for a CFP® professional who believes financial planning is about stewardship, clarity, and long-term impact, not product pushing or asset gathering for its own sake.

This role is ideal for an advisor who:

  • Already has a book of business and wants a better home

  • Is tired of sales quotas, misaligned incentives, or compliance theater

  • Wants to serve clients deeply, grow intentionally, and be rewarded fairly

You will operate with significant autonomy while being supported by systems, planning tools, and a firm culture built on trust and responsibility.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver holistic, values-based financial planning (cash flow, investments, risk management, tax awareness, and legacy planning)

  • Manage and grow client assets withintegrity, discipline, and fiduciary care

  • Act as a coach and guide, not just an advisor—educating clients so they make wise, confident decisions

Required

  • CFP® certification (non-negotiable)

  • 3+ years of experience as a Financial Advisor / Financial Planner

  • Active Series 65 license

  • Existing book of business or a clearly demonstrated ability to transition/grow one

  • Strong coaching mindset—you genuinely enjoy teaching and empowering clients

  • High personal and professional integrity (this matters more than production numbers)

Preferred (not required)

  • Comfort with modern planning tech and remote-first collaboration

  • Desire for long-term partnership rather than job-hopping


Benefits

Compensation & Structure

  • 40%–80% of revenue, based on:

    • Size and quality of book transitioned

    • Growth contribution over time

  • No artificial caps

  • No product quotas

  • Aligned incentives: you win when your clients win

(This is built for adults who want ownership, not hand-holding.)

  • Annual company retreat

  • A firm that values:

    • Long-term thinking over short-term wins

    • Stewardship over speculation

Who This IsNotFor

  • Advisors who need scripts, pressure, or micromanagement

  • Product-centric sales roles disguised as “planning”

Job Title

Services Sales

Job Description

在这个岗位上，您将有机会

负责区域内客户的服务销售及客户关系维护工作，通过推广服务产品和解决方案，支持客户设备全生命周期管理，推动业务持续增长。

您的职责是

业务销售

  • 负责区域内客户的服务产品销售工作。
  • 推广服务合同、维修服务、备件及增值服务解决方案。
  • 发现并挖掘客户业务机会，完成销售目标。

客户管理

  • 建立和维护良好的客户关系。
  • 跟进服务合同签署、续约及执行情况。
  • 协调内部资源解决客户问题，提升客户满意度。

市场拓展

  • 收集市场及客户信息。
  • 识别区域业务机会并推动转化。
  • 支持区域市场活动及重点项目开展。

个人成长

  • 持续学习产品知识和销售技能。
  • 遵守公司流程及合规要求。
  • 使用CRM系统进行客户和销售机会管理。

您将适合这个岗位，如果您具备

Must Have

  • 良好的客户沟通和关系维护能力
  • 较强的学习能力和执行力
  • 客户导向思维和结果导向意识
  • 能够独立进行客户拜访和业务跟进
  • 愿意持续学习医疗行业及服务业务知识

Nice to Have

  • B2B销售经验
  • 医疗行业或医疗器械相关经验
  • 客户管理或售后服务相关经验
