raw.title: Director of Growth Marketing
raw.excerpt: To maintain a strong connection with our members and local communities and better understand their unique needs, we are currently considering applications from candidates residing in Oregon and Washington for all open positions.
raw.description:
To maintain a strong connection with our members and local communities and better understand their unique needs, we are currently considering applications from candidates residing in Oregon and Washington for all open positions. We appreciate your understanding as we focus our hiring efforts in these specific regions. And, we encourage all qualified candidates from these states to apply, as we look forward to learning more about your unique skills and experience!

Job Overview:

Owns Peak’s member-growth strategy and its execution across the full member lifecycle: awareness, acquisition, activation, onboarding, retention, and referral. Sets the growth roadmap across digital and offline channels, leads the growth marketing team, and partners with the SVP of Marketing & Internal Communications, Product team, and IT to build funnels, launch products, and grow membership and share of wallet. This is a measurement-driven role where success is defined by movement on a small set of growth metrics, not activity.

Where You Will Work:

  • Remote role open to candidates residing in Washington (WA) or Oregon (OR). (Branches)
  • Travel is required.

When You Will Work:

  • This is an exempt position.
  • Standard business hours.

Pay Range:

  • The target annual pay range for this position is $184,536 - $209,700. The full annual pay range is $167,760 - $251,640.
  • Compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer of employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant.
  • Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Sets and executes the annual member-growth strategy across the full lifecycle, with quarterly priorities aligned to Peak’s goals.
  • Owns and allocates the growth marketing budget, optimizing spend against return.
  • Reports progress against growth targets to the SVP of Marketing & Internal Communications and leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Plans, launches, and optimizes integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social by platform, SEO, display/retargeting, email, streaming, direct mail.
  • Leads go-to-market for new products, features, rates, and offers, from positioning through channel execution.
  • Builds and runs lifecycle and trigger programs (onboarding, cross-sell, win-back) that deepens member relationships and grow share of wallet.
  • Defines, tracks, and reports the metrics that govern this role (e.g., net new members, CAC, cost per funded account, conversion rate, ROAS, share of wallet).
  • Owns a continuous testing roadmap across creative, audience, offer, and channel, and scale what wins.
  • Partners with the Marketing Analyst, Digital agency, and Business Intelligence to turn campaign and member data into decisions.
  • Operates and improves Peak’s marketing technology stack: HubSpot Marketing, PowerBI, Microsoft Copilot, Google Analytics, and additional analytics and advertising platforms.
  • Partners with IT and digital to maintain clean data flow, accurate attribution, and reliable campaign execution.
  • Ensures all marketing meets credit-union advertising and lending compliance requirements (for example UDAAP, Reg DD, Reg Z, and NCUA advertising rules).
  • Leads and develops a team of direct reports plus agency and contractor partners; sets goals, coaches, and builds a culture of experimentation and accountability.
  • Collaborates across product, retail/branch, digital, and IT to deliver programs on time.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's in Marketing, Business, Communications, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A minimum of ten (10) years of marketing experience with a progression of increasing responsibility, including a minimum of five (5) years in management or leadership role owning growth, demand, or digital marketing strategy. Deep understanding of digital marketing and data analysis, with direct B2C acquisition experience. Proven ability to reduce acquisition costs and improve return on spend.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a financial institution or other highly regulated environment preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Makes data-driven decisions and translates complex data into strategy.
  • Full-funnel growth expertise across acquisition, lifecycle, and retention.
  • Proficiency with marketing automation, CRM, and web analytics platforms.
  • Command of paid and organic channels and the metrics behind each (CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, LTV).
  • Budget management and the ability to calculate and improve ROI.
  • Strong project management; runs multiple programs simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of credit-union and lending compliance requirements.
  • Comfort with experimentation, testing design, and basic statistical reasoning.
  • Hands-on proficiency and certifications with HubSpot Marketing, Google Ads, and Google Analytics preferred.
  • Track record leading B2C digital acquisition at scale and managing creative or agency partners preferred.

Total Rewards:

This position is eligible for Full-Time Regular benefits. Employees and their eligible family members have access to a wide array of employee benefits, such as medical, dental, vision and life insurance coverage.

  • Includes an option for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance to be paid at a 100% by company for the employee only coverage.
  • We also offer Health Care FSA (HCFSA), Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions, and Dependent Care FSA (DCFSA).
  • Employees also have access to Life and AD&D insurance.
  • Employees are able to enroll in our 401k plan.
  • Full-Time Regular employees accrue 8 hours of vacation and 8 hours of sick leave, on a monthly basis.
  • Full-Time Regular hired employees also receive 11 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 1 floating holiday, 16 hours of self-care time, and 16 hours of volunteer time.

All benefits except 401k start the first of the month following date of hire. Employees become eligible to contribute to 401k on the first of the month following 60 days of employment.

Peak Credit Union participates in E-Verify. We use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all persons hired to work in the United States.

For more information on E-Verify, please click here: E-Verify Participation Poster English and Spanish

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. raw.description:
We’re seeking an organized, motivated, and collaborative individual for our medical writing team.

The senior medical writer will partner cross-functionally with client teams in Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory, and Program Management in leading the planning and preparation of high-quality clinical regulatory documents. The medical writer may produce protocols, publications, study reports, investigator brochures, narratives, and module documents, according to client and agency guidelines, to support drug development under brisk timelines.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the execution of documents, including project management tasks such as creating, maintaining, and communicating timelines

  • Coordinate cross-functional client contributors and stakeholders as well as internal resources (e.g., quality control [QC], publishing) to ensure timely completion of documents

  • Ensure document development adheres to any relevant client processes, templates, and instructional documents

  • Serve as an expert on client document management system and related tools, templates, and procedures to ensure efficient document development

  • Lead document message development in collaboration with client

  • Interpret data and create shell documents to support authoring

  • Plan and lead kickoff meetings

  • Facilitate resolution of review feedback including planning and leading comment resolution meetings (curate review comments to ensure meetings are efficient)

  • Follow-up with individual team members as needed to resolve outstanding review feedback

  • Ensure consistency among client programs in terms of messaging, formatting, and presentation of documents

  • Conduct literature searches as needed

  • Perform peer QC review as needed

  • Contribute to medical writing operational initiatives (e.g., templates, style guides, reference management), if needed

Requirements

  • Experience (5+ years) as a medical writer in the CRO/biotech/pharmaceutical field

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field

  • Oncology, Infectious Disease, or Vaccine experience desired

  • Experience desired in writing clinical study reports, protocols, protocol amendments, investigator brochures, module 2, and module 5 documents

  • Flexibility to work across multiple therapeutic areas, if needed

  • Experience writing documents according to established processes and document templates

  • Familiarity with lean authoring approaches and structured content management

  • Familiarity with the requirements for preparation of key clinical and regulatory documents, including ICH and US regulatory requirements; working knowledge of ex-US regulatory requirements is desired

  • Expertise with Microsoft Word and other Microsoft applications

  • Experience developing documents using document management systems, collaborative authoring tools, and review tools

  • Comfortable adapting to new tools and technologies, if needed

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in the face of competing priorities

  • Service-oriented and proactive approach to project management

  • Excellent conflict management and negotiation skills

  • Comfortable providing suggestions based on previous experience

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: Computational Statistics and Applied Mathematics Expert (R, Python, and Matlab/Scilab)
Type:Contract
Compensation:$70–$90/hour
Location:Remote
Commitment:15–20 hours/week

Role Responsibilities

  • Design challenging computational problems using specialized statistical, mathematical, or scientific software packages.
  • Evaluate AI's ability to compute reproducible numerical answers and carry out complex workflows.
  • Develop problems requiring strategic planning for information discovery and efficient problem-solving.
  • Test and refine problems against state-of-the-art AI models to achieve target difficulty.
  • Work independently and asynchronously to refine problem designs based on feedback.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Graduate-level training in statistics, applied mathematics, or a relevant STEM field.
  • Proven proficiency with at least one specialized software package through research publications or professional work.
  • Strong Python skills for writing problem setups and solution validators.
  • Ability to work independently in a Linux/terminal environment with remote compute sandboxes.
  • Available for at least 15–20 hours per week.

Preferred

  • Experience across multiple computational domains or specialized software packages.
  • Familiarity with benchmark or evaluation design.
  • Background in scientific teaching or exam/problem-set design.
  • Experience with computational reproducibility and containerized environments.

raw.description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

Program Overview:

Our Core Banking Internship Program offers a dynamic 10-week experience designed to provide undergraduate students with a comprehensive introduction to banking operations, strategies, and career opportunities. Interns will collaborate with seasoned professionals within our banking teams, gaining hands-on exposure to operational processes, client engagement, and business initiatives that drive success and community impact.

Throughout the program, we prioritize your professional growth, equipping you with the skills and knowledge needed to advance your career. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our brand voice and digital culture while engaging in professional development, analytical training, and networking. Key program components include:

  • Onboarding Week: Kick off your internship with an orientation, featuring training sessions, networking with peers and SouthState leaders, and an introduction to our banking business.
  • Hands-On Experience: Work alongside high-performing teams, participating in daily activities to build analytical and creative skills, and gain insight into critical banking processes.
  • Mentorship & Support: Partner with experienced team members who provide guidance, answer questions, and offer feedback to help you navigate challenges and grow professionally.
  • Speaker Series: Hear from senior leaders about industry trends in banking, and how to maximize your internship experience.
  • Networking Opportunities: Engage in organized events to connect with peers, employees, and leaders across the organization while contributing to community initiatives.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Participate in internship program activities, including workshops, training sessions, and special projects.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify client needs and recommend tailored banking solutions.
  • Assist with data analytics, due diligence on banking platforms, and document reviews to support client engagement and outreach.
  • Collaborate with product managers, analysts/specialists, and team leaders to contribute to real-time consumer and business initiatives.
  • Support activities to enhance user engagement and promote banking services through various channels.
  • Prioritize tasks, maintain attention to detail, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

  • Education: Current undergraduate student pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Project Management, Information Systems, or a related field; Rising Senior graduating in December 2027 or May 2028 preferred. 3.4 GPA preferred.
  • Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; strong analytical and creative mindset, and eagerness to learn.
  • Attributes: Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to work effectively under pressure.

Training Requirements:

  • Complete mandatory new hire compliance training and New Employee Orientation.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to effectively access and interpret information on computer screens, documents, and reports. The role requires extended time using a computer, which can be accommodated by sitting or standing at an appropriate desk. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

This internship provides a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in Core Banking, build a professional network, and develop skills that will propel your career forward. Join us to make a meaningful impact while gaining invaluable experience!

Compensation & Benefits

$20 per hour


Click here to view: Benefits | SouthState Careers


Job Posting Deadline

While the anticipated deadline for the job posting is 10/16/2026, we encourage you to submit your application as we may still consider qualified candidates beyond this date.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disabled/veterans.

raw.title: DevOps Laravel Engineer
raw.excerpt: DeterTech's purpose is giving greater peace of mind to people and communities, every day.
raw.description:
DeterTech's purpose is giving greater peace of mind to people and communities, every day. The systems and software behind our products need to be as reliable and secure as the physical security solutions we deliver. This role exists to build and maintain the infrastructure, automation and deployment pipelines that keep our Laravel-based applications running smoothly, securely and at scale.

The DevOps Laravel Engineer will work within the IT function, part of Group Operations, partnering closely with our development team to bring strong DevOps practice to the applications that support DeterTech's customers and colleagues across the UK, Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark and Sweden.
This role will take day-to-day operational ownership of our AWS cloud environment under the technical direction and architectural governance of the Lead Full Stack Developer. Working closely alongside the Lead Developer and existing infrastructure specialists, you will share and progressively take on full operational ownership of our cloud footprint—establishing robust auto-scaling, high-availability, and modern infrastructure-as-code practices. You will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure and application engineering—ensuring event queues, databases, and background workers scale effortlessly during real-time alarm surges, while embedding automated deployment pipelines that help our developers ship quality code safely, predictably, and with full architectural sign-off.

Key Responsibilities

1. Infrastructure and environments
• Build, maintain and continuously improve the cloud infrastructure that hosts DeterTech's Laravel applications, using infrastructure-as-code practices.
• Manage development, staging and production environments so releases are consistent, predictable and easy to roll back if needed.
• Own the configuration and performance of web servers, databases and caching layers supporting our applications.

• Architect, configure, and maintain our core AWS cloud footprint (specifically EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM, and VPC networking, alongside ECS/containers) in direct consultation with the Lead Developer, adhering to established system design standards, high availability, and disaster recovery requirements.

• Collaborate alongside existing infrastructure specialists to capture, map, and record infrastructure knowledge as operational ownership is progressively consolidated in-house, maintaining clear architecture diagrams and operational runbooks.

• Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using technologies such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, ensuring all cloud infrastructure modifications are submitted via pull requests, version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and signed off prior to execution.

• Fine-tune and scale background queues and caching layers to guarantee low latency or monitoring lag during high-volume alarm spikes.

2. CI/CD and automation
• Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Laravel applications, automating testing, build and deployment.
• Reduce manual, repetitive work through automation, so the development team can ship changes quickly and safely.
• Support version control workflows and branching strategies that keep releases clean and traceable.
• Architect, configure, and maintain our core AWS cloud footprint (specifically EC2, ECS/containers, RDS, and Lambda) in direct consultation with the Lead Developer, adhering to established system design standards, high availability, and disaster recovery requirements.
• Maintain clear, documented architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and internal cloud governance in partnership with the Lead Developer.
• Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using technologies such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, ensuring all cloud infrastructure modifications are submitted via pull requests, version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and signed off prior to execution.
• Fine-tune and scale background queues and caching layers to guarantee low latency or monitoring lag during high-volume alarm spikes.
3. Monitoring, reliability and security
• Implement monitoring, logging and alerting so issues are caught and resolved before they affect customers or colleagues.
• Own backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements for the applications you support.

• Participate as an escalation point for production incidents alongside our 24/7 out-of-hours support partner, following clear triage and communication processes.

• Deploy centralised observability and alerting systems (e.g. Grafana, or Sentry etc) to monitor API response times, queue depths, memory thresholds, and database connection pooling in real time, escalating critical anomalies to the Lead Developer.

• Enforce robust cloud security policies, least-privilege IAM roles, security groups, SSL/TLS certificates, and secure secrets management (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager or HashiCorp Vault), avoiding plain-text credentials in application code.

• Ensure infrastructure and release processes comply with ISO 27001, GDPR, and security alarm industry regulatory standards.

• Provide our external 24/7 out-of-hours support partner with up-to-date operational runbooks, health check procedures, and clear escalation workflows in agreement with the Lead Developer.

4. Collaboration and continuous improvement
• Work closely with the development team to embed DevOps thinking into how Laravel applications are designed, built and released.
• Share knowledge and document processes clearly, so the wider IT and development teams can work confidently with the systems you build.
• Keep up to date with developments in the Laravel and DevOps ecosystem, bringing new tools and approaches to the team where they add real value.

• Conduct cost-optimisation reviews across AWS services, presenting rightsizing and architectural recommendations to the Lead Developer and IT leadership for approval.

• Facilitate blameless post-incident reviews alongside the Lead Developer following infrastructure or deployment issues to prevent recurring outages.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise


• Proven experience in a DevOps or infrastructure engineering role supporting PHP/Laravel applications in production.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (for example GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) and infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform or Ansible).

• Strong Linux administration skills and experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure).

• Practical knowledge of containerisation (Docker) and, ideally, orchestration (Kubernetes or similar).

• Experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and caching technologies (Redis).

• A security-conscious mindset, comfortable applying best practice around access control, secrets management and vulnerability management.

• Clear communicator, comfortable working closely with developers and explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

• Commercial background configuring and managing production AWS cloud environments, specifically focused on EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM, and VPC (or comparable cloud equivalents).

• Practical understanding of Laravel internals from an infrastructure perspective (Artisan commands, queue workers, job processing, caching strategies, and Laravel Horizon).

• Comfortable collaborating alongside external or partner technical specialists to share operational coverage and progressively absorb platform ownership.

• Strong technical documentation skills, able to record, map, and consolidate infrastructure architecture and operational runbooks as knowledge transitions in-house.

• Demonstrated experience implementing Terraform or CloudFormation to manage infrastructure-as-code in a multi-environment setting (Dev, Staging, Production).

• Hands-on experience securing cloud workloads, applying principle of least privilege, secrets management, and network access controls.

• Comfortable collaborating under the technical governance of a Lead Developer, actively seeking code and architectural reviews for infrastructure changes.

Desirable
• Familiarity with Laravel-specific tooling
• Experience working in a regulated or security-focused industry.
• Exposure to observability tooling (for example Grafana, Prometheus, New Relic or Datadog).
• Experience supporting applications used across multiple countries or time zones.

• AWS Certifications (e.g. AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Solutions Architect, or DevOps Engineer).

• Familiarity with containerised deployments using Docker and AWS ECS.

• Experience handling high-throughput, real-time message queues or streaming architectures (such as SQS, RabbitMQ, or MQTT for IoT devices).

• Experience collaborating with an external 24/7 managed service or out-of-hours monitoring partner.

raw.description:
Senior Project Manager — Telecommunications & Low Voltage Systems

About the Role

Our client in the Data Center Construction Field designs, installs, and commissions telecommunications and low-voltage infrastructure for enterprise, data center, healthcare, education, and public-sector clients across the United States. We are hiring a Senior Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of those projects.

This is a fully remote, full-time, W-2 position. You run your projects from a home office anywhere in the continental U.S. and travel roughly 30% of the time to job sites nationwide — site surveys and existing-conditions audits before the work starts, quality and safety walks while it is running, and punch-list resolution and final client sign-off at the end.

You are accountable for scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, and the client relationship from award through closeout. You will direct field supervisors, technicians, and subcontractors you do not see every day.

What You Will Do

  • Own project delivery end to end: validate the estimate at handoff, build the schedule and execution plan, and drive it to closeout on time and on margin.
  • Travel to job sites nationwide (approx. 30%) for pre-construction surveys, existing-conditions audits, in-progress quality and safety walks, punch-list walks, and final customer sign-off.
  • Direct field supervisors, lead technicians, and subcontractor foremen on manpower loading, sequencing, and daily reporting — remotely most weeks, on site when it counts.
  • Own project financials: labor against earned value, material and subcontractor spend, change order origination and negotiation, progress billing, and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Serve as the single point of accountability for the client, with a consistent cadence of written status reports, risk logs, and look-ahead schedules.
  • Enforce compliance with ANSI/TIA-568, 569, 606, and 607, BICSI installation methods, NEC, and NFPA 70/72, along with the company and site-specific safety programs.
  • Oversee testing and certification — copper channel and permanent link, OTDR and optical loss, system commissioning — and review results before they go to the client.
  • Assemble and deliver complete closeout packages: as-builts, test results, warranty registrations, O&M manuals, labeling schedules, and final acceptance documentation.
  • Qualify and manage subcontractors on multi-site and out-of-region deployments, holding them to the same quality, safety, and documentation standard as internal crews.
  • Mentor project coordinators and assistant project managers, and help standardize delivery practice across the team.

What You Need

  • Seven (7) or more years of progressively responsible project management experience delivering telecommunications, structured cabling, fiber optic, or low voltage systems projects, with full ownership of scope, schedule, and budget.
  • A track record on significant-value projects and/or concurrent multi-site programs, including work delivered outside your home region.
  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, project management, telecommunications, engineering technology, business, or a related field — or an equivalent combination of education, certification, military service, and directly relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Working command of structured cabling and fiber optic systems, including installation methods, termination, testing, certification, and the applicable ANSI/TIA, BICSI, and NEC standards.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction documents — architectural, electrical, and telecommunications drawings, riser diagrams, specifications, submittals, and RFIs.
  • Experience owning project financials, including change order negotiation and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Proficiency with project scheduling and collaboration platforms (MS Project, Smartsheet, Primavera P6, Procore, or equivalent) and strong spreadsheet skills.
  • Demonstrated success managing projects and field teams remotely, with a dedicated home workspace and reliable high-speed internet.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30% nationally, including overnight stays, and to access active construction sites.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States on a W-2 basis without current or future employer sponsorship.
  • Valid driver's license and an acceptable motor vehicle record.

Nice to Have

  • BICSI RTPM or RCDD certification; PMP or CAPM certification; OSHA 30-Hour Construction.
  • Manufacturer certifications (CommScope, Panduit, Corning, Belden, Leviton) and fiber test platform experience (Fluke Networks, VIAVI, EXFO, AFL).
  • Mission-critical environment experience: data centers, colocation, hyperscale build-outs, or hospital and healthcare campuses.
  • Experience with DAS/ERRCS, Wi-Fi infrastructure, access control and IP video, AV, fire alarm, nurse call, or building automation scopes.
  • Government, federal, E-Rate, or prevailing-wage and certified-payroll project experience.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish.

Travel and Working Conditions

Travel averages approximately 30% of working time — typically two to six days per month, occasionally more during mobilization, cutover, or closeout. Travel is scheduled in advance around project milestones and is not on-call; overnight stays are typical, and occasional Sunday departures or Saturday returns may be required to meet Monday-morning mobilization or weekend cutover windows. All business travel expenses are paid by the company under the corporate travel and expense policy.

Home-office work involves prolonged sitting and computer use with frequent video conferencing. Job-site work involves standing and walking on active construction sites and uneven surfaces, climbing stairs and ladders, bending, stooping, kneeling and reaching, occasional lifting up to 40 pounds, work at heights and in confined spaces such as ceilings and telecom rooms, and wearing required PPE. Sites may involve noise, dust, temperature variation, and moving equipment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Conditions of Employment

After a conditional offer of employment, this position requires a background check appropriate to the role and to client site-access requirements, a motor vehicle record check, and substance screening where required by the company, by client contract, or by law. Some client sites require additional badging, security clearance, safety orientation, or health screening. Criminal history, where considered, is assessed individually — the nature and gravity of the offense, the time elapsed, and its relationship to the duties of this position; a criminal record does not automatically disqualify an applicant.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Our client is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or older), physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, veteran or military status, citizenship status where protected, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants with sincerely held religious beliefs, absent undue hardship, and we prohibit retaliation against anyone who reports discrimination or participates in an investigation.



Our client is an EEOC Employer and encourages all minority groups to apply.

By applying to this job, as part of our typical recruiting process, from time to time, we may contact you regarding positions that we feel are a good fit for you or engage with you during the recruiting process via SMS text message. Message and data rates may apply, depending on your mobile phone service plan. At any time you can get more help by replying HELP to these texts, or you can opt-out completely by replying STOP. About EVgo

EVgo (Nasdaq: EVGO) is one of the nation’s largest public fast charging networks for electric vehicles. Our mission is to build a sustainable business that powers our transportation and protects our planet. As a leader in clean transportation, EVgo sits at the intersection of technology, infrastructure, and innovation.

We are rapidly expanding our national footprint through strategic partnerships with retailers, automakers, rideshare and, fleets, bringing fast charging to communities across the country. EVgo enables drivers of all makes and models to charge where they want, when they want.

At EVgo, sustainability is not just what we do; it is who we are. We are committed to reducing carbon emissions, advancing clean energy solutions, and building infrastructure that supports a more sustainable future. We believe great companies are built by great people. Our culture is mission driven, customer centric, collaborative, and innovative, with a strong focus on creating an environment where employees can growand make a lasting positive impact. Join us as we charge forward.

Position Summary

The Grid Integration Manager leads utility coordination, grid integration strategy, and energy management initiatives for EVgo's fast-charging infrastructure. This role drives projects through utility design, engineering, and construction phases while ensuring technical feasibility, constructability, regulatory compliance, and timely energization. Working cross-functionally with Engineering, Deployment, Construction, Operations, and external utility partners, the Grid Integration Manager develops solutions that optimize charging performance, reduce capital and operating costs, and support reliable grid integration at scale.

Responsibilities

Grid Integration Strategy

  • Develop and execute grid integration strategies for EVgo charging infrastructure, considering grid capacity, demand response programs, distributed energy resources, and renewable energy opportunities.
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with electric utilities and regulatory agencies to facilitate project approvals and successful grid interconnections.
  • Identify and implement innovative solutions that improve charging station performance, reduce energy costs, and enhance grid reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop deployment strategies that optimize project economics and reduce capital expenditures.

Utility Infrastructure Development

  • Lead utility infrastructure planning and development activities, including site feasibility assessments, value engineering, and utility equipment requirements.
  • Coordinate with construction teams, utilities, contractors, and vendors to ensure timely and successful execution of utility-related work.
  • Maintain accountability for the quality and completeness of utility deliverables, ensuring robust QA/QC processes throughout development and construction.

Grid Interconnection Management

  • Partner closely with utilities to negotiate and execute interconnection agreements, coordinate engineering studies, and satisfy technical requirements.
  • Align stakeholders on utility sequencing and project execution to ensure seamless handoff from construction to energization.
  • Manage utility schedules and forecasting to support key project milestones, including Utility Release for Construction and Energization.
  • Provide technical leadership during interconnection negotiations, commissioning activities, and system testing.

Technical Analysis & Energy Management

  • Lead technical analyses, simulations, and modeling to evaluate grid integration scenarios and support early-stage site acquisition decisions.
  • Assess the impact of EV charging on electric distribution systems and develop mitigation strategies where necessary.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and energy management solutions that improve operational efficiency and long-term scalability.

Regulatory Compliance

  • Maintain current knowledge of industry regulations, utility standards, and applicable electrical codes.
  • Ensure all projects comply with regulatory requirements and industry best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Team Development & Knowledge Sharing

  • Provide technical guidance and subject matter expertise to junior engineers and cross-functional teams.
  • Share knowledge of utility processes, grid integration best practices, and regulatory requirements to build team capability.
  • Foster collaborative relationships that support continuous process improvement and successful project delivery.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned to support team and organizational objectives.

Qualifications

  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience.

Desired Skills

  • Experience in the electric vehicle, energy, consulting, or utility sectors.
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification.
  • Familiarity with Utility design, demand response programs, distributed energy resources, or battery energy storage systems.
  • Minimum 4+ years of related Utility experience, or equivalent work experience.
  • Equivalent technical education or training in a related field (e.g., certification program, coursework in electrical engineering or power systems, or demonstrated on-the-job learning) accepted in lieu of a formal degree.
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems, utility operations, project management principles, and energy management technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience with utility interconnection processes, utility requirements, and regulatory compliance.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce, Sitetracker, or comparable enterprise CRM/project management platforms.
  • Proficiency with engineering and design tools such as AutoCAD, Bluebeam, and Google Earth.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Up to 20% travel may be required for utility meetings, site visits, and cross-functional engagement.

Benefits and Perks

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus mental wellbeing support and wellness programs
  • Financial Benefits: 401(k), Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for medical and dependent care, life and disability insurance
  • Work-Life Support: Uncapped paid time off, enhanced parental leave, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Care Navigation & Support: Access to Health Advocate services for help with claims, provider searches, and care decisions
  • Flexible Care Options: Telehealth services for convenient, low-cost access to care
  • Growth & Development: Mentorship programs and opportunities for career growth and internal mobility
  • Additional Perks: Monthly Tech Stipend, one-time home office setup reimbursement, Volunteer time off, commuter benefits, and employee focused programs

In addition to a competitive base salary, we offer discretionary target cash bonuses, restricted stock units (subject to Board Approval), and a comprehensive benefits package including health, life, and disability insurance, unbounded paid time off including parental leave, and a 401(k).

In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop Workday integrations using EIB, Workday Studio, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and PECI.
  • Build inbound and outbound integrations connecting Workday with payroll, benefits, IT provisioning, finance, and analytics systems.
  • Develop XSLT transformations within Workday Studio integrations, applying disciplined templating practices, reusable helper libraries, and careful test coverage to keep complex mappings maintainable.
  • Implement integrations using Workday REST and SOAP web services where appropriate.
  • Design error handling, retry, and notification strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Develop and maintain integration system users, ISSGs, security configurations, and tenant-level setup for integrations.
  • Build and maintain calculated fields, custom reports, and report-as-a-service integrations.
  • Implement Workday business processes and condition rules that support integration logic, ensuring the upstream and downstream sides of each integration agree on routing, approvals, and state transitions.
  • Participate actively in Workday tenant refresh planning and integration regression testing, ensuring critical integration paths are exercised in lower environments before each tenant move and any drift is caught early.
  • Collaborate with HR, payroll, IT, and finance stakeholders to translate business needs into integration designs.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Support production incidents related to integrations and drive durable fixes.
  • Participate in Workday release planning and regression testing, reviewing upcoming feature changes for impact, scheduling validation cycles, and coordinating with stakeholders so adoption proceeds smoothly.
  • Stay current with Workday product releases and integration platform evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 12 or more years of Workday integration development experience.
  • Deep expertise in EIB, Workday Studio, and Core Connectors.
  • Strong XSLT skills and experience with Workday Studio orchestrations.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Strong understanding of the Workday data model and tenant configuration.
  • Experience with Workday security model including ISU/ISSG patterns.
  • Familiarity with calculated fields and custom report design.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Pro Integrations certification.
  • Experience with PICOF, PECI, or Cloud Connect for Payroll.
  • Familiarity with Workday Extend.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments.
  • Experience integrating Workday with major SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce).

raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Level 3 Engineer and Microsoft 365 Specialist to design, build, and strengthen internal technology platforms while delivering high-quality technical support across a diverse small-business client environment.

This is a hands-on position suited to an experienced MSP professional who combines strong technical capability with a practical builder mindset. The initial focus will be on enhancing internal systems, configuring and improving RMM and PSA platforms, strengthening documentation and service-management standards, and uplifting Microsoft 365 security and endpoint-management environments.

You will also provide Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 incident triage, incident management, and technical support while proactively identifying opportunities to improve security, scalability, automation, and service delivery.

About the Client

You will be working with a South Australian managed services provider supporting a carefully selected portfolio of small-business clients. The organisation combines enterprise-level technology expertise with a personalised, trusted-partner approach and is entering an exciting stage of growth.

As part of this growth, the business is strengthening its internal systems, tools, security controls, and service-management capabilities to deliver increasingly secure, structured, and scalable technology services.

Ideal Profile

Experience & Role Requirements

  • Minimum five years of relevant experience across IT engineering, systems administration, or technical support.
  • Demonstrated Level 3 capability within Microsoft 365 environments, including strong hands-on experience with Intune, Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot, and Microsoft Purview.
  • Previous experience working within a managed services provider environment.
  • Proven ability to design, implement, and support production systems rather than solely administer established environments.
  • Strong incident triage and incident-management experience across Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 issues.
  • Experience configuring or improving RMM and PSA platforms and associated workflows.
  • Working knowledge across networking, endpoint management, identity, security, backup, and SaaS administration.
  • Ability to audit technology environments, identify control or configuration gaps, and deliver structured remediation.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills with excellent technical documentation discipline.

Technical Skills

  • Strong Microsoft 365 administration and security expertise.
  • Hands-on capability with Microsoft Intune, Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot, and mobile device management.
  • Experience with Microsoft Purview, data loss prevention, and information/document classification.
  • Knowledge of RMM and remote-support platforms; NinjaOne experience is highly regarded, while TeamViewer familiarity is beneficial.
  • Experience configuring PSA platforms and service-management workflows.
  • Microsoft Azure capability, particularly virtual machine and terminal-server provisioning, is highly regarded.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 and SaaS backup solutions, including NinjaOne SaaS Backup, is advantageous.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant management solutions such as CIPP or Microsoft Lighthouse is advantageous.
  • Experience supporting Ubiquiti UniFi networking and Lenovo and HP desktop environments.
  • Sound understanding of SaaS concepts, cybersecurity controls, and secure administration practices.

Qualifications & Certifications

  • Relevant Microsoft certifications covering Microsoft 365, endpoint management, security, or Azure, or equivalent demonstrable technical capability.
  • ITIL certification is highly regarded, supported by practical knowledge of IT service management and change management.
  • A tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline is desirable.

Professional Attributes

  • Methodical, structured, and highly attentive to detail.
  • Proactive and self-directed, with the confidence to identify priorities and recommend improvements.
  • Strong commitment to clear, accurate, and maintainable technical documentation.
  • Practical builder mindset with ownership of solution quality, usability, and maintainability.
  • Comfortable balancing platform-development initiatives with client support requirements in a growing MSP environment.
  • Curious about AI, automation, and emerging technologies, with an ability to explore them responsibly.
  • Reliable and trustworthy when managing privileged access to client environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and continuously improve internal IT systems, tools, and service-delivery capabilities.
  • Build and administer remote monitoring and management environments, including supporting the transition toward NinjaOne and existing TeamViewer capabilities.
  • Configure and enhance PSA platforms and associated operational workflows.
  • Deliver Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 technical support, including incident triage and incident management.
  • Implement and administer Microsoft Intune, Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot, and mobile device management environments.
  • Configure Microsoft Purview capabilities, including data loss prevention and information/document classification.
  • Implement and maintain Microsoft 365 and SaaS backup solutions.
  • Support secure administration across multiple Microsoft 365 tenants using appropriate tenant-management platforms.
  • Assess and audit internal and client environments, identifying security, configuration, and control gaps and implementing structured improvements.
  • Support Microsoft Azure and broader systems-engineering activities, including virtual machine and terminal-server provisioning.
  • Configure and support Ubiquiti UniFi networking environments and Lenovo and HP desktop devices.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, implementation records, standards, procedures, and change records.
  • Apply structured IT service-management and change-management practices across technical work.
  • Help strengthen client environments against relevant cybersecurity standards and controls, including SMB1001 Gold where applicable.
  • Explore practical applications of AI and automation to improve internal processes, service delivery, and client outcomes.
  • Proactively identify priorities, ask informed questions, and recommend improvements with limited day-to-day direction.

How we take care of our team

💰 Get paid in Australian Dollars

🏥 Medical insurance from day one for you + spouse (or parents if unmarried)
🩺 Generous OPD coverage from doctor visits to all your medical needs
🏡 Home office setup allowance to build your ideal workspace
🌐 Internet allowance to keep you connected
💪 Gym & wellness allowance to stay fit and balanced
🎉 Work hard, play hard – regular team events & engagement activities
🧠 Diji Assist – Mental health & counseling support when you need it
📚 We invest in you – reimbursement for industry certifications
🗣️ Open-door culture – your ideas and feedback always matter
🌍 Flexible work – home or office, wherever you do your best work
🏆 Rewards & recognition that actually recognize you
🥳 Great christmas & financial year-end parties to unwind with your loved ones

raw.description:
Join our growing Customer Success Team and support one of our largest partners.

We are looking for an entry-level, bilingual (English/Spanish) Customer Success Manager (CSM)/ School Experience Manager (SEM) with significant K-12 instructor and leadership experience.

You'll own some of our largest and most complex client relationships: an international school group with significant scale and a multi-product footprint across the Faria product suite.

This is an enterprise client experience role: you'll manage executive relationships, navigate multiple stakeholders across the group, and operate at both the HQ and individual school levels simultaneously. You'll be the single point of accountability for the group you own, coordinating Sales, Support, Product, and Implementation to deliver a unified experience for the client.

What you'll do

Executive relationship management

  • Own the senior stakeholder relationship at group HQ level, including C-suite and Director-level contacts across curriculum, operations, and technology
  • Lead executive business reviews and annual strategic reviews, articulating ROI and aligning our roadmap to the group's educational priorities
  • Build multi-threaded relationships across regions and school campuses, identifying and developing internal champions at each level
  • Maintain continuity of relationship through leadership transitions, proactively managing champion turnover risk

Account strategy and growth

  • Develop and own a multi-year account plan for each group, covering retention, product expansion, and NRR growth targets
  • Identify and qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across the group's school network
  • Partner with Sales on commercial negotiations, group-level agreements, and multi-year contract structures
  • Track product adoption at both group and school level, intervening proactively where usage is low or champion knowledge has eroded

Retention and risk management

  • Lead back-to-green plans for at-risk schools within the group, coordinating with Support, Product, and regional SEMs as needed
  • Monitor competitive risk and develop targeted responses in partnership with CE leadership and Product Marketing
  • Escalate retention risks early with a recommended action plan

Internal coordination

  • Act as the primary internal coordinator for group accounts — the single point of contact and accountability within Faria for each assigned group
  • Coordinate with regional SEMs where a group has schools in multiple regions, ensuring consistency of experience and a unified Faria voice
  • Brief Support on escalations and liaise with Product on feature gaps affecting the group, mobilizing internal resources when needed
  • Act as the senior relationship owner for new school onboarding within the group, ensuring client experience is right from day one

Change management and adoption

  • Coordinate implementation, product adoption, and rollout plans with internal teams — Implementation, Support, Product, and regional SEMs — so onboarding leads smoothly into steady-state usage across the group
  • Act as the change management lead for the client during major rollouts, aligning internal teams and client stakeholders on timelines, training needs, and communication
  • Partner with Implementation and Support to translate rollout plans into adoption milestones, and track usage against those milestones at both group and school level
  • Proactively identify adoption gaps or change-fatigue risk within the group and mobilize the right internal team to address them
  • Keep internal teams aligned on a single rollout and adoption narrative for the group, so the client experiences one coordinated voice from Faria

Operational

  • Maintain accurate stakeholder maps, health scores, renewal risk, and account plans in Salesforce and Planhat
  • Contribute to portfolio health reviews and board-level reporting on strategic accounts

What we're looking for

  • Remote with potential for 20% travel to school/organizational sites
  • Fluent in both Spanish and English
  • Willingness to work EST hours and support calls primarily during European time zones.
  • Comfort coordinating across internal teams (Sales, Support, Product, Implementation) without formal authority over them
  • Previous school leadership experience (i.e., principal, director, coordinator, department chair, etc.)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with account planning, renewal risk management, and commercial negotiation
  • Familiarity with CRM and customer success platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Planhat) or equivalent tools
  • A track record of managing senior, multi-stakeholder relationships, including executive business reviews

*Career development and other business needs occasionally present themselves, even for non-traveling roles; therefore, we ask all Faria Education Group employees to maintain a valid passport.

Full training will be provided during induction, and further training will be provided throughout your employment to assist in advancing your career with Faria Education Group.

Equal Opportunities: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or sex.

Please note:Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to a high volume of applicants.

BENEFITS

  • $50,000 - $70,000 annual salary (with additional OTC earnings potential)
  • PTO (15)
  • Holidays (12)
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Retirement Savings

ABOUT FARIA EDUCATION GROUP

At Faria Education Group, we are dedicated to reaching every learner and inspiring every educator. As the trusted partner of over 10,000 schools and 4 million students in 155 countries, we lead the way in international education systems and services.

We offer an integrated suite that supports all aspects of curriculum management, teaching and learning, admissions, and school-to-home communications. With an unwavering commitment to innovation, our technology is designed with rigorous standards for data protection and security, ensuring first-class training and support for modern international schools.

Through our innovative online courses and revision programs, we provide comprehensive educational experiences. Our offerings include the IB Diploma and Cambridge online courses, bringing high-quality education to schools and homes worldwide.

Join us in our commitment to transforming education and empowering communities globally. Explore our services, including ManageBac, OpenApply, Atlas, SchoolsBuddy, Pamoja, Vectare, Wolsey Hall, and Oxford Study Courses.

Salary: $60-70,000 annually

Description

Hypernative is the leader in real-time threat prevention for Web3. We empower protocols, bridges, and DeFi platforms to detect and prevent exploits before they happen. Our platform is trusted by leading crypto-native organizations to protect billions of dollars in on-chain value. Backed by world-class investors and experiencing rapid growth, we’re building a customer-centric organization that helps our customers stay safe, agile, and ahead of threats.

We’re looking for a Senior Security Solutions Engineer for a hands-on, customer-facing role, working directly with our US-based customers to implement and optimize their security operations using the Hypernative platform.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role that works closely with our US team to support customers throughout the day. You'll be embedded directly in customer environments: configuring and customizing the Hypernative platform, scripting integrations and custom monitoring logic in Python, and guiding customers through implementation and day-to-day use of our security tools.

If you're passionate about blockchain and cybersecurity and looking for a challenging, customer-facing role with a dynamic, innovative team, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Risk Strategy - assist customers in conducting thorough analyses of their Web3 assets, evaluate their security postures, and assess associated risks; advise on optimal configurations for risk monitoring tools; and develop comprehensive monitoring and response plans covering preventive measures, detection techniques, and incident response strategies
  • Customer Collaboration and Support - maintain continuous communication with customers, keeping them informed of potential security issues and shifts in the threat landscape
  • Partner Collaboration - work with technology and ecosystem partners on joint integrations and solutions that support customer environments
  • Training and Enablement - deliver security training and enablement sessions to client teams, from technical staff to non-technical stakeholders
  • Sales Support - support Sales on professional services scoping, proposals, and technical positioning
  • Implementation and Configuration - configure and customize the Hypernative platform for each customer's environment, including custom rules, integrations, and Python scripting, and provide hands-on support to ensure security practices integrate cleanly with existing workflows

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • In-depth understanding of Web3 technologies, decentralized systems, and blockchain security concepts
  • Advanced understanding of cybersecurity principles, best practices, and industry standards as they apply to digital assets and blockchain technologies
  • Working proficiency in Python for scripting, integrations, and custom monitoring logic
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively, including with external partners
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex security concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven track record of effective customer-facing engagements, with patience, professionalism, and a customer-first attitude

raw.description:
Who we are:

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.


We support 100% remote work for this role!


We’d love to hear from you if:

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Manager, Media Investment you will focus on:


Client‑Centric

  • Lead Media Investment planning and execution for your accounts across TV, OTT/CTV, OLV, Audio, and Display; ensure plans align with client goals and full‑funnel strategies with clear trade‑offs, channel roles, pacing, and investment recommendations.
  • Co‑present investment recommendations and performance updates in client touchpoints alongside Senior Buyers/TVAD/Client Partners; explain marketplace conditions and partner performance in clear, business‑friendly language.
  • Identify opportunities for strategic expansion, optimization, and campaign growth, bringing pragmatic ideas and clear rationale to your leads and clients.

Product‑Led

  • Maintain stronghands‑on‑keys skills in relevant platforms (DSPs, research/planning tools, ad servers) and lead by example in how to set up, QA, and optimize buys.
  • Guide your team in using platform features and partner capabilities (e.g., premium inventory, audience/data tools, packaging options, automation) safely and effectively; help structure small, low‑risk tests.
  • Assist in evaluating new partner offerings and opportunities; summarize pros/cons and suitability for your accounts; support Senior Managers and Directors in deciding what to test or adopt.

Data & Measurement‑Driven

  • Review campaign performance data (spend, delivery, reach, CAC/ROAS, quality metrics such as viewability/IVT) regularly; help your team turn data into clear “what’s happening” and “what we should consider doing” statements.
  • Work with TVAD and Analytics/Econometrics to apply basic incrementality/lift learnings and MMM pointers in your investment decisions; understand when to lean in, hold steady, or pull back.
  • Own and oversee QA and delivery hygiene on your accounts: make sure your team catches and addresses under‑delivery, tagging/trafficking errors, quality issues, and contract compliance, and that fixes are documented.

The Tinuiti Way

  • Apply Tinuiti’s buying, negotiation, and stewardship playbooks; ensure your team follows standards for brand safety/verification, viewability/IVT, frequency/overlap, and QA.
  • Serve as a go‑to resource in at least one area of the TV/audio/display landscape; help your team understand how marketplace changes (formats, pricing, data, quality) impact your accounts and decisions.
  • Keep yourself and your team current on media trends through publisher meetings and independent research; share meaningful updates and opportunities with internal partners.


Owner Mindset

  • Love Growth: Support and sometimes lead the design of growth plays (inventory upgrades, new partner packages, data audiences) within your accounts; help define what success looks like and how your team will run and read the test.
  • Hate Waste: Challenge and improve economics (rates, added value, guarantees) and quality on your accounts; ensure your team isn’t repeating the same issues and that basic processes (orders, QA checklists) are followed.
  • Take ownership of moderately complex, cross‑account projects (e.g., updating rate cards, refining QA templates, rationalizing partners for your cluster of accounts) that improve how Media Investment operates day‑to‑day.

People Leader

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a small team of Associates/Senior Associates/Buyers; set clear goals and expectations, give regular feedback, and help team members grow their skills and responsibility.
  • Review your team’s work before it goes to Senior Managers or Directors, TVAD, or clients; coach on both detail and judgment.
  • Help your team balance workload and priorities; teach them when to solve problems themselves and when to escalate; model a collaborative, solution‑oriented mindset.

Professional Qualifications:

  • Experience: 5–7+ years of experience in a media agency or publisher environment, focused on media buying in linear TV, OTT/CTV, digital audio, and/or display; exposure to related channels (commerce, OOH, experiential, paid social) is a plus.
  • Proven track record of leveraging partner relationships and marketplace knowledge to negotiate and execute high‑value media opportunities; demonstrable, ongoing relationships with key media salespeople.
  • Experience leading a small team of individual contributors (formally or as a strong de facto lead); comfortable balancing hands‑on work with team oversight.
  • Direct hands‑on‑keys experience in industry platforms (e.g., DSPs, research/planning tools, ad servers) with the ability to coach others on correct usage and QA.
  • Baseline knowledge of incrementality testing and in‑channel/cross‑channel measurement approaches (e.g., MMM pointers, ghost bidding, conversion lift); able to work with TVAD/Analytics to interpret partner studies and guardrails.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow‑through; demonstrated ability to oversee process and QA for both your own work and that of your team.
  • Self‑motivated, curious, and collaborative; asks good questions and supports a positive, problem‑solving team environment.
  • Working knowledge of strategic marketing and communication; able to help promote new media opportunities internally and, when appropriate, with clients.
  • Proficiency in Excel/Sheets and solid business writing and presentation skills; excellent time management across multiple projects and accounts.

The hiring salary range for this role is $85,000 - $100,000. We also offer an incentive pay program (RevShare) comprising a monthly variable revenue payment opportunity and a discretionary annual performance bonus.


Hiring salaries are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, parity with other team members, and alignment with market data. We will provide more information on our benefits, incentive pay, and equity upon request. Disclosure as required by the Colorado Equal Pay for > Equal Work Act, C.R.S. § 8-5-101 et seq.

FLSA Classification: Exempt

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. raw.description:
What is the position?

As a Scrum Master, you love contributing to the in-depth growth of development teams brought together for our clients. You will focus on the agile process of the team, support this process by making it more efficient and improving collaboration. In a nutshell, your most important task is to facilitate a good development process of the team. You enthuse the team to follow specific methodologies and solve any roadblocks the team encounters within their process. You also coach the team in their agile abilities and answer any process related questions from both the team as well as other stakeholders.

What are you going to do?

You will be part of a young and growing organization that aims to develop the best cross-platform mobile apps out there. As a Scrum Master, you’ll be responsible for creating a team spirit within a group of developers. You’ll act as a link between our developers, clients and third parties and keep the focus on the end goal. In addition, you’ll ensure that you will keep an open attitude but remain critical to make sure requirements are met for the customer while keeping everyone informed on project progress, status, schedule, deadlines, and releases.

You’ll be transparent and open about the choices made and to be made. You’ll know the ins and outs of the market and translate this into user stories. You’ll also be realistic and pragmatic and willing to cooperate.

Who are we looking for?

For this position, we are looking for someone who has very strong communication skills, experience with a role as a Scrum Master in an Agile work environment and an interest in the world of app development.

Ideally, you have some (Xamaring, C#, .NET) programming experience and you have at least two years’ experience in a comparable position. A PSM II certification is a big plus! You should also be aware of the ins and outs of the market and be able to translate this to user stories. Last but not least, you have a completed Masters Degree or equivalent.

Who is XABLU?

XABLU is a leader in cross-platform mobile app development and consultancy. From boosting our clients’ development teams to helping them refine their mobile strategy: we are there to support them with all of their app development needs. In addition, we host events where developers can talk about technology, hack and socialize. We are known for our deep expertise in the Microsoft Xamarin mobile ecosystem as well as our signature friendly and efficient team approach.

We also have internal projects we are developing: one is a user-centered platform combined with blockchain, and the other is a platform with a lot of automation challenges!

XABLU is a remote-first company: team and communication are our top priority and we embrace different cultures as well as different geo-locations. At XABLU, you’ll be working in an environment where you can express your talents, ideas and personality. You’ll be pushed by your colleagues to develop yourself and the team in an informal and fun atmosphere.

Your Profile

  • Experience with a role as Scrum Master
  • Strong communication skills
  • Interest in app development
  • Enjoy managing people and projects
  • Good at prioritizing and planning
  • Ideally, programming experience
  • Completed Master Degree or equivalent
  • Prefarably having PSM II certification or willing to obtain it
  • Used to working with a team and to build up dynamics
  • Available for 32-40 hours per week
