raw.excerpt: Infinite Electronics powers a global portfolio of specialized connectivity companies delivering reliable engineered solutions worldwide.
raw.description:
Infinite Electronics powers a global portfolio of specialized connectivity companies delivering reliable engineered solutions worldwide. Built as a unified platform for speed, scale, and reliability, the company combines shared infrastructure, best-in-class logistics, and deep engineering expertise to support mission-critical connectivity needs. Through scalable global operations and rapid development capabilities, Infinite helps customers accelerate innovation and bring new ideas to market. Our companies offer strong value-added solutions across several areas, including power distribution, surge protection, EMP, RF, cables, fiber optic solutions, connectors, sensors, and antennas. This broad product portfolio is supported by robust engineering capabilities and vertically integrated global manufacturing operations. Infinite Electronics is the first choice for customers across various markets, including telecommunications, industrial, military, energy, medical, transportation, and data centers.

Founded in 1967, Transtector is one of the most established and trusted companies in the surge protection industry. A pioneer in integrated power systems, Transtector is known for precision engineering and patented innovations that perform in the harshest conditions while protecting against surges, EMI, and EMP events. Through its engineering-focused approach, Transtector coordinates multiple protection components and connectivity technologies to deliver high-performing, integrated solutions that meet even the most stringent industry standards.

Since 1979,PolyPhaser has defined the global standard for RF surge protection and grounding. Trusted in first-responder two-way radio networks, defense mobile systems, telecom radio, GPS systems, utility SCADA, FAA air traffic systems, and rail communication systems, PolyPhaser supports secure delivery of mission-critical signals and data. For decades, PolyPhaser has been the standard for RF surge protection and performance.

Position Description:

The Business Development Manager is responsible for developing new business, expanding market presence, and driving incremental revenue growth through proactive customer engagement, opportunity development, and strategic account penetration. This role identifies and pursues new opportunities across the Transportation/Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) markets, promotes cross-brand solutions, and builds strong relationships to position Transtector/PolyPhaser as the preferred partner. Candidates must stay current on industry trends, products, competitors, and standards to leverage that insight in creating account plans and driving consistent execution from prospecting through to winning new customers. Success requires strong technical sales capability, disciplined opportunity management, and the ability to influence engineers, product line managers, executives, and key customer stakeholders. The ideal candidate brings an established network of contacts, strong technical presentation skills, accurate forecasting, and a track record of profitable quota attainment.(Preferred Location: Remote near Tampa FL)

General Duties and Responsibilities:

Revenue Growth

  • This is a new logo, market-development sales role requiring a proven hunter who can open doors, create demand, build a pipeline from scratch, and convert technical opportunities into revenue. The ideal candidate has demonstrated success prospecting into state and local DOTs, ITS integrators and contractors, traffic and tolling OEMs, engineering and design firms, and system integrators serving the transportation market.
  • Develop new business opportunities across targeted market segments through proactive prospecting, solution positioning, and opportunity qualification. Experience with ITS field infrastructure, traffic signal cabinets and controllers, roadside cabinets and enclosures, dynamic message signs (DMS), CCTV and detection systems, ramp metering, tolling and electronic toll collection (ETC), connected and autonomous vehicle (CAV/V2X) roadside units, ITS communication networks (fiber, Ethernet, wireless/cellular), GPS timing, traffic management centers (TMCs), and power protection, surge protection, and grounding for roadside and intersection equipment.
  • Execute strategic account penetration plans to expand Infinite Electronics’ company presence within key industrial OEMs, integrators, contractors, and end-user accounts. Target state and local Departments of Transportation (DOTs), municipal and county traffic and public works agencies, toll authorities, transit agencies, ITS and traffic OEMs, traffic signal and cabinet manufacturers, ITS system integrators and contractors, transportation engineering and design firms, and distributor partners serving the ITS market.
  • Promote cross-selling with all IE products that address customer needs for multiple applications and leverage custom-engineering capabilities with an integrated solution.
  • Build and maintain strong customer and channel relationships to position products and companies as a preferred partner.
  • Gather, interpret, and communicate market insights, competitive intelligence, and emerging opportunities to internal stakeholders.
  • Work closely with Product Management, Marketing, and Inside Sales to support the product to market with customers.
  • Generate leads and set qualified meetings through trade shows, participation in key organizations/groups, and social selling (LinkedIn), converting engagement into pipeline.
  • Secure specification positions with customers that convert into measurable revenue and recurring opportunities.
  • Influence purchasing decisions through third parties (e.g., integrators), distributors, and end customers to drive pull-through demand and win preferred positions.
  • Prospect and develop new opportunities through outbound activity, strategic outreach, and convert qualified leads into active quotes.
  • Build and execute account and territory plans with sales leadership, defining target accounts, pipeline goals, key pursuits, customer QBRs, and the actions required to achieve quota.
  • Own RFQs and quoting from intake to close, answering technical/availability questions, delivering timely quotes, negotiating pricing with margin discipline, and following up to secure purchase orders.
  • Consistently meet or exceed revenue and profitability quotas for the assigned territory and account base.

Reporting

  • Maintain CRM hygiene and provide weekly sales activity reports, forecasts, pre/post-travel summaries, and a pipeline funnel. Use competitive and performance insights to improve conversion rates and adjust strategy.
  • Pipeline review weekly with direct manager. Monthly and quarterly review with senior leaders reviewing new customer targets, pipeline, new quotes, YTD performance, and sales forecast (upcoming month, quarter, and 12 months).

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a technical/vocational field.
  • 10+ years of sales experience in the Transportation/ITS market, including experience working with state and local DOTs, intelligent transportation systems (ITS), and OEM equipment companies that support the ITS market.
  • Established relationships with key industry leaders, governing agencies, and industry organizations in the market (Ex. ITS America, ITE, IBTTA, AASHTO, state and regional ITS chapters).
  • Strong interpersonal skills, sound business judgment, a customer-focused mindset, and a proven track record of delivering revenue growth.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and professionally in English.
  • Strong proficiency and working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Ex, Excel, Word, & PowerPoint), CRM, and ERP.
  • Experience working successfully in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

Performance Goals:

  • Achieve a revenue goal for new customers with $625K per quarter with a 12-month revenue goal of $2.5M. Grow existing base business by 10% YoY with new products or new projects.
  • First 30 Days
  • Present on the company and general overview of products, outlining key value with differentiators to FAE and sales manager.
  • Learn about all key competitors and market dynamics.
  • Do an introduction call with all existing customers.
  • First 60 Days
  • Develop a target list of 25 new customers for prospecting.
  • Visit three new targets or existing customers by the end of 60 days.
  • First 90 Days
  • Develop an additional target list of 25 new customers for a total of 50 new targets.
  • Present account plan and pipeline review of existing and new accounts.
  • Build a pipeline of $250k in new opportunities.

Preferred Leadership and Professional Attributes:

  • Successful candidates are solution-oriented, collaborative, and accountable for results while exhibiting ownership and urgency.
  • Dependable, accountable, and consistent in follow-through.
  • Highly organized with strong time management and prioritization skills.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, reliability, and sound judgment.
  • Detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Able to perform effectively under deadlines and changing business needs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and commercial teams.
  • Maintains a professional presence and represents the organization effectively in internal and external settings.
  • Demonstrates ownership, urgency, collaboration, accountability, and a solutions-oriented approach.

Physical/Environmental Requirements

  • Frequently remains in a stationary position and occasionally moves about the office or worksite to access files, supplies, or attend meetings.
  • Frequently uses hands and fingers to operate office equipment such as a keyboard, mouse, telephone, and other standard office tools.
  • Must be able to visually assess information on screens, documents, and reports.
  • Frequently reads, interprets, and analyzes written and visual information.
  • Occasionally lifts or moves items up to [10–15] pounds (e.g., files, laptop, meeting materials).
  • Must be able to effectively communicate information and ideas in person, via video conference, and through written communication.
  • Works primarily in an office or remote office environment with standard business equipment.
  • May require extended periods of screen time.
  • May occasionally be required to attend meetings or events outside of normal workspace or business hours.

Work Environment

This role may be either remote or at an office location. Employees may work from their home office and regularly collaborate with colleagues across various company sites during normal or extended business hours, as needed. Office-based work depends on an employee's proximity to an Infinite facility and may be determined by management. Travel is part of this role’s responsibilities, including customer visits, supplier meetings, industry conferences, and internal gatherings.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Infinite Electronics is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to building a diverse workforce and actively encourage women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans to apply.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About Monaire
​
Monaire is building the infrastructure layer for intelligent commercial HVAC. We combine on-device sensors, smart thermostats, and machine-learning systems to automate control, surface real operational insight, and materially reduce energy waste at scale.

This is not offline modeling or notebook ML. Models run in production, interact with physical systems, and must be observable, debuggable, and correct. The platform spans edge devices, cloud services, streaming pipelines, control logic, and ML inference.

Engineers here work on:

  • Data ingestion and streaming at scale from heterogeneous hardware

  • Low-latency decision pipelines and control loops

  • ML systems that survive missing data, drift, and adversarial real-world conditions

  • Infrastructure for model deployment, monitoring, and rollback

  • Apps and services that customers depend on to run their buildings every day

The market is large, broken, and technically underserved. We’re scaling the system and need engineers who care about correctness, performance, and ownership — people who want to build infrastructure that actually controls the physical world, not just dashboards that look good in demos.

Role Overview

As aSenior Backend Engineer, you will design and buildhigh-scale, cloud-native backend systemsthat power real-time monitoring, analytics, and automation for commercial HVAC/R operations.

You will takeend-to-end ownershipof critical services, influence architectural decisions, and mentor other engineers while working closely with product, data, and infrastructure teams. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoysolving complex distributed systems problemsand want to see their work have real-world impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and operatescalable backend servicesfor a high-growth SaaS platform

  • Own theend-to-end lifecycleof services—from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and optimization

  • Build and evolvedistributed, event-driven microserviceshandling high-volume data and real-time workflows

  • Ensurehigh availability, reliability, performance, and securityof production systems

  • Drive architectural decisions aroundAPIs, data models, service boundaries, and system integrations

  • Leadprototyping and proof-of-conceptsfor new ideas, features, and platform capabilities

  • Collaborate closely withfrontend, data, DevOps, QA, and product teamsto deliver cohesive solutions

  • Identify technical debt and proactively improve system design, developer experience, and operational excellence

  • Mentor and guide other engineers throughcode reviews, design discussions, and best practices

Thrive in a fast-paced startup environment with high ownership and accountability

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • 4–6 yearsof experience building and operatingmedium to large-scale backend systems

  • Strong hands-on experience withGo, Python.

  • Proven experience designingcloud-native, distributed systemsfor SaaS platforms

  • Strong understanding ofmicroservices architecture, REST APIs, and asynchronous processing

  • Experience withSQLandNoSQLdatabases

  • Excellent grasp ofcomputer science fundamentals(data structures, algorithms, complexity)

  • Expertise indebugging, performance tuning, and production issue resolution

  • Experience writingclean, maintainable, well-documented code

  • Solid experience withDockerandAWS

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams

  • Self-driven mindset with the ability tolearn, adapt, and lead by example

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Hands-on experience withKubernetesand container orchestration

  • Experience withmessage queues and streaming systems(Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, Kinesis)

  • Exposure tobig data and workflow platforms(Spark, Flink, Airflow)

  • Experience withAPI gateways(Kong, Ambassador),service meshes, orVault

  • Familiarity withcaching systems, distributed tracing, logging, and monitoring stacks

  • Experience building and maintainingCI/CD pipelinesand automated deployments

  • Prior experience inIoT, telemetry, time-series data, or industrial systems

  • Startup or0→1 product-building experience

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree inComputer Science, IT, or a related fieldfrom a reputed institution


Benefits

  • Competitivesalary + equitywith meaningful ownership

  • Comprehensivehealth insurance(self, spouse, children, and parents)

  • Remote-first, flexible work culture

  • Opportunity to work onhigh-impact systems with climate and sustainability impact

  • Strong emphasis onengineering excellence, ownership, and growth

  • ​Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego team culture

  • Almeno 8 anni di esperienza complessiva, di cui minimo 4 anni nel ruolo di Project Manager.
  • Laurea magistrale in discipline tecnico-scientifiche (Ingegneria, Informatica, Matematica, ecc.) oppure cultura equivalente.
  • Certificazioni (almeno una, obbligatorie):
    • PMI/PMP
    • IPMA
    • ISIPM o certificazioni equivalenti

Requisiti preferenziali

Saranno considerati titoli preferenziali:

  • AgilePM® / Scrum Master
  • ITIL 4
  • TOGAF
  • PRINCE2®
  • COBIT

Competenze richieste:

  • Ottima conoscenza dei principi di Project Management, metodologie tradizionali e agili
  • Capacità di coordinare team multidisciplinari
  • Competenze nella gestione del rischio, monitoraggio e controllo dei progetti
  • Esperienza nellutilizzo di strumenti di gestione progetti (es. MS Project, JIRA, Trello, ecc.)
  • Spiccate capacità comunicative, problem-solving e leadership

Sede di lavoro: Non vincolante

Modalità di lavoro: Remoto

Chi siamo:

Clariter, nata nel 2010, ha svelato le diverse sfaccettature dell'era digitale ben prima degli altri. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di guidare i Clienti nel tumultuoso ambiente competitivo odierno. Con la nostra suite unica di servizi, denominata QALYA®, promettiamo non solo soluzioni, ma anche risultati di business tangibili e misurabili.

I nostri Centri di Eccellenza QALYA® danno concretezza al ciclo di vita completo di un prodotto digitale, dalla comprensione del cliente alla realizzazione di soluzioni tecnologiche innovative, passando per test rigorosi di qualità e sicurezza.

L'intelligenza di un team transdisciplinare, l'energia di una community di crowdsourcing europea senza rivali e un ecosistema tecnologico all'avanguardia sono i nostri ingredienti segreti. Presenti in Italia, Regno Unito, Spagna e Portogallo, Clariter è il motore dell'innovazione continua.

Attraverso l'engagement operativo e l'apporto formativo della Clariter Academy, puntiamo a forgiare la leadership dei nostri clienti nella trasformazione digitale e nella sicurezza informatica.

Inclusione e pari opportunità:

raw.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • Lead and shape the QA function at the AI-native insurance platform of choice for the world's leading insurers
  • 100% remote, with a global, diverse team
  • Own quality strategy for a fast-growing product suite, with a direct line to the Head of QA and real influence over how we build

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 120 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

What You Will Do

Strategy, Process & Governance

  • Provide full oversight of the testing lifecycle across multiple teams and projects, defining and enforcing QA processes and standardizing tools, environments, and test coverage organization-wide
  • Establish and continuously refine QA processes, procedures, and standards for testing products before they go to market
  • Ensure scalable test infrastructure, and extend our testing capability into advanced domains including performance, security, and compliance testing
  • Identify systemic quality gaps and cross-team risks, run trend analysis on quality metrics, and anticipate issues that could affect release stability or timelines
  • Evaluate and resolve organizational blockers in QA workflows, balancing trade-offs and delivery timelines while protecting stakeholder satisfaction
  • Deliver executive-level QA insights — reports, dashboards, and strategic recommendations — to the Head of QA and cross-functional leadership

Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor QA Leads and senior individual contributors, fostering career growth, succession planning, and technical leadership across the QA organization
  • Distribute workload, set goals for QA Leads and their teams, and conduct performance reviews across the function
  • Drive continuous performance evaluation and improvement of QA teams — resolving conflicts, supporting morale, and building a culture of ownership, accountability, and excellence
  • Be the advocate for Agile testing and quality across the business, building quality awareness at every stage of the product lifecycle

Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Oversee QA engineers and Leads testing our products and implementing automation across cross-functional teams
  • Partner closely with engineering, product, and business analysts to shape requirements and comprehensive testing strategies
  • Participate in reviews of software requirements, design documents, and system architecture, ensuring testing requirements are addressed early
  • Manage and triage reported defects, and keep visibility over how features delivered by other teams interact across subsystems
  • Continuously improve and refactor our testing infrastructure and automated/regression frameworks to ensure reliability and scalability

What We Need

Experience & Leadership

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 8+ years of experience in software QA spanning both manual and automated testing of web and API applications, including at least 2+ years directly managing QA Leads, senior engineers, or a multi-team QA function
  • Experience in the insurance or a similarly regulated, complex industry is a strong plus
  • Proven track record establishing QA processes, tooling, and standards organization-wide, not just within a single team
  • Experience navigating executive-level reporting — comfortable turning quality metrics into insights and recommendations for senior leadership

Technical Depth

  • Deep understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes across the full testing lifecycle
  • Experience implementing and scaling automated testing frameworks in an agile environment, with deep understanding of BDD and Gherkin
  • Hands-on familiarity with testing tools for JavaScript and .NET such as Jest, Mocha, JMeter, Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer, NUnit, Cucumber, Telerik, Specflow, or similar, and how to integrate them with CI
  • Proficient with defect tracking and test management tooling, with strong experience setting up QA processes and running structured performance reviews
  • Working knowledge of performance, security, and compliance testing domains
  • Practical experience building and rolling out AI-powered processes across teams or workflows

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • 100% Remote Work
  • 15 Days of Annual Leave
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Stock Options after 6 months
  • Company Activities and Events
  • Learning and Development Plan

We are looking for an SAP SuccessFactors HCM Consultant to support implementations and provide ongoing support for our customers. This is a permanent role which is fully remote, and the consultant will work from home with occasional travel.

  • Manage the relationship with the customer throughout the implementation/support process
  • Train end-users on specific processes and applications
  • Provide post-implementation support services including incident management, release management, and enhancement requests
  • Work with team members to facilitate successful integration between modules
  • Transfer knowledge to the customer for on-going maintenance & support
  • Keep abreast of upcoming SAP releases and features
  • Maintain certifications in your respective area(s) of expertise

  • A relevant degree/diploma in HR/IT
  • Associate or Professional level certification in one or more of the following SAP SuccessFactors modules:

    • SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding
    • SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Core
    • SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management
    • SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll
    • SAP SuccessFactors Time off
    • SAP SuccessFactors Performance and Goals
    • SAP SuccessFactors Succession Management
    • SAP SuccessFactors Compensation
    • SAP SuccessFactors Career Development Planning and Mentoring
    • SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Analytics
    • SAP SuccessFactors People Analytics: Reporting

  • Detailed and results oriented individual who takes initiative to solve problems and overcome roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Knowledgeable in current HR policies, practices, and ability to anticipate future trends affecting the business from a systems and process perspective
  • Ability to elicit and document business requirements
  • Ability to communicate with team members and customers clearly, concisely, and confidently, both verbal and written
  • Ability to work on multiple initiatives simultaneously
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

You will be among the first remote professionals integrated directly into the company's core operations to build stronger systems, improve operational visibility, and protect executive bandwidth.

This is not a traditional administrative support role. As the Executive Assistant, you will serve as the owner's trusted right-hand partner, taking direct ownership of key financial, operational, and administrative workflows. You will bring structure to a fast-moving environment, managing cash flow, field receipts, communications, and SOP development without requiring constant supervision.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Core Requirements:

  • Experience: Proven track record as an Executive Assistant, Senior Administrative Assistant, or Operations Coordinator working directly with business owners.

  • Financial & Tech Mastery: Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online, bookkeeping, invoicing, accounts receivable, and expense/job-cost tracking.

  • Software Fluency: High proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word) and Google Workspace.

  • Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills; highly organized with obsessive attention to detail and accuracy.

🌟 Preferred / Highly Valued:

  • Experience supporting construction, civil engineering, trade, contracting, or field-service businesses.

  • Hands-on experience with construction-related job costing and managing high-volume project documentation.

  • Bilingual Spanish & English: Spanish proficiency is a strong advantage due to communication with trade partners and Hispanic clients.

🛠️ Tech Stack Used:

  • QuickBooks Online, Microsoft Outlook & Office, Google Workspace, VoIP telephony, Email/SMS.

About Us

The Virtual Preparatory Academy of Florida is a K–12 tuition-free online public school serving students statewide. At VPA Florida, we provide a safe and nurturing environment where every student has the opportunity to be understood and inspired through a customized learning path that includes live interactive sessions and personalized teacher support.

We are seeking teachers who are excited to create a rigorous and nurturing classroom environment that prioritizes student learning and social-emotional development. ACCEL Schools uses a cutting-edge 21st-century curriculum, which can be accessed online and through a variety of traditional methods. 

Please note – while this is an online school position and all instruction occurs virtually, travel and face to face attendance will be required several times per year to support in person state testing and student events.

Eligibility: Open to residents of Florida

About the Opportunity

  • Serve as the teacher of record and primary instructor in all core content areas and grade levels
  • Relentlessly work to meet all goals related to student achievement and culture as well as state specific academic accountability goals
  • Deliver highly effective live lessons via web conference based on student need, rooted in research-based instructional practices
  • Complete course set up for each course within the Learning Management System
  • Monitor student progress in asynchronous courses and provide feedback/grade assignments daily
  • Track and maintain contact with each student
  • Collaborate with Principal to create and deliver Progress Reports of Students
  • Review student level data frequently to inform instructional program adjustments
  • Differentiate instruction to meet the needs of all students
  • Utilize research-based best practices in both synchronous and asynchronous instruction
  • Create a joyful, caring, and loving classroom environment for all students
  • Integrate culturally responsive teaching practices into daily lessons and interactions with students, parents, and colleagues
  • Implement school-wide culture expectations and norms, inside the classroom and beyond
  • Communicate regularly with families regarding the academic and social-emotional growth of their child
  • Incorporate 21st century technology skills into daily classroom practice and team settings
  • Participate in the planning and implementation of non-instructional activities such as social events and field trips and attend these events in person
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively, humbly, and respectfully with all colleagues
  • Travel to support required face-to-face state testing annually
  • Perform other duties as assigned

  • Current State teaching license in appropriate content area
  • Knowledge of State Standards and Common Core Standards
  • Preferred two years’ experience teaching
  • High level of comfort working in a growth-focused coaching environment based on frequent observations, debriefs, action planning, and progress monitoring

We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

Career benefits – keep growing

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Primary Functions

Reporting to the Mobile Team Lead, the Quality Assurance Analyst’s key responsibilities will include:

  • Create, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts for new features, bug fixes, integrations, customer scenarios, and release validation, including functional, exploratory, regression, and developer work item testing.
  • Document, investigate, reproduce, track, and validate software defects, enhancement requests, and customer-reported issues in collaboration with developers, product owners, support staff, and other stakeholders.
  • Communicate release changes through clear release notes and demonstrations of new features for customers, peers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Use approved AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to support test planning, defect analysis, documentation, and release note drafting.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, testing standards, documentation, and release readiness practices.

Qualifications

Required Education/Experience

  • Experience testing software applications, creating and executing test cases, validating expected results, documenting defects clearly, and applying strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to write clear defect reports, release notes, and customer-facing documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively with developers, support staff, product stakeholders, and other cross-functional team members.
  • Strong knowledge of PC and LAN environments, primarily using Windows Server and Windows operating systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to use software tools for data entry, analysis, documentation, presentations, and calculations.
  • Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently in a remote team environment.

Preferred Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and database concepts.
  • Experience with client/server, web, and mobile applications, including iOS and Android platforms.
  • Experience testing public safety, law enforcement, records management, CAD, mobile computing, or field reporting software.
  • Experience working in an Agile software development environment.
  • Experience using issue tracking, test management, or work management tools such as Jira.
  • Experience with source control concepts or tools.
  • Experience with API testing, integration testing, data validation, or test automation is a plus.
  • Experience with public safety or law enforcement software is a plus; prior SmartCOP software experience is especially helpful.

Desired Job-Specific Competencies and Skills

  • Strong curiosity and persistence when investigating software behavior and reproducing reported issues.
  • Strong customer empathy and an understanding of the importance of reliable software in mission-critical public safety environments.
  • Ability to think from the perspective of end users, including officers, dispatchers, supervisors, records personnel, and support staff, and apply diagnostic and problem-solving skills to develop logical, documented recommendations with the appropriate teams.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into clear, actionable information for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to balance quality, release timelines, customer impact, and team priorities.
  • Openness to learning and responsibly applying AI-assisted tools to improve testing efficiency, documentation quality, and team productivity.

Salary range: $55,000 - $65,000 USD per year.

Responsible for the clinical operations of a project within a defined regional/global level. Provides oversight of project deliverables, assigned Clinical Research Associate (CRAs) and Investigator sites in accordance with the Monitoring Plan, Protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and local regulations. The COL acts as a primary liaison between the CRAs and the clinical project team. Additional responsibilities include project specific training of CRAs, conducting assessment visits with CRAs, implementation of enrollment and recruitment strategies, preparation of the monitoring plan and other structural documentation and the oversight of monitoring visit scheduling, site and monitoring performance metrics, issue escalation and corrective actions. The COL will develop study tools for site and CRA use, review visit reports, review and track protocol deviations, and support other objectives for clinical operations and the clinical project team.

Project Oversight

  • Overall oversight of (a group of) regional CRAs to ensure (site) compliance with study protocol, study plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines.
  • Monitoring support visits (Co-monitoring), per project requirements, to aid the site/CRA in the satisfactory performance and compliance with standards mentioned above.
  • May support clinical project team by providing oversight of study deliverables related to other departments (e.g. Data Management, TMF Operations, etc.)
  • Oversee regional startup and feasibility activities.
  • Assist in vendor management activities as required per project.

  • Assure compliance with high quality and timely project deliverables according to the project requirements and the monitoring plan.

  • Contribute to financial project management processes as applicable. May include but may not be limited to input on revenue recognition, site payments, and site pass-through expense review.

Project Liaison

  • Conduct regular global CRA calls with the monitoring and site management team, as well as individual/country CRA calls

💡 About Zack D. Films

Zack D. Films, a prominent YouTube channel known for its innovative and engaging content, is looking for highly skilled Contract 3D Animators to join the team. This is not an entry-level opportunity, we are seeking experienced artists capable of producing scroll‑stopping, top‑tier visuals that push the boundaries of animated shorts. We raise the bar every day, and we expect our animators to do the same.

🎬 Position Overview

As a Contract 3D Animator, you will collaborate with our producers to craft captivating 20–45 second 3D clips. These animations are a vital component of our storytelling, adding depth and excitement to our videos.

We’re hiring for multiple contract roles and welcome candidates from around the world. A strong understanding of the English language is required to ensure smooth communication and collaboration.

Please review the following videos, if you feel confident you could create something of similar or higher quality, we’d love to see your work:



🔍 Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with producers to conceptualize and produce high‑quality, visually striking 3D animations.

  • Deliver animations quickly without compromising quality. If the test project takes longer than one day to complete at a high standard, this role may not be the right fit.

  • Ensure all animations meet the creative vision of the channel and are delivered on schedule.

  • Maintain a high level of craftsmanship in character animation, camera work, lookdev, shader effects, and simulations.

📤 Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a rapidly growing team & one of the most viewed YouTube channels in the world.

  • Work on projects that reach hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide.

  • Opportunities for consistent work, week after week, all year round.

  • Join an online community of animators for support, collaboration, and shop talk.

💰 Compensation

We offer a flat rate per project.

Requirements

  • Proven, professional-level experience in 3D animation and editing.

  • Proficiency in character animation, camera work, lookdev, shader effects, and simulations.

  • Ability to work under deadlines and collaborate effectively with a remote team.

  • A creative thinker who can independently find unique solutions in their edits.

  • Blender proficiency is a major plus.

  • A test project is the preferred and most likely route to success

  • Applicants must indicate:

    • What software they are proficient in

    • Whether they are applying as a solo freelancer, a studio, or a collective

Test Project (Required to Apply)

Please find the test project here. (< Click the link to access)

Quick Details:

  • 📱 Aspect Ratio: 9:16

  • 💰 Pay: Unpaid test; if approved, you’ll begin working on paid projects

  • ⏰ Deadline: No set deadline, but sooner is better

What if I don’t want to do the test?

There is an alternative option: Submit one edited video under 60 seconds showcasing all of the following:

  • Original character animation

  • VFX / simulation capabilities

  • Lookdev abilities

  • Modeling abilities

This must be delivered as one single edited clip. No folders of individual clips will be reviewed. Links must be direct to the reel not to a general artist page.

Why is there an unpaid test?

Due to the one-of-a-kind nature of our videos, showreels and portfolios are often missing the proper examples needed to evaluate your potential with us. Not only is the test designed to show us everything we need to see, it's also been crafted to ensure a quick turnaround is possible, with most experienced artists completing it after a couple of hours.

What style should I follow?

Follow our YouTube Shorts style: Zack D. Films Shorts

What if I don’t have time right now?

No worries — you can return to the test whenever you're ready.

Can I deviate from the animation notes?

Yes! They’re there to guide you, but we love creative approaches that elevate the final product. This is your opportunity to impress us with smooth animation, great timing, and creative camera work.

Highlights

Collaborate with our producers to craft captivating 20-45 second 3D clips. These animations are a vital component of our storytelling, adding depth and excitement to our videos.

Summary:

We're hiring a Revenue Manager to own pricing strategy and revenue performance across a growing short term rental and hospitality portfolio.

This role is responsible for maximizing rate capture and RevPAR while protecting occupancy through data driven pricing decisions, demand forecasting, market intelligence, and disciplined revenue management.

We're looking for someone analytical, proactive, and highly accountable who has hands on experience managing pricing across short-term rentals, hotels, or multi unit hospitality assets.

What You'll Own:

  • Pricing strategy across the portfolio, including nightly rates, minimum stays, seasonal pricing, event pricing, gap-night strategy, and last-minute discounts.
  • Average Daily Rate (ADR) growth while protecting occupancy.
  • RevPAR growth across the portfolio.
  • Competitive positioning and market intelligence across different submarkets.
  • Demand forecasting based on seasonality, events, booking pace, and market changes.
  • Clear documentation and evaluation of pricing decisions and their results.

Core Responsibilities:

Revenue & Pricing Strategy

  • Manage pricing across a portfolio of short-term rental and hospitality units.
  • Set and optimize nightly rates, minimum-stay requirements, seasonal pricing, event pricing, and last minute discount strategies.
  • Develop unit level pricing strategies rather than relying solely on portfolio wide rules.
  • Continuously evaluate pricing performance and adjust strategies based on results.
  • Identify opportunities where additional rate or revenue can be captured.

Revenue Performance & Analytics

  • Monitor key performance indicators including occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), RevPAR, booking pace, and lead time.
  • Grow ADR against seasonally matched historical performance while protecting booking volume.
  • Use RevPAR as a key measure of overall portfolio performance.
  • Analyze large data sets and reporting to identify pricing opportunities and performance gaps.
  • Evaluate the impact of pricing decisions and adjust quickly when performance data indicates a change is needed.

Market Intelligence & Forecasting

  • Monitor comparable properties and competitor pricing across relevant submarkets.
  • Maintain a clear understanding of how properties are positioned against their competitive sets.
  • Identify demand softness and surges early enough to adjust pricing proactively.
  • Track local events, seasonality, booking patterns, and market changes that may impact demand.

Qualifications & Skills:

Required:

  • Hands on experience managing revenue and pricing for a portfolio of short-term rentals, hotels, or hospitality units.
  • Demonstrated experience owning pricing decisions and measuring their impact on revenue performance.
  • Strong understanding of occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, booking pace, and lead time.

  • Strong written English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively in a remote environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Streamline PMS.
  • Experience managing multi-market portfolios.
  • Experience pricing boutique hotels or multi-unit hospitality assets.
  • Experience managing both individual vacation rentals and larger hospitality properties.

Tools & Platforms:

As the Vice President of Sales and Marketing, you will be responsible for managing our key customer relationships and for expanding ZTR's reach Globally and within North America towards our targeted markets with respect to leading the global product market.

As a leader, you'll be providing inspiring and charismatic leadership for your respective teams, as well as cross collaborating with others to reach our company mission and objectives.

This position is a remote role, open to anywhere within the United States.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

Leadership

  • Develop the marketing DNA of ZTR by developing the market vision and strategies and all associated implementations
  • Foster relationships with key customers in a global space
  • Implement, execute and maintain sales processes designed to achieve and accelerate growth

Strategy

  • Identifying new business opportunities for further growth
  • Create analysis of activity to develop the most effective business plans and realistic and meaningful KPIs
  • Participate in strategic planning and collaborating with other departments
  • Present the strategic positioning of the ZTR portfolio to customers, partners, and market influencers

Business Development

  • Study industry trends and create an effective business plan based on commercial opportunities, while ensuring they are in line with organization’s objectives
  • Become ZTR's subject-matter-expert towards services, products and how clients and customers use them
  • Collaborating with the Product Marketing to create effective marketing collateral and translating solutions for market
  • Participate and lead in global expansions activities i.e. "C" - level customer meetings, industry trade shows, and other various marketing endeavors and campaigns

Who you are:

  • 10+ years of experience as a senior sales professional
  • 10+ years in a sales managerial related role, preferably selling to the Freight Railway industry experience is an asset
  • SaaS and services experience is an asset
  • Technically savvy with previous experience in Railway, Industrial Engineered Solutions or hard Products (i.e. Control Systems Solutions)
  • Proven ability to generate sales leads and leverage existing relationships
  • Experienced in managing agents or manufacturing representatives
  • Demonstrated charismatic leadership and coaching ability, collaborative spirit
  • Established strategic sales planning and execution experience for Commercial teams
  • Data-driven with strong analytical and quantitative skills as well as attention to detail

Why Choose ZTR?

ZTR offers a positive working environment and a group of friendly and talented industry leaders passionate about driving environmental and financial benefits for our clients. We value lateral moves as much as vertical promotions; we believe all roles should develop your skills, broaden your experience, and help you continue a journey to build a rewarding career at ZTR.

Company Overview

Founded in 2004, Applied Biological Materials (abm) Inc. is a global leader in cell biology and cell engineering, leveraging advanced technologies and model systems including CRISPR gene editing, iPSC technologies, and advanced cell models to support groundbreaking discoveries in Life Sciences and Drug Development. Our headquarters in Vancouver, Canada, spans over 30,000 sq. ft. of state-of-the-art wet lab and office space, serving as a hub for advanced R&D and global logistics. Based in Canada, abm operates internationally with locations in the United States, China, and France, serving academic, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, government, and research customers worldwide.

About the Role

As part of our continued expansion in the United States, abm is looking for a Sales Account Manager to manage and grow our U.S. West Territory, with a West Coast base location preferred. This role is responsible for managing and expanding existing customer accounts and developing new relationships across academic, biotech, pharma, CRO, government, and research institutions.

You will act as a key point of contact for customers in the region, identifying needs, proposing tailored solutions, and driving business growth. The ideal candidate will bring both sales expertise and a strong understanding of the life sciences sector, with a proactive, customer-first mindset. Experience selling cell lines, cell-based products, or related life science research products is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and expand customer accounts across the U.S. West Territory, including key life science hubs and academic, biotech, pharma, CRO, government, and research institutions
  • Identify new business opportunities and drive revenue growth
  • Build long-term relationships with researchers, laboratory leaders, procurement contacts, and other key decision-makers and influencers.
  • Conduct regular customer meetings, both virtually and in person, to understand research needs and identify opportunities for abm products and services.
  • Develop territory and account plans, prioritize high-potential customers, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
  • Identify customer needs and work with internal technical and product teams to recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Meet or exceed assigned revenue targets, sales KPIs, and territory growth objectives.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and activity information in the CRM system.
  • Collaborate closely with Technical Support, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and other internal teams to provide a strong customer experience.
  • Represent abm at regional conferences, trade shows, scientific meetings, and other customer-facing events.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activity and provide feedback to support commercial strategy.
  • Travel regularly within the assigned territory for customer meetings, conferences, and events, with occasional travel to other abm locations as required.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is an asset.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in business development, account management, or technical sales within the life sciences or biotechnology sector.
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. life science research, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical markets.
  • Experience selling cell lines, primary cells, cell-based products, research reagents, or related life science products is strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing customers within the Western U.S. and/or an established customer network in the region is an asset.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop customer relationships, identify sales opportunities, and grow revenue.
  • Strong interpersonal, presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Self-motivated and organized, with the ability to independently manage a geographic territory and competing priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
  • Willing and able to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.

Work Location

Employment Type

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: Annual USD $90,000 – $105,000, commensurate with relevant experience and qualifications
  • Eligible for a performance-based sales incentive plan
  • Paid time off and company holidays

Job Title: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator

Job Location: Washington, District Of Columbia, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

MCRA is part of IQVIA MedTech. As a trusted CRO and advisory partner, IQVIA MedTech and MCRA deliver integrated lifecycle solutions for the medical device and diagnostics industry. Together, we support innovation from concept to commercialization, offering expertise in regulatory strategy, clinical trial design and execution, market access, and post-market optimization. Our teams combine deep therapeutic knowledge with advanced data and technology to help clients make smarter decisions and thrive in the market. Join our team to help shape the future of MedTech.

Overview


The Lead Clinical Research Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting the execution of clinical research studies by coordinating and performing remote clinical activities in compliance with study protocols, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and Good Clinical Practice (GCP). This role is responsible for performing a variety of clinical procedures to collect, record, report, and interpret patient data for individuals enrolled in or seeking enrollment in clinical studies.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Adhere to SOPs and Manual of Procedures when conducting all study-related activities to ensure compliance and consistency. This includes maintaining a working knowledge of study-specific software applications and equipment.
  • Collaborate with the research team and study sites to identify, recruit, and virtually enroll eligible patients for clinical trials.
  • Collect, maintain, and securely store all relevant data associated with clinical research trials in accordance with regulatory and organizational standards.
  • Educate potential participants about clinical research trials, including study requirements, and manage the informed consent process through virtual interactions.
  • Assist with participant study compliance by providing guidance and reminders to ensure adherence to protocol requirements.
  • Conduct follow-up activities for clinical trials while maintaining adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.
  • Ensure patient safety by monitoring participants, reporting adverse events promptly, and ensuring compliance with IRB-approved protocols.
  • Support the research participant call center as assigned, handling inquiries and providing assistance.
  • Maintain professionalism in all interactions with research participants to foster trust and engagement.
  • Assist with study equipment management and reporting, ensuring proper tracking, functionality, and documentation.
  • Communicate effectively with MCRA clinical affairs staff and clients, providing updates and support under the guidance of senior MCRA staff as needed.
  • Perform additional duties and projects as assigned to support the success of clinical research operations.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required (preferably in a life sciences or healthcare-related field)
  • Experience: Minimum of three years of experience as a Clinical Coordinator or in a comparable clinical research role
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The potential base pay range for this role, when annualized, is $49,200.00 - $123,000.00. The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part-time). 3M Health Care is now Solventum

We are seeking a strategic and collaborative Procurement Project Initiatives Lead to drive key procurement initiatives aligned with our broader business priorities. This individual will play a critical role in developing and executing cross-functional project plans, optimizing process and defining standard work, shaping our procurement technology roadmap, and defining business requirements to enable operational excellence in a regulated, fast-paced medical device and pharmaceutical manufacturing environment

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As a Procurement Project Initiatives Lead, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

•Project Leadership:

Lead and manage end-to-end procurement-related initiatives, from concept through execution, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and on budget.

•Strategic Planning & Alignment:

Translate business goals into clear, actionable procurement strategies and project plans that align with overall company priorities and objectives.

•Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Partner effectively with internal stakeholders (e.g., Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory, Finance, and IT) to align procurement initiatives with broader operational and product development timelines.

•Technology Roadmap & Enablement:

Contribute to the development and execution of the procurement technology roadmap. Define and document requirements for systems, tools, and digital workflows to improve sourcing efficiency and visibility.

  • Master Data Product and Process Stewardship:

Support the business functional team in assessing the requirements and strategy around master data management for procurement and its associated governance. Work with the digital and IT teams on enablement of the future data architecture.

Serve as the primary communication bridge across departments, providing clear updates, managing stakeholder expectations, and ensuring project transparency at all levels.

Define and address key master data elements and ensure governance and performance indicators are clearly defined and measurable.

oBachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or related field and7+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain, or project management roles

Experience in medical device, life sciences, or regulated manufacturing industries.

o Experience with ERP and procurement systems (e.g., SAP, Coupa, Ariba).

o Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a proactive mindset.

o Ability to thrive in a dynamic, rapidly evolving environment.

Supporting Your Well-being

As a Technical Support Specialist, you’ll be a customer-facing member of our Tier 2 support team, handling product issues that require deeper troubleshooting or coordination beyond frontline support.

You’ll use company's procedures and diagnostic tools to investigate issues, guide customers through next steps by phone, email, and SMS, and coordinate with service partners when a field visit is needed. When an issue requires Engineering input, you’ll gather the relevant findings and provide a clear escalation. You’ll remain responsible for customer communication and follow-up as the case moves toward resolution.

What you'll own:

  • Troubleshoot known product issues with customers using company's procedures and diagnostic tools.
  • Ask effective diagnostic questions, document findings, and determine the appropriate next step.
  • Own assigned cases through resolution, including timely customer updates and follow-up.
  • Coordinate customers, service partners, and internal teams to arrange field visits and track outcomes.
  • Escalate complex issues to Engineering with a clear summary of symptoms, troubleshooting completed, and supporting information.
  • Maintain accurate case records in Zendesk, Jira, and other support systems.
  • Identify gaps or recurring issues and help improve troubleshooting procedures, support documentation, and tools.
  • Work closely with Customer Experience, Field, and Engineering as support processes evolve

Requirements

  • 3+ years in customer-facing technical support or remote troubleshooting. Hardware, connected devices, appliances, or field service experience is a strong plus.
  • Must have prior US-hours experience.
  • Has helped build or standardize processes (SOPs, macros, knowledge base, escalation paths). Can work in gray areas without a script.
  • Comfortable talking to both non-technical end users and engineers or field techs.
  • Individual contributor, not a team lead, but brings enough seniority.
  • Spanish/English bilingual is strongly preferred.

Nice to have:

  • HVAC experience is last on the nice-to-have list. Technical aptitude, critical thinking, and phone skills come first.

Benefits

Location: Remote in Central Arkansas - candidate will need to be located in Little Rock and surrounding areas (travel is expected to be up to 75% within the region)

Hiring Range: This position’s hiring range is anticipated to start at $58,656 annually, plus great benefits!

Prison Break. Breakout. Fixer Upper. This Old House.

Imagine if there was a job where day-to-day was a combination of these types of shows, but you were assisting dogs and cats to bust out of traditional shelters, where staff love them but often don’t have enough resources to save them. Then you get to share the resources we have to help the shelters enhance their facilities and programs.


So, not only do you get to help dogs and cats, but you also get to help the staff who try so hard and care so much by giving them support to improve their shelter, make their jobs more rewarding, and to save more animals.


Shelter Engagement Specialists are on the front line of lifesaving. They play a direct role in achieving Best Friends Animal Society’s no-kill mission by selecting and pulling animals from priority shelters, and then helping priority shelter partners make enhancements to their shelter as well as develop or enhance lifesaving programming.


We’re seeking someone who has experience working in animal shelters, is savvy with dogs, cats, and PEOPLE, loves problem solving, and is not afraid to get covered in fur to bring about the future of animal sheltering. Does this sound like a dream job to you? If so, apply today for the Shelter Engagement Specialist role and make that dream a reality!

Culture Statement and Responsibility: We believe in treating everyone with kindness and compassion, building trust through authenticity and following through on commitments. We prioritize well-being alongside our mission, fostering strong relationships through open communication and transparent feedback. Diversity and inclusion are integral to our culture, enriching team dynamics by valuing diverse perspectives. Each team member is responsible for creating an inclusive environment where all voices are respected and contributing to a workplace that embodies our shared values and commitment to progress. By consistently aligning our actions with our Guiding Principles, we strengthen our culture and ensure that our values are lived every day.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrate kindness and the Golden Rule in our everyday actions by practicing inclusion and respect for every person for the value they bring to the table. Be a role model for the spirit of authenticity, kindness, and positive influence with each other, our visitors, volunteers, and the animals every day. This includes listening, being present, being supportive of others, and demonstrating compassion and curiosity in conflict.
  • Build relationships with assigned shelters and provide consultative guidance, coaching and strategicmentorship on an ongoing basis to help shelters implement programming to achieve and sustain a 90% save rate. These areas include; shelter operations, lifesaving programs and proven strategies, community engagement, and more; including participating in direct, hands-on lifesaving work at partner shelter locations, as well as virtually
  • Travel to shelters to evaluate population needs and placement opportunities for dogs and cats for our Northwest Arkansas program and safely transport them to the center.
  • Support partner shelters by partnering with shelter leaders and staff to assess day-to-day operational challenges, reinforce accountability, and guide adoption of effective lifesaving practices as needed to provide needed lifesaving training to help them achieve and sustain no-kill; participate in team-building activities with shelter staff as needed to enhance buy-in.
  • Deliver superior customer service to partner shelters, community stakeholders and others. Develop and maintain a robust knowledge of Best Friends’ and animal welfare standard best practices to support lifesaving and care.
  • Serve as a mission ambassador, representing Best Friends’ mission and vision within partner shelters; leading training, consultation, and mentoring efforts; developing and refining resources for partner shelters on proven programs support their success in achieving no-kill; support the maintenance of statistics within priority partners shelters.
  • Lead and empower volunteers and volunteer teams in support of programs with the goal of utilizing volunteers to the greatest extent possible to expand Best Friends lifesaving capacity; deliver and lead superior customer service.
  • Work collaboratively with and assist Best Friends’ team members in all areas of operations to develop, refine, and implement efficient processes to achieve lifesaving goals exercise judgment in prioritizing work,follow policies, procedures, and task lists, including accurate and timely communications, work completion, data entry, and recordkeeping; respect partner policies when working in partner facilities.
  • Travel up to 75% within the state of Arkansas and surrounding states.

Skills and Experience:

  • Background in animal sheltering working in an animal shelter is required, preferably in a municipal, government or private shelter with contractual animal control responsibilities.
  • Basic ability to identify and speak to medical and behavioral characteristics, as well as body language of dogs and cats.
  • Ability to work in an environment that is not no-kill, remaining professional, nonjudgmental, and supportive of that shelter’s staff.
  • Experience with and comfortability driving large multi-passenger vehicles or willingness to learn.
  • Experience leading teams and implementing programs is preferred but not required.  
  • Bilingual or multilingual skills are preferred but not required.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, a team player, personable, professional, and able to get along with people from different backgrounds, as well as the ability to handle sensitive and confidential situations.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with well-developed organization skills to juggle multiple competing tasks and demands.  
  • Resourceful, get-it-done attitude; initiative to assist in any area or process; problem solving, seeking answers independently and enthusiastically; flexibility to persist until goals are achieved. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office products; familiarity with shelter software/animal management software, or desire to learn. 
  • Ability to professionally advocate Best Friends’ positions on issues; experience in supporting, engaging with, and developing relationships with volunteers and donors.

Physical Requirements:


  • Must have a valid driver's license for at least 3 years, ability to qualify to be added to Best Friends insurance.
  • Must be able to travel regularly up to 75% for evaluating and transporting pets, in shelter presentations, and training. Overnight stays when needed.
  • Exposure to dogs and cats of all sizes, temperaments, and medical status. Ability to work with, leash, kennel, walk, and handle cats and dogs, including those with health and/or behavior conditions/concerns.
  • Ability to be in a shelter environment and work in the presence of both cats and dogs, including large numbers of cats and dogs as in a shelter setting, and in shelters that are not yet no-kill.

What IT Program & Project Management Office (PMO) contributes to Cardinal Health

The PMO drives business outcomes by transforming strategic vision into execution through robust program governance, modern tools, and proactive change leadership. This function mobilizes high-performing project teams, aligns resource capacity to strategic priorities, and establishes clear accountability for deliverables. As financial and operational stewards, this job family optimizes project investments, proactively mitigates risks, and ensures rigorous adherence to quality standards while leveraging strategic partnerships and holding vendors accountable to ensure project success is achieved and outcomes are realized.

The Director, Technology Strategy & Execution (IT PMO) is a key leader in the IT Project Management Office responsible for shaping the portfolio and maximizing its strategic value. This role goes beyond traditional execution metrics; while maintaining a rigorous focus on delivering projects on time, within scope, and on budget, this leader ensures that the fundamental business case is met, strategic outcomes are achieved, and long-term business value is realized. This leader will oversee a portfolio of complex IT initiatives, ensuring close alignment with organizational goals, and will be instrumental in evolving the PMO into a high-performing strategic partner that actively shapes and protects business investments.


Location - Nationwide, fully remote (with preference towards candidates in ET/CT, willing and able to travel to our global HQ in Central Ohio 5-10%)


Responsibilities

  • Portfolio & Strategic Alignment: Champion the IT PMO strategy by shifting from administrative progress reporting to actively shaping the enterprise portfolio, ensuring investments directly drive strategic business value and outcomes.
  • Predictive PMO Enablement: Champion the adoption of Planview and the integration of AI-driven insights, focusing on what will happen to drive proactive decision-making rather than merely reporting on what has already occurred.
  • Talent Leadership & Workforce Coaching: Build a future-ready workforce by upskilling, mentoring, and coaching project managers; cultivate critical situational skills including critical thinking, relationship building, and thriving in ambiguity.
  • Upstream Demand Shaping (“Shift Left”): Drive proactive “shift left” processes, including pre-project estimating and business-case planning, to ensure new work is rigorously scoped and aligned to strategic goals before execution begins.
  • Empowered Truth & Accountability: Foster a high-trust culture where PMO professionals are empowered to drive accountability, speak the truth on project health, and proactively escalate risks and critical dependencies.
  • Executive Risk & Resource Stewardship: Partner with senior leadership to assess enterprise-wide project risks, strategic dependencies, and resource constraints, facilitating timely, data-driven decisions and governance.
  • Vendor Accountability & Value Management: Collaborate with Solution Owners and Indirect Procurement to actively manage technology investments, leveraging strategic partnerships and holding vendors accountable to maximize delivered value.
  • Strategic Influence & Negotiation: Drive consensus and alignment across diverse, cross-functional stakeholder groups in sensitive or complex business situations while maintaining positive, collaborative relationships.

Qualifications

  • Ideally targeting individuals with 10-12+ years of experience in IT project/program management (5+ in people leadership capacity highly preferred)
  • Proven experience managing large-scale IT programs, with a demonstrated ability to evolve a PMO from an execution-focused to a value-driven organization.
  • Prior experience with Planview is preferred, not required.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing front-end governance or “shift left” processes, including pre-project sizing, demand shaping, and strategic capacity management.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and situational leadership skills, with a proven ability to challenge status-quo thinking, negotiate high-risk vendor parameters, and influence executive stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership capabilities with experience in championing talent development, coaching, and building a high-performing, resilient team.
  • PMP or similar certification preferred.

Bonus Eligible - Yes

Job

OSA Support Technician

Description

OSA Support Technician

SUMMARY


The Customer Support Technician provides technical support for our client and theater exhibitor partners to ensure sites and their cinema screens have the required content and playlists to deliver advertising campaigns and other ‘pre-show’ content to movie theater patrons.

RESPONSIBILITIES


  • In a team environment perform monitoring of site systems and perform technical troubleshooting to ensure content is played as scheduled.
  • Develop understanding and use of site hardware and associated server and screen player software components.
  • Contribute to knowledgebase and troubleshooting processes, training, and maintain documentation of standard operating procedures.
  • Manage end-to-end incident resolution and repair transactions.
  • Perform outbound calls as needed to sample, track and document select advertising campaigns.
  • Utilize ticketing system to accommodate incident tracking.
  • Utilize network management systems to accommodate content and playlist delivery using electronic and physical mediums.
  • Work overtime hours as needed in the event of high support volume.
  • Maintain professionalism and courtesy when working with internal and external customers.

REQUIREMENTS


  • Minimum of a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • Experience in technical support or equivalent training preferred.
  • Computer hardware, software and networking knowledge preferred.
  • Familiarity with Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel) required.
  • Reputable verbal communication and written documentation skills with attention to detail.
  • Adhere to confidentiality of sensitive and proprietary company and client information.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills with the ability to delight the customer.

ABOUT THE COMPANY


Deluxe, a subsidiary of Platinum Equity, is a global leader in media and entertainment services for film, video, and online content. Since 1915, Deluxe has been the trusted partner for the world’s most successful Hollywood studios, independent film companies, TV networks, exhibitors, advertisers and others, offering best-in-class solutions in post-production, distribution, asset and workflow management, and cloud-based technologies.


With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices around the globe, the company employs over 3,500 of the most talented individuals, developers, and industry veterans worldwide. For more information, please visit .


We offer competitive pay and benefits program including medical, dental & vision coverage, vacation & sick leave, 401(k), and more.

It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees.
