Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Compliance Lead who will be responsible for operationalizing our compliance programs and championing a culture of integrity at Geotab. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Compliance Lead your key area of responsibility will be driving adherence to our policies, procedures, and evolving global regulatory requirements by designing and executing right-sized compliance initiatives. You will need to work closely with Legal, Finance, Technology, HR, IT, Operations, and Senior Management.

To be successful in this role you will be a high-performance, tech-forward individual with strong agility, integrity, communication, and leadership skills. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong risk and control orientation, strategic thinking, analytical capability, and a focus on continuous improvement.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of a comprehensive, risk-based ethics and compliance strategy—proactively identifying gaps, recommending solutions, and aligning programs to global business goals without waiting to be directed.
  • Lead and manage thorough, impartial investigations into allegations of non-compliance, unethical conduct, or violations of our Code of Conduct and other policies—leveraging AI tools to enhance efficiency, pattern detection, and investigative rigor, and delivering clear findings to leadership.
  • Take full ownership of drafting, reviewing, and continuously improving key ethics and compliance policies and procedures—including our Code of Conduct, Anti-Corruption & Anti-Bribery, Third-Party Risk Management, Sanctions, Conflicts of Interest, and Whistleblower policies—anticipating regulatory changes and proactively recommending updates before issues arise.
  • Design and own compliance risk assessment programs—identifying vulnerabilities before they become issues, leveraging AI-powered analytics to surface patterns and gaps, and bringing forward data-driven, actionable solutions rather than escalating problems.
  • Serve as a proactive thought partner and subject matter expert for the compliance team and business partners on ABAC, third-party risk, business continuity, records retention, and sanctions—consistently bringing well-reasoned recommendations and solutions to the table rather than surfacing problems without a path forward.
  • Drive cross-functional compliance integration by independently initiating partnerships with Legal, Finance, Technology, HR, IT, Operations, and Senior Management—embedding compliance into business processes and building AI-powered tools and self-service resources that reduce friction and manual effort across the organization.
  • Stay abreast of evolving laws, regulations, industry standards, and best practices relevant to ethics and compliance in the technology sector. Drive automation and AI utilization across compliance workflows, building scalable tools, automated systems, and self-service knowledge repositories that enable other departments to handle routine compliance matters independently—reducing reliance on manual administrative support and empowering the organization to self-serve.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 5 - 8 years of required experience in developing and managing ethics and compliance programs, conducting internal investigations, and leading complex cross-functional compliance initiatives.
  • Technology Adoption & Automation: Rapidly learns, adopts, and deploys new technologies, SaaS platforms, and AI tools. Comfortable building workflow automations to eliminate repetitive administrative tasks and drive self-service adoption to scale compliance operations.

  • Agility & Multi-Tasking: Ability to juggle competing priorities, context-switch smoothly in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple complex projects simultaneously while maintaining high attention to detail.

  • Risk & Control Orientation: Strong ability to identify, evaluate and mitigate compliance risks across processes. Demonstrates proactive approach to maintaining effective control environments.

  • Integrity & Ethical Conduct: Upholds the highest ethical standards and promotes a culture of honesty and transparency. Acts as a trusted advisor and role model for ethical decision-making.

  • Strategic Thinking & Decision-Making: Balances regulatory requirements with business objectives. Anticipates compliance challenges and recommends forward-looking strategies.

  • Communication & Influence: Effectively communicates compliance expectations to all levels of the organization. Influences stakeholders and drives behavioral change without direct authority.

  • Leadership & Collaboration: Leads cross-functional initiatives, guiding teams to embed compliance into business operations. Builds strong relationships with internal stakeholders.

  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Capability: Uses data and evidence-based approaches to identify issues and develop solutions. Demonstrates sound judgment in handling sensitive or complex compliance matters.

  • Continuous Improvement & Learning: Stays updated on evolving regulatory landscapes and industry best practices. Continuously seeks to enhance compliance processes, tools and training programs.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field with a focus on ethics and compliance programs (Post-Secondary Diploma/Degree required). Professional Certification in CCEP is preferred.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.

Baby bonus & parental leave top up program

How we work:

At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!

Engagement Lead - Liquid AI

Let’s be unstoppable together!

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We have a global commitment to diversity,equity,and inclusion as we believe in the undeniable strength that diversity brings to our business, employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at .

What will you be doing?

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Engagement Manager to lead AI solution deployments across a broad range of clients. The ideal candidate will have a background in consulting, with a proven track record of managing technology deployments and delivering exceptional results. You will need a deep understanding of the AI solutions you’re deploying to ensure successful deployments. You will be responsible for building and maintaining relationships with senior client leadership and key stakeholders, ensuring that the deployment team meets the established goals and objectives, and helping each client prepare for and manage the necessary change within their organization to deliver the expected business value. This role supports clients in the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), General Merchandise, and Retail industries.

Job Responsibilities

  • Define, initiate, and lead the overall client engagement strategy for AI deployments, serving as the executive sponsor and senior trusted advisor accountable for business outcomes, technical integration, adoption, and long-term value realization.
  • Lead and direct cross-functional deployment teams, setting the vision, operating model, priorities, and governance needed to launch and scale client initiatives while ensuring disciplined execution against strategic objectives.
  • When necessary, leverage deep expertise on AI and Circana AI solutions to advise clients on best deployment practices.
  • Provide strategic guidance to clients on best practices for deployment, including AI technology integration, process improvement, and change management.
  • Oversee the deployment lifecycle, from initial sale through the successful deployment of the AI solutions as well as the transition to on-going post-deployment support.
  • Conduct thorough needs assessments and strategic planning sessions to understand client requirements and challenges as it relates to the deployment of AI solutions.
  • Manage deployment timelines, solution revenue, and resource allocation effectively, including establishing and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs), to ensure the deployment is completed on time and within scope with the ability to demonstrate the AI solution impact.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership and client stakeholders to communicate deployment progress, address concerns, and ensure alignment between Circana’s and the client’s goals.
  • Advise and guide clients through adoption using principles of change management.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at client organizations, acting as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation with a focus on scale across the deployment team.

Requirements

  • Significant experience sponsoring and leading enterprise client engagements, including setting strategic direction, establishing governance, aligning executive stakeholders, and owning delivery accountability across complex programs.
  • Strong passion for AI overall and a deep understanding of AI technologies and their applications in business settings.
  • Proven track record of leading successful technology deployments, including hands-on technical experience designing, configuring, and delivering AI solutions that leverage LLMs (e.g., prompt and workflow design/orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, usage tracking, automated testing, evaluation and monitoring), including tailored agentic and agent-to-agent patterns.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage directly with client IT, data architecture, and AI governance teams in technically credible discussions about how Circana’s solutions integrate into their existing ecosystems.

Position Overview: 

We’re seeking an exceptional Director of Global IT Support that will lead and oversee global IT service desk operations, managing a multi-tiered support organization that delivers 24/7/365 follow-the-sun coverage to approximately 7,500 employees across five countries. In this strategic leadership role, you will be responsible for establishing world-class service delivery, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring exceptional end-user experiences while managing distributed teams and complex enterprise IT environments. You will also champion the strategic adoption of AI and automation to transform how support is delivered – reducing ticket volume through intelligent self-service and elevating the role of human agents to higher-value work.

What We Need From You: 

  • Execute a 24/7/365 service availability global service desk strategy aligned with corporate IT objectives and business goals
  • Foster a culture of customer service excellence, accountability, and continuous learning to delight our end users
  • Build high-performing teams through effective recruiting, onboarding, and training
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of a multi-tiered (Tier 1, Tier 2&3, and HW Support) global service desk organization
  • Establish service level objectives (SLOs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational metrics to measure and improve service delivery
  • Drive AI transformation initiatives to modernize service desk operations, including AI-powered ticket triage and routing, predictive issue detection, and self-service deflection to reduce Tier 1 volume
  • Champion adoption of AI copilots and agentic tools for L1/L2 technicians to accelerate resolution time and improve first-contact resolution rates
  • Define and track AI-driven efficiency metrics (deflection rate, automated resolution %, agent time saved) alongside traditional SLOs/KPIs
  • Manage annual budget planning, forecasting, and cost optimization for service desk operations
  • Implement and optimize follow-the-sun support model across India, US, The Philippines, Mexico, and UK locations
  • Manage relationships with third-party vendors, managed service providers, and technology partners to purchase hardware, licenses, and complete projects in support of end users
  • Build strong partnerships with HR, Finance, and other corporate functions
  • Drive implementation and optimization of ITSM tools, AI-enabled knowledge bases, and self-service portals – leveraging natural language search and generative AI to improve knowledge accuracy and findability
  • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies including AI-powered chatbots, automation, and analytics
  • Ensure integration between service desk platforms and enterprise systems (email systems, IAM, HRIS systems, and more)
  • Drive adoption of remote support tools, asset management systems, and monitoring solutions for end users
  • Maintain security and compliance standards across all service desk technologies

 

What You Will Bring To HealthEdge: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field (Master's degree preferred)

  • Familiarity with integration patterns between ITSM, HRIS, and identity management systems
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and retain high-performing global teams
  • Strong change management capabilities with experience leading organizational transformations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to present to executive audiences
  • Proven track record of building and scaling service desk operations
  • Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, and contractual negotiations
  • Customer service orientation with commitment to exceptional user experiences
  • Data-driven decision making with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strategic thinking combined with hands-on operational capabilities
  • Cultural sensitivity and ability to work effectively across diverse global teams
  • Adaptability and resilience in fast-paced, dynamic environments
  • Experience with email and IAM systems federations and complex merger/acquisition IT integrations
  • Background or familiarity with healthcare compliance (HIPAA, SOC 2) and security frameworks
  • Hands-on experience implementing AI/ML-powered ITSM capabilities – chatbots/virtual agents, intelligent ticket routing, automated knowledge management, or predictive analytics – with measurable impact on deflection or resolution metrics
  • Previous experience in merger and acquisition IT integration projects a plus

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

At DiligenceVault , we've built the leading technology platform transforming how due diligence is conducted globally.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team and help build and scale a modern, data-intensive B2B SaaS platform. You'll work across the full stack - designing robust backend APIs, and contributing to a polished Angular frontend - while collaborating closely with product, design, and fellow engineers.
This is a high-ownership role. You'll be involved in architectural decisions, code reviews, and shaping engineering standards, not just executing tickets.

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js, Express.js, and TypeScript
  • Develop and maintain frontend features in Angular, working closely with designers to deliver clean, performant UIs
  • Contribute to API design, ensuring consistency, security, and maintainability
  • Design database schemas, write migrations, and optimize query performance across PostgreSQL and SQL Server
  • Participate in system design discussions and help define technical direction for new features
  • Write well-tested, reviewable code and actively participate in code reviews
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Implement security best practices - JWT auth, rate limiting, input validation, prompt shielding
  • Own production reliability - PM2 process management, graceful shutdown, health checks, structured logging
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, QA, and other engineers in an agile environment

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Production experience with Express.js - middleware chains, request lifecycle, error handling
  • Fluency in TypeScript - you default to it, not tolerate it

  • Experience building streaming APIs (SSE, chunked transfer encoding)
  • Experience with authentication patterns (JWT RS256, OAuth 2.0, SAML)
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Container experience (Docker, Azure Container Instances)
